97.s:
īśvara uvāca
(3)prātar nitpavidhiṃ kṛtvā dvārapālaprapūjanaṃ /
praviśya pragvidhānena dehaśuddhyādimācaret //
97.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
(3)प्रातर् नित्पविधिं कृत्वा द्वारपालप्रपूजनं /
प्रविश्य प्रग्विधानेन देहशुद्ध्यादिमाचरेत् //
97.m:
The Lord said:
Having performed the regular morning rites and the worship of the door-guardians,
entering according to the prior injunction, one should carry out the purification of the body and other [preliminaries].

97.s:
dikpatīṃś ca samabhyarcya śivakumbhañca vardhanīṃ /
:n
1 satyādhivāsanamiti ja..
2 dīkṣāntañca samabhyarcyeti ja..
3 vāsudeva dayāśīla līlayā māṃ samuddhara / gharoddhāre samarthosi
mamoddhāre kiyañchramaḥ // iti śloko kha.. , cha.. pustakedhikotrāsti
:p 327
aṣṭamuṣṭikayā(1) liṅgaṃ vahniṃ sanparpya ca kramāt //
97.d:
दिक्पतींश् च समभ्यर्च्य शिवकुम्भञ्च वर्धनीं /
:न्
1 सत्याधिवासनमिति ज..
2 दीक्षान्तञ्च समभ्यर्च्येति ज..
3 वासुदेव दयाशील लीलया मां समुद्धर / घरोद्धारे समर्थोसि
ममोद्धारे कियञ्छ्रमः // इति श्लोको ख.. , छ.. पुस्तकेधिकोत्रास्ति
:प् 327
अष्टमुष्टिकया(1) लिङ्गं वह्निं सन्पर्प्य च क्रमात् //
97.m:
And having worshipped the regents of the directions, the Śiva-pitcher, and the Vardhanī pitcher,
[Footnotes]
1. 'satyādhivāsanam' in manuscript ja.
2. 'dīkṣāntañca samabhyarcya' in manuscript ja.
"3 O Vāsudeva of merciful nature, deliver me through Your divine play! You are capable of lifting up the earth; what effort is there in uplifting me?" This extra verse is found here in manuscripts kha and cha.
and having gratified the liṅga and the fire in order with the eight-handful offering,

97.s:
śivājñātastato gacchet prāsādaṃ śastramuccaran(2) /
tadgatān prakṣipedvighnān humphaḍantaśarāṇunā(3) //
97.d:
शिवाज्ञातस्ततो गच्छेत् प्रासादं शस्त्रमुच्चरन्(2) /
तद्गतान् प्रक्षिपेद्विघ्नान् हुम्फडन्तशराणुना(3) //
97.m: one should then go, by Śiva's command, to the temple, reciting the weapon-mantra. / One should banish the obstacles residing there with the arrow-mantra ending in 'hum phaṭ'.

97.s:
na madhye sthāpayelliṅgaṃ bedhadoṣaviśaṅkayā /
tasmān madhyaṃ parityajya yavārdhena yavena vā //
97.d:
न मध्ये स्थापयेल्लिङ्गं बेधदोषविशङ्कया /
तस्मान् मध्यं परित्यज्य यवार्धेन यवेन वा //
97.m: One must not set up the liṅga in the exact center, out of apprehension of the fault of piercing. / Therefore, leaving the center by half a barleycorn or by a barleycorn,

97.s:
kiñcidīśānamāśritya śilāṃ madhye niveśayet /
mūlena tāmanantākhyāṃ sarvādhārasvarūpiṇīṃ(4) //
97.d:
किञ्चिदीशानमाश्रित्य शिलां मध्ये निवेशयेत् /
मूलेन तामनन्ताख्यां सर्वाधारस्वरूपिणीं(4) //
97.m: leaning slightly toward the northeast, one should place the stone in the middle. / With the root-mantra, [he should place] that immovable stone named Anantā, which is the nature of the foundation of all,

97.s:
sarvagāṃ sṛṣṭiyogena vinyasedacalāṃ śilāṃ /
athavānena mantreṇa śivasyāsanarūpiṇīṃ //
97.d:
सर्वगां सृष्टियोगेन विन्यसेदचलां शिलां /
अथवानेन मन्त्रेण शिवस्यासनरूपिणीं //
97.m: all-pervading, through the conjunction of creation; / or with this mantra, [as] having the nature of Śiva's seat:

97.s:
oṃ namo vyāpini bhagavati sthire 'cale dhruve /
hraṃ laṃ hrīṃ svāhā(5)
tvayā śivājñayā śakte sthātavyamiha santataṃ //
97.d:
ओं नमो व्यापिनि भगवति स्थिरे ऽचले ध्रुवे /
ह्रं लं ह्रीं स्वाहा(5)
त्वया शिवाज्ञया शक्ते स्थातव्यमिह सन्ततं //
97.m:
Oṃ, obeisance to the All-Pervading, Auspicious, Firm, Immovable, Steadfast One!
Hraṃ laṃ hrīṃ svāhā.
"By the command of Śiva, O Śakti, you must remain here constantly."

97.s:
ityuktvā ca samabhyarcya(6) nirudhyādraudramudrayā(7) /
vajrādīni ca ratnāni tathośīrādikauṣadhīḥ //
97.d:
इत्युक्त्वा च समभ्यर्च्य(6) निरुध्याद्रौद्रमुद्रया(7) /
वज्रादीनि च रत्नानि तथोशीरादिकौषधीः //
97.m:
Having said this and worshipped, restraining [her] with the mudrā of Rudra,
[he deposits] diamond and other gems, as well as uśīra and other medicinal herbs,

97.s:
lohān hemādikāṃsyantān haritālādikāṃs tathā /
dhānyaprabhṛtiśastrāṃś ca pūrvamuktānanukramāt //
97.d:
लोहान् हेमादिकांस्यन्तान् हरितालादिकांस् तथा /
धान्यप्रभृतिशस्त्रांश् च पूर्वमुक्ताननुक्रमात् //
97.m:
metals beginning with gold and ending with bronze, as well as orpiment and other minerals,
grains and the weapons previously spoken of, in proper succession.

97.s:
prabhārāgatvadehatvavīryaśaktimayānimān(8) /
bhāvayennekacittastu lokapāleśasaṃvaraiḥ(9) //
97.d:
प्रभारागत्वदेहत्ववीर्यशक्तिमयानिमान्(8) /
भावयेन्नेकचित्तस्तु लोकपालेशसंवरैः(9) //
97.m:
These [substances], consisting of lustre, passion, body, vigour, and power,
one should contemplate with focused mind, together with the restraints of the Regents of the Directions.

97.s:
pūrvādiṣu ca garteṣu(10) nyasedekaikaśaḥ kramāt(11) /
:n
1 aṣṭaputriyeti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca / aṣṭapuṣpikayeti ga.. , ṅa.. , ca /
aṣṭapuṣṭikayā iti ja..
2 prāsādamastramuccaran iti kha.. , ṅa.. ca / prasādaṃ śāstramuccaranniti
ga.. , ja.. ca
3 huṃ phaḍantaśivātmaneti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. ca / huṃ
phaḍantaśivāṇuneti ja..
4 sarvādhānasvarūpiṇīmiti ja..
5 hraṃ laṃ hraṃ svāheti kha.. , cha.. , ca / oṃ hrāṃ laṃ hāṃ svāheti
ja..
6 ity uktvā taṃ samabhyarcyeti kha.. , cha.. ca / ity unmūlaṃ samabhyarceti ga.. /
ity uccārya samabhyarcyeti ṅa..
7 virundhyādrodhamudrayeti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. ca
8 vīryāśaktimanukramāditi gha..
9 lokapāleśasañcarair iti gha..
10 pūrvādivatsvagarteṣu iti ṅa..
11 prabhārāgetyādiḥ nyasedekaikaśaḥ kramāditi pāṭhaḥ,
chapustake nāsti
:p 328
97.d:
पूर्वादिषु च गर्तेषु(10) न्यसेदेकैकशः क्रमात्(11) /
:न्
1 अष्टपुत्रियेति ख.. , घ.. , छ.. च / अष्टपुष्पिकयेति ग.. , ङ.. , च /
अष्टपुष्टिकया इति ज..
2 प्रासादमस्त्रमुच्चरन् इति ख.. , ङ.. च / प्रसादं शास्त्रमुच्चरन्निति
ग.. , ज.. च
3 हुं फडन्तशिवात्मनेति ख.. , ग.. , छ.. च / हुं
फडन्तशिवाणुनेति ज..
4 सर्वाधानस्वरूपिणीमिति ज..
5 ह्रं लं ह्रं स्वाहेति ख.. , छ.. , च / ओं ह्रां लं हां स्वाहेति
ज..
6 इत्य् उक्त्वा तं समभ्यर्च्येति ख.. , छ.. च / इत्य् उन्मूलं समभ्यर्चेति ग.. /
इत्य् उच्चार्य समभ्यर्च्येति ङ..
7 विरुन्ध्याद्रोधमुद्रयेति ख.. , ग.. , ङ.. च
8 वीर्याशक्तिमनुक्रमादिति घ..
9 लोकपालेशसञ्चरैर् इति घ..
10 पूर्वादिवत्स्वगर्तेषु इति ङ..
11 प्रभारागेत्यादिः न्यसेदेकैकशः क्रमादिति पाठः,
छपुस्तके नास्ति
:प् 328
97.m:
And in the pits beginning with the east, he should deposit them one by one in order.
[Notes]
1 "aṣṭaputriyā" thus in MSS kha, gha, and cha. / "aṣṭapuṣpikayā" thus in MSS ga, ṅa, and ca.
"aṣṭapuṣṭikayā" thus in MS ja.
2 "prāsādamastramuccaran" thus in MSS kha and ṅa. / "prasādaṃ śāstramuccaran" thus in MSS ga and ja.
3 "huṃ phaḍantaśivātmanā" thus in MSS kha, ga, and cha. / "huṃ phaḍantaśivāṇunā" thus in MS ja.
4 "sarvādhānasvarūpiṇīm" thus in MS ja.
5 "hraṃ laṃ hraṃ svāhā" thus in MSS kha, cha, and ca. / "oṃ hrāṃ laṃ hāṃ svāhā" thus in MS ja.
6 "ity uktvā taṃ samabhyarcya" thus in MSS kha and cha. / "ity unmūlaṃ samabhyarca" thus in MS ga.
"ity uccārya samabhyarcya" thus in MS ṅa.
7 "virundhyādrodhamudrayā" thus in MSS kha, ga, and ṅa.
8 "vīryāśaktimanukramāt" thus in MS gha.
9 "lokapāleśasañcaraiḥ" thus in MS gha.
10 "pūrvādivatsvagarteṣu" thus in MS ṅa.
11 The reading beginning with "prabhārāga..." up to "nyasedekaikaśaḥ kramāt" is not present in manuscript cha.

97.s: hemajaṃ tārajaṃ kūrmaṃ vṛṣaṃ vā dvārasammukhaṃ(1) //
97.d: हेमजं तारजं कूर्मं वृषं वा द्वारसम्मुखं(1) //
97.m: A tortoise or a bull, made of gold or silver, facing the entrance,

97.s:
sarittaṭamṛdā yuktaṃ parvatāgramṛdāthavā(2) /
prakṣipenmadhyagartādau(3) yadvā meruṃ suvarṇajaṃ //
97.d:
सरित्तटमृदा युक्तं पर्वताग्रमृदाथवा(2) /
प्रक्षिपेन्मध्यगर्तादौ(3) यद्वा मेरुं सुवर्णजं //
97.m:
accompanied by clay from a riverbank or clay from a mountaintop,
he should deposit first in the central pit, or else Mount Meru made of gold,

97.s:
madhūkākṣatasaṃyuktamañjanena samanvitaṃ /
pṛthivīṃ rājatīṃ yadvā yadvā hemasamudbhavāṃ //
97.d:
मधूकाक्षतसंयुक्तमञ्जनेन समन्वितं /
पृथिवीं राजतीं यद्वा यद्वा हेमसमुद्भवां //
97.m:
joined with madhūka flowers, unbroken grains, and accompanied by collyrium;
or an earth [image] made of silver, or else made of gold,

97.s:
sarvavījasuvarṇābhyāṃ samāyuktāṃ vinikṣipet(4) /
svarṇajaṃ rājataṃ vāpi sarvalohasamudbhavaṃ(5) //
97.d:
सर्ववीजसुवर्णाभ्यां समायुक्तां विनिक्षिपेत्(4) /
स्वर्णजं राजतं वापि सर्वलोहसमुद्भवं(5) //
97.m:
accompanied by all types of seeds and gold, he should deposit;
or one made of gold, or silver, or produced from all kinds of metal,

97.s:
suvarṇaṃ kṛśarāyuktaṃ padmanālaṃ(6) tato nyaset /
devadevasya śaktyādimūrtiparyantamāsanaṃ //
97.d:
सुवर्णं कृशरायुक्तं पद्मनालं(6) ततो न्यसेत् /
देवदेवस्य शक्त्यादिमूर्तिपर्यन्तमासनं //
97.m:
or gold accompanied by spiced rice; then he should deposit a lotus stalk.
Having fashioned the seat of the God of Gods extending up to the icon, beginning with the Śakti,

97.s:
prakalpya pāyasenātha liptvā(7) guggulunāthavā /
śvabhramācchādya vastreṇa tanutreṇāstrarakṣitaṃ(8) //
97.d:
प्रकल्प्य पायसेनाथ लिप्त्वा(7) गुग्गुलुनाथवा /
श्वभ्रमाच्छाद्य वस्त्रेण तनुत्रेणास्त्ररक्षितं(8) //
97.m:
and having smeared [it] with milk-rice or with bdellium,
and having covered the pit with a cloth, protected by the weapon [mantra] as an armour,

97.s:
dikpatibhyo baliṃ(9) datvā samācānto 'tha deśikaḥ /
śevena vā śilāśvabhrasaṅgadoṣanivṛttaye(10) //
97.d:
दिक्पतिभ्यो बलिं(9) दत्वा समाचान्तो ऽथ देशिकः /
शेवेन वा शिलाश्वभ्रसङ्गदोषनिवृत्तये(10) //
97.m:
having offered a bali offering to the Regents of the Directions, the preceptor, having sipped water,
either with the Śiva [mantra] or with the weapon [mantra], in order to remove the fault of contact between the stone and the pit,

97.s:
śastreṇa vā śataṃ samyag juhuyāt pūrṇayā saha /
:n
1 dvārasampuṭamiti ga.
2 mṛdā puna iti ga..
3 madhyagartāyāmiti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca
4 madhūkākṣatettyādiḥ, vinikṣipedityantaḥ pāṭho ga.. pustake
nāsti
5 sarvalohasamanvitamiti ga..
6 pañcadhānyamiti kha.. , gha.. ca
7 lipteti gha.. , ṅa.. ca
8 śvabhramācchādya vastreṇa tanmātreṇa svarakṣitamiti kha.. , ṅa.. ca /
yantramācchādya śastreṇa tanutreṇa svarakṣitamiti ja.. /
śvabhrettyādipāṭho cha.. pustake nāsti
9 dikpālādibhyo balimiti ḍa..
10 śilāstatra saṅgadoṣanivṛttaye iti gha.. , ja.. ca /
śilāśvabhramaṅgadoṣavṛttaye iti kha.. , cha.. ca
:p 329
ekaikāhutidānena santarpya vāstudevatāḥ //
97.d:
शस्त्रेण वा शतं सम्यग् जुहुयात् पूर्णया सह /
:न्
1 द्वारसम्पुटमिति ग.
2 मृदा पुन इति ग..
3 मध्यगर्तायामिति ख.. , घ.. , ङ.. च
4 मधूकाक्षतेत्त्यादिः, विनिक्षिपेदित्यन्तः पाठो ग.. पुस्तके
नास्ति
5 सर्वलोहसमन्वितमिति ग..
6 पञ्चधान्यमिति ख.. , घ.. च
7 लिप्तेति घ.. , ङ.. च
8 श्वभ्रमाच्छाद्य वस्त्रेण तन्मात्रेण स्वरक्षितमिति ख.. , ङ.. च /
यन्त्रमाच्छाद्य शस्त्रेण तनुत्रेण स्वरक्षितमिति ज.. /
श्वभ्रेत्त्यादिपाठो छ.. पुस्तके नास्ति
9 दिक्पालादिभ्यो बलिमिति ड..
10 शिलास्तत्र सङ्गदोषनिवृत्तये इति घ.. , ज.. च /
शिलाश्वभ्रमङ्गदोषवृत्तये इति ख.. , छ.. च
:प् 329
एकैकाहुतिदानेन सन्तर्प्य वास्तुदेवताः //
97.m:
should properly offer one hundred oblations together with the full oblation.
1 "dvārasampuṭam" thus in MS ga.
2 "mṛdā punaḥ" thus in MS ga.
3 "madhyagartāyām" thus in MSS kha, gha, and ṅa.
4 The reading beginning with "madhūkākṣata..." and ending with "vinikṣipet" is not present in manuscript ga.
5 "sarvalohasamanvitam" thus in MS ga.
6 "pañcadhānyam" thus in MSS kha and gha.
7 "liptā" thus in MSS gha and ṅa.
8 "śvabhramācchādya vastreṇa tanmātreṇa svarakṣitam" thus in MSS kha and ṅa.
"yantramācchādya śastreṇa tanutreṇa svarakṣitam" thus in MS ja.
The reading beginning with "śvabhra..." is not present in manuscript cha.
9 "dikpālādibhyo balim" thus in MS ḍa.
10 "śilāstatra saṅgadoṣanivṛttaye" thus in MSS gha and ja.
"śilāśvabhramaṅgadoṣavṛttaye" thus in MSS kha and cha.
gratifying the deities of the site architecture with the offering of one oblational libation each.

97.s:
samutthāpya hṛdādevamāsanaṃ maṅgalādibhiḥ /
gururdevāgrato gacchenmūrtipaiś ca diśi sthitaiḥ(1) //
97.d:
समुत्थाप्य हृदादेवमासनं मङ्गलादिभिः /
गुरुर्देवाग्रतो गच्छेन्मूर्तिपैश् च दिशि स्थितैः(1) //
97.m:
Having raised the god [and] the seat with the heart [mantra] and auspicious chants,
the guru should proceed in front of the deity, along with the attendants of the icons situated in the directions,

97.s:
caturbhiḥ saha kartavyā devayajñasya(2) pṛṣṭhataḥ /
prāsādādi(3) paribhramya bhadrākhyadvārasammukhaṃ //
97.d:
चतुर्भिः सह कर्तव्या देवयज्ञस्य(2) पृष्ठतः /
प्रासादादि(3) परिभ्रम्य भद्राख्यद्वारसम्मुखं //
97.m:
to be accompanied by four [priests] behind the sacrificial offering to the deity.
Having circumambulated the temple, [bringing it] before the door known as bhadra,

97.s:
liṅgaṃ saṃsthāpya datvārghyaṃ prāsādaṃ sanniveśayet(4) /
dvāreṇa dvārabandhena dvāradeśena tacchilā //
97.d:
लिङ्गं संस्थाप्य दत्वार्घ्यं प्रासादं सन्निवेशयेत्(4) /
द्वारेण द्वारबन्धेन द्वारदेशेन तच्छिला //
97.m:
having installed the liṅga and given water offering, he should bring it into the temple
through the door, the doorframe, and the threshold, [and place] that stone.

97.s:
dvārabandhe śikhāśūnye tadardhenātha tadṛte(5) /
varjayan(6) dvārasaṃsparśaṃ dvāreṇaiva maheśvaraṃ //
97.d:
द्वारबन्धे शिखाशून्ये तदर्धेनाथ तदृते(5) /
वर्जयन्(6) द्वारसंस्पर्शं द्वारेणैव महेश्वरं //
97.m:
In a doorframe devoid of a lintel crest, through half of it, or without it,
avoiding contact with the door, [he should bring] Maheśvara right through the entrance.

97.s:
devagṛhasamārambhe koṇenāpi praveśayet /
ayameva vidhirjñeyo vyaktaliṅge 'pi sarvataḥ //
97.d:
देवगृहसमारम्भे कोणेनापि प्रवेशयेत् /
अयमेव विधिर्ज्ञेयो व्यक्तलिङ्गे ऽपि सर्वतः //
97.m:
At the beginning of [constructing] the temple, he may also enter through a corner.
This very rule is to be understood in all respects even for a manifest liṅga.

97.s:
gṛhe praveśanaṃ dvāre lokair api samīritaṃ /
apadvārapraveśena vidurgotrakṣayaṃ gṛhaṃ(7) //
97.d:
गृहे प्रवेशनं द्वारे लोकैर् अपि समीरितं /
अपद्वारप्रवेशेन विदुर्गोत्रक्षयं गृहं(7) //
97.m:
Entering into a house through the entrance is likewise spoken of by worldly people;
by entering through a non-doorway, they know ruin to the lineage will befall the house.

97.s:
atha pīṭhe(8) ca saṃsthāpya liṅgaṃ dvārasya sammukhaṃ /
tūryamaṅgalanirgheṣair dūrvākṣatasamanvitaṃ //
97.d:
अथ पीठे(8) च संस्थाप्य लिङ्गं द्वारस्य सम्मुखं /
तूर्यमङ्गलनिर्घेषैर् दूर्वाक्षतसमन्वितं //
97.m:
Then, having installed the liṅga on the pedestal facing the doorway,
accompanied by dūrvā grass and unbroken grains, amidst the sounds of musical instruments and auspicious celebrations,

97.s:
samuttiṣṭhaṃ hṛdetyuktvā mahāpāśupataṃ paṭhet /
:n
1 mūrtipaiḥ svadiśi sthitair iti ja..
2 bandhubhiḥ saha kartavyā devayānasyeti kha.. / bandhubhiḥ sahakāre ca
devālayasya iti ga.. , ja.. ca
3 prāsādārdhamiti ja..
4 sampraveśayediti gha..
5 tadardhenātha ghātayet iti jha.. / tadardhenātha tatsute iti ga.. / tadardhenātha
tadyatimiti gha.. / tadardhe vātha tatsutamiti ja.. / tadardhe nātha tadyute iti
ṅa..
6 bandhane iti kha.. / bandhyan iti gha.. / rakṣayan iti jha.. / varjayediti cha..
7 vittagotrakṣayaṃ guhamiti ga..
8 atha caivaṃ iti ja.. , jha.. , gha.. ca
:p 330
apanīya ghaṭaṃ śvabhrād(1) deśiko mūrtipaiḥ saha //
97.d:
समुत्तिष्ठं हृदेत्युक्त्वा महापाशुपतं पठेत् /
:न्
1 मूर्तिपैः स्वदिशि स्थितैर् इति ज..
2 बन्धुभिः सह कर्तव्या देवयानस्येति ख.. / बन्धुभिः सहकारे च
देवालयस्य इति ग.. , ज.. च
3 प्रासादार्धमिति ज..
4 सम्प्रवेशयेदिति घ..
5 तदर्धेनाथ घातयेत् इति झ.. / तदर्धेनाथ तत्सुते इति ग.. / तदर्धेनाथ
तद्यतिमिति घ.. / तदर्धे वाथ तत्सुतमिति ज.. / तदर्धे नाथ तद्युते इति
ङ..
6 बन्धने इति ख.. / बन्ध्यन् इति घ.. / रक्षयन् इति झ.. / वर्जयेदिति छ..
7 वित्तगोत्रक्षयं गुहमिति ग..
8 अथ चैवं इति ज.. , झ.. , घ.. च
:प् 330
अपनीय घटं श्वभ्राद्(1) देशिको मूर्तिपैः सह //
97.m:
Saying 'Stand upright!' with the Heart [mantra], he should recite the Mahāpāśupata [hymn].
[Notes]
1. 'By the mūrtipas stationed in their own directions,' thus in manuscript ja.
2. 'Should be done together with relatives, of the divine carriage,' thus in kha. / 'And in the cooperation with relatives, of the temple,' thus in ga and ja.
3. 'Half of the temple,' thus in ja.
4. 'Should cause to enter,' thus in gha.
5. 'With half of that then he should strike,' thus in jha. / 'With half of that then for his son,' thus in ga. / 'With half of that then that ascetic,' thus in gha. / 'Or with half of that his son,' thus in ja. / 'With half of that, O lord, endowed with that,' thus in ṅa.
6. 'In binding,' thus in kha. / 'Binding,' thus in gha. / 'Protecting,' thus in jha. / 'Should avoid,' thus in cha.
7. 'The cave with the destruction of wealth and lineage,' thus in ga.
8. 'And then indeed thus,' thus in ja, jha, and gha.
[Page 330]
Having removed the jar from the pit, the master, together with the mūrtipas,

97.s:
mantraṃ sandhārayitvā tu(2) viliptaṃ(3) kuṅkumādibhiḥ /
śaktiśaktimatoraikyaṃ dhyātvā caiva tu rakṣitaṃ(4) //
97.d:
मन्त्रं सन्धारयित्वा तु(2) विलिप्तं(3) कुङ्कुमादिभिः /
शक्तिशक्तिमतोरैक्यं ध्यात्वा चैव तु रक्षितं(4) //
97.m: bearing the mantra, [the liṅga] smeared with saffron and other [unguents], / and having meditated upon the unity of Śakti and Śaktimat, it is protected.

97.s:
layāntaṃ(5) mūlamuccārya spṛṣṭvā śvabhre niveśayet(5) /
aṃśena brahmabhāgasya yadvā aṃśadvayena ca //
97.d:
लयान्तं(5) मूलमुच्चार्य स्पृष्ट्वा श्वभ्रे निवेशयेत्(5) /
अंशेन ब्रह्मभागस्य यद्वा अंशद्वयेन च //
97.m: Uttering the root-mantra up to dissolution [layānta], touching it, he should place it in the pit, / by one portion of the Brahmā-section, or by two portions,

97.s:
ardhena vāṣṭamāṃśena sarvasyātha praveśanaṃ(7) /
vidhāya sīsakaṃ nābhidīrghābhiḥ(8) susamāhitaḥ //
97.d:
अर्धेन वाष्टमांशेन सर्वस्याथ प्रवेशनं(7) /
विधाय सीसकं नाभिदीर्घाभिः(8) सुसमाहितः //
97.m: or by half, or by an eighth part—then inserting the whole. / Having placed the lead [cushion], completely composed, with [strips] as long as the navel,

97.s:
śvabhraṃ(9) vālukayāpurya brūyāt sthirībhaveti ca(10) /
tato liṅge sthirībhūte dhyātvā(11) sakalarūpiṇaṃ //
97.d:
श्वभ्रं(9) वालुकयापुर्य ब्रूयात् स्थिरीभवेति च(10) /
ततो लिङ्गे स्थिरीभूते ध्यात्वा(11) सकलरूपिणं //
97.m: filling the pit with sand, he should say, 'Become firm!' / Then, when the liṅga has become firm, meditating upon the One endowed with parts,

97.s:
mūlamuccārya śaktyantaṃ sṛṣṭyā ca niṣkalaṃ(12) nyaset /
sthāpyamānaṃ yadā liṅgaṃ yāmyāṃ diśamathāśrayet(13) //
97.d:
मूलमुच्चार्य शक्त्यन्तं सृष्ट्या च निष्कलं(12) न्यसेत् /
स्थाप्यमानं यदा लिङ्गं याम्यां दिशमथाश्रयेत्(13) //
97.m: uttering the root-mantra up to Śakti, he should deposit the Partless [Lord] in the order of creation. / When the liṅga being installed leans toward the southern direction,

97.s:
tattaddigīśamantreṇa pūrṇāntaṃ dakṣiṇānvitaṃ /
:n
1 ghaṭaṃ tatra iti jha..
2 mantraṃ sandhārayitvātha iti kha.. / patrasthaṃ dhārayitvā tu, iti
gha..
3 suliptamiti ga..
4 lakṣitamiti gha.. , ja.. , jha.. , ca
5 namontamiti ḍa..
6 śaktimudre niveśayediti ja..
7 ardhena cāṣṭamāṃśena sarvasyādhaḥ praveśanam iti ja..
8 sīsakaṃ vāgbhirdīrghābhiriti cha.. / sīsakaṃ cāpi dīrghāriti
ja..
9 atheti ka.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca
10 layāmantamityādiḥ, sthirībhaveti ca ity antaḥ
sārdhaślokadvayātmakaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti
11 dhyāyediti gha..
12 sṛṣṭyādivikalamiti jha.. / sṛṣṭyādiniṣphalamiti kha.. , gha.. , ca
/ sṛṣṭyādi niṣphalamiti ga.. , ḍa.. ca
13 tato liṅge ity ādiḥ, diśamathāśrayedityantaḥ pāṭho ja.. pustake
nāsti
:p 331
savye sthāne ca vakre ca(1) calite sphuṭitepi vā //
97.d:
तत्तद्दिगीशमन्त्रेण पूर्णान्तं दक्षिणान्वितं /
:न्
1 घटं तत्र इति झ..
2 मन्त्रं सन्धारयित्वाथ इति ख.. / पत्रस्थं धारयित्वा तु, इति
घ..
3 सुलिप्तमिति ग..
4 लक्षितमिति घ.. , ज.. , झ.. , च
5 नमोन्तमिति ड..
6 शक्तिमुद्रे निवेशयेदिति ज..
7 अर्धेन चाष्टमांशेन सर्वस्याधः प्रवेशनम् इति ज..
8 सीसकं वाग्भिर्दीर्घाभिरिति छ.. / सीसकं चापि दीर्घारिति
ज..
9 अथेति क.. , ङ.. , छ.. च
10 लयामन्तमित्यादिः, स्थिरीभवेति च इत्य् अन्तः
सार्धश्लोकद्वयात्मकः पाठो झ.. पुस्तके नास्ति
11 ध्यायेदिति घ..
12 सृष्ट्यादिविकलमिति झ.. / सृष्ट्यादिनिष्फलमिति ख.. , घ.. , च
/ सृष्ट्यादि निष्फलमिति ग.. , ड.. च
13 ततो लिङ्गे इत्य् आदिः, दिशमथाश्रयेदित्यन्तः पाठो ज.. पुस्तके
नास्ति
:प् 331
सव्ये स्थाने च वक्रे च(1) चलिते स्फुटितेपि वा //
97.m:
with the mantra of the lord of that respective direction, ending with the full oblation, accompanied by a sacrificial fee,
[Notes]
1. 'The jar there,' thus in jha.
2. 'Having retained the mantra then,' thus in kha. / 'Bearing that which is placed on the leaf, however,' thus in gha.
3. 'Well smeared,' thus in ga.
4. 'Observed,' thus in gha, ja, jha, and ca.
5. 'Ending with namaḥ,' thus in ḍa.
6. 'Should insert into the śaktimudrā,' thus in ja.
7. 'And by half, by an eighth part, the insertion below of all,' thus in ja.
8. 'The lead with long words,' thus in cha. / 'And also the lead long,' thus in ja.
9. 'Then,' thus in ka, ṅa, and cha.
10. The reading consisting of two and a half verses, beginning with 'layāntam' and ending with 'sthirībhaveti ca', is not present in manuscript jha.
11. 'Should meditate,' thus in gha.
12. 'Deficient in creation and the rest,' thus in jha. / 'Fruitless in creation and the rest,' thus in kha, gha, and ca. / 'Fruitless in creation and the rest,' thus in ga and ḍa.
13. The reading beginning with 'tato liṅge' and ending with 'diśamathāśrayet' is not present in manuscript ja.
[Page 331]
or in the left position, or crooked, or moved, or cracked,

97.s:
juhuyān mūlamantreṇa bahurūpeṇa(2) vā śataṃ /
kuñcānyeṣvapi doṣeṣu śivaśāntiṃ samāśrayet(3) //
97.d:
जुहुयान् मूलमन्त्रेण बहुरूपेण(2) वा शतं /
कुञ्चान्येष्वपि दोषेषु शिवशान्तिं समाश्रयेत्(3) //
97.m: he should offer one hundred oblations with the root-mantra or with the Bahurūpa [mantra]. / In cases of bending and other defects as well, he should take recourse to the propitiation of Śiva.

97.s:
yuktaṃ nyāsādibhirliṅgaṃ(4) kurvannevaṃ na doṣabhāk /
pīṭhabandhamataḥ kṛtvā lakṣaṇasyāṃśalakṣaṇaṃ(5) //
97.d:
युक्तं न्यासादिभिर्लिङ्गं(4) कुर्वन्नेवं न दोषभाक् /
पीठबन्धमतः कृत्वा लक्षणस्यांशलक्षणं(5) //
97.m: Doing this, the liṅga being endowed with nyāsa and the rest, he incurs no fault. / Then, having constructed the binding of the pedestal according to the proportion of its characteristics,

97.s:
gaurīmantraṃ layaṃ nītvā sṛṣṭyā piṇḍīñca vinyaset /
sampūrya pārśvasaṃsiddhiṃ vālukāvajralepanaṃ(6) //
97.d:
गौरीमन्त्रं लयं नीत्वा सृष्ट्या पिण्डीञ्च विन्यसेत् /
सम्पूर्य पार्श्वसंसिद्धिं वालुकावज्रलेपनं(6) //
97.m: having dissolved the Gaurī-mantra, he should deposit the pedestal in the order of creation. / Having filled [the cavity] to ensure stability of the sides with sand and adamantine plaster,

97.s:
tato mūrtidharaiḥ sārdhaṃ guruḥ śāntiṃ ghaṭordhvataḥ /
saṃsthāpya kalaśair anyaistadvat(7) pañcāmṛtādibhiḥ //
97.d:
ततो मूर्तिधरैः सार्धं गुरुः शान्तिं घटोर्ध्वतः /
संस्थाप्य कलशैर् अन्यैस्तद्वत्(7) पञ्चामृतादिभिः //
97.m: the guru then, together with the mūrtidharas, having established propitiation above the jar, / likewise with other jars, with the five nectars and other [liquids],

97.s:
vilipya candanādyaiś ca(8) sampūjya jagadīśvaraṃ /
umāmaheśamantrābhyāṃ tau spṛśelliṅgamudrayā //
97.d:
विलिप्य चन्दनाद्यैश् च(8) सम्पूज्य जगदीश्वरं /
उमामहेशमन्त्राभ्यां तौ स्पृशेल्लिङ्गमुद्रया //
97.m: having smeared it with sandalwood and other unguents, and having worshipped the Lord of the universe, / he should touch the two with the mantras of Umā and Maheśa using the liṅgamudrā.

97.s:
tatastritattvavinyāsaṃ ṣaḍarcādipuraḥsaraṃ(9) /
kṛtvā mūrtiṃ tadīśānāmaṅgānāṃ brahmaṇāmatha //
97.d:
ततस्त्रितत्त्वविन्यासं षडर्चादिपुरःसरं(9) /
कृत्वा मूर्तिं तदीशानामङ्गानां ब्रह्मणामथ //
97.m: Then, having performed the ritual deposition of the three principles preceded by the sixfold worship and the rest, / and then the icon of their lords, of the limbs, and of the Brahmā mantras,

97.s:
jñānī liṅge(10) kriyāpīṭhe vināsya snāpayettataḥ /
gandhair vilipya sandhūpya vyāpitve śive nyaset //
97.d:
ज्ञानी लिङ्गे(10) क्रियापीठे विनास्य स्नापयेत्ततः /
गन्धैर् विलिप्य सन्धूप्य व्यापित्वे शिवे न्यसेत् //
97.m: the knower, having deposited [them] on the liṅga and the pedestal of action, should then bathe [it]. / Having smeared it with fragrant pastes and censed it, he should deposit it in Śiva in His omnipresence.

97.s:
sragdhūpadīpanaivedyair hṛdayena phalāni ca /
:n
1 vakreṇeti kha..
2 catūrūpeṇa iti jha..
3 sthāpyamānamityādiḥ, śāntaṃ samāśrayat ity antaḥ pāṭhī
ga.. , ṅa.. , pustake nāsti
4 uktanyāsavidhiṃ liṅge iti kha.. / uktanyāsavidhau liṅge iti ga..
5 pīṭha bandhamadhaḥ kṛtvā kurvanneva na doṣabhāk iti kha.. , ga..
ca / pīṭha bandhamataḥ kṛtvā lakṣaṇasyāṅgalakṣaṇamiti
gha..
6 pārśvasiddhiṃ ca vālukāvrajalepanamiti ja..
7 saptāranyakalaśair anyaiḥ stutvā iti jha..
8 caturājyaiś ca iti jha..
9 ṣaḍarghādipuraḥsaramiti jha.. / ṣaḍagrādipuraḥsaramiti
kha..
10 jñānaliṅge iti jha..
:p 332
vinivedya yathāśakti samācamya maheśvaraṃ //
97.d:
स्रग्धूपदीपनैवेद्यैर् हृदयेन फलानि च /
:न्
1 वक्रेणेति ख..
2 चतूरूपेण इति झ..
3 स्थाप्यमानमित्यादिः, शान्तं समाश्रयत् इत्य् अन्तः पाठी
ग.. , ङ.. , पुस्तके नास्ति
4 उक्तन्यासविधिं लिङ्गे इति ख.. / उक्तन्यासविधौ लिङ्गे इति ग..
5 पीठ बन्धमधः कृत्वा कुर्वन्नेव न दोषभाक् इति ख.. , ग..
च / पीठ बन्धमतः कृत्वा लक्षणस्याङ्गलक्षणमिति
घ..
6 पार्श्वसिद्धिं च वालुकाव्रजलेपनमिति ज..
7 सप्तारन्यकलशैर् अन्यैः स्तुत्वा इति झ..
8 चतुराज्यैश् च इति झ..
9 षडर्घादिपुरःसरमिति झ.. / षडग्रादिपुरःसरमिति
ख..
10 ज्ञानलिङ्गे इति झ..
:प् 332
विनिवेद्य यथाशक्ति समाचम्य महेश्वरं //
97.m:
With garlands, incense, lamps, food offerings, and fruits with the Heart [mantra],
[Notes]
1. 'By the crooked,' thus in kha.
2. 'With the fourfold form,' thus in jha.
3. The reading beginning with 'sthāpyamānam' and ending with 'śāntaṃ samāśrayet' is not present in manuscripts ga and ṅa.
4. 'The stated rule of nyāsa on the liṅga,' thus in kha. / 'In the stated rule of nyāsa on the liṅga,' thus in ga.
5. 'Having made the pedestal-binding below, doing thus he does not incur fault,' thus in kha and ga. / 'Then having made the pedestal-binding, the characteristic of the limbs of the characteristic,' thus in gha.
6. 'And the accomplishment of the sides, the plaster of sand and adamantine cement,' thus in ja.
7. 'Having praised with other jars of the seven wild [elements],' thus in jha.
8. 'And with the four clarified butters,' thus in jha.
9. 'Preceded by the six water offerings and the rest,' thus in jha. / 'Preceded by the six tips and the rest,' thus in kha.
10. 'On the liṅga of knowledge,' thus in jha.
[Page 332]
having offered according to ability, and having sipped water, [addressing] Maheśvara,

97.s:
datvārghaṃ ca japaṃ kṛtvā(1) nivedya varade kare(2) /
candrārkatārakaṃ yāvan mantreṇa śaivamūrtipaiḥ(3) //
97.d:
दत्वार्घं च जपं कृत्वा(1) निवेद्य वरदे करे(2) /
चन्द्रार्कतारकं यावन् मन्त्रेण शैवमूर्तिपैः(3) //
97.m: and having given the arghya, and having performed japa, offering it into the boon-granting hand, / [proclaiming] 'As long as the moon, sun, and stars endure,' with the mantra by the Śaiva mūrtipas:

97.s:
svecchayaiva tvayā nātha sthātavyamiha mandire /
praṇamyeva vahirgatvā(4) hṛdā vā praṇavena vā //
97.d:
स्वेच्छयैव त्वया नाथ स्थातव्यमिह मन्दिरे /
प्रणम्येव वहिर्गत्वा(4) हृदा वा प्रणवेन वा //
97.m: 'By your own will alone, O Lord, you should remain here in this temple!' / Bowing and going outside, either with the Heart [mantra] or with the Praṇava,

97.s:
saṃsthāpya vṛṣabhaṃ paścāt pūrvavadvalimācaret /
nyūnādidoṣamoṣāya(5) tato mṛtyujitā śataṃ //
97.d:
संस्थाप्य वृषभं पश्चात् पूर्ववद्वलिमाचरेत् /
न्यूनादिदोषमोषाय(5) ततो मृत्युजिता शतं //
97.m: having installed the bull behind, he should perform the bali offering as before. / Then, for the destruction of deficiencies and other defects, one hundred [oblations] with the Mṛtyujit [mantra]

97.s:
śivena saśivo hutvā śāntyarthaṃ pāyasena ca /
jñānājñānakṛtaṃ yacca tat pūraya mahāvibho(6) //
97.d:
शिवेन सशिवो हुत्वा शान्त्यर्थं पायसेन च /
ज्ञानाज्ञानकृतं यच्च तत् पूरय महाविभो(6) //
97.m: being identical with Śiva, should be offered to Śiva with milk-rice for the sake of pacification: / 'Whatever has been done knowingly or unknowingly, fulfill that, O great Lord!'

97.s:
hiraṇyapaśubhūmyādi(7) gītavādyādihetave /
ambikeśāya tad bhaktyā śaktyā sarvaṃ nivedayet //
97.d:
हिरण्यपशुभूम्यादि(7) गीतवाद्यादिहेतवे /
अम्बिकेशाय तद् भक्त्या शक्त्या सर्वं निवेदयेत् //
97.m: Gold, cattle, land, and so forth, for the sake of songs, musical instruments, and the like, / he should offer all that with devotion according to ability to the Lord of Ambikā.

97.s:
dānaṃ mahotsavaṃ paścāt kuryāddinacatuṣṭayaṃ /
trisandhyaṃ tridinaṃ mantrī homayen mūrtipaiḥ saha //
97.d:
दानं महोत्सवं पश्चात् कुर्याद्दिनचतुष्टयं /
त्रिसन्ध्यं त्रिदिनं मन्त्री होमयेन् मूर्तिपैः सह //
97.m: Afterward, he should celebrate gifts and a great festival for four days. / For three days at the three junctions of the day, the mantrin together with the mūrtipas should offer oblations.

97.s:
caturthehani pūrṇāñca carukaṃ bahurūpiṇā /
nivedya sarvakuṇḍeṣu sampātāhutisodhitam(8) //
97.d:
चतुर्थेहनि पूर्णाञ्च चरुकं बहुरूपिणा /
निवेद्य सर्वकुण्डेषु सम्पाताहुतिसोधितम्(8) //
97.m: On the fourth day, having presented the full oblation and the sacrificial cooked rice with the Bahurūpa [mantra], / purified with sampātāhuti offerings in all the fire-pits,

97.s:
dinacatuṣṭayaṃ yāvattannirmālyantadūrdhataḥ /
nirmālyāpanayaṃ kṛtvā snāpayitvā tu(9) pūjayet //
97.d:
दिनचतुष्टयं यावत्तन्निर्माल्यन्तदूर्धतः /
निर्माल्यापनयं कृत्वा स्नापयित्वा तु(9) पूजयेत् //
97.m: the floral offerings of the deity remain for four days; after that, / having removed the floral offerings of the deity and bathed [the liṅga], he should worship it.

97.s:
pūjā sāmānyaliṅgeṣu kāryā sādhāraṇāṇubhiḥ(10) /
:n
1 jalaṃ hutvā iti ga..
2 nivedya varadevake iti ja..
3 mantreśair mūrtipaiḥ saha iti jha.. / mantreśair mūrtijaiḥ saha iti
gha..
4 vahiṣkṛtvā iti jha.. / vahirhatvā iti gha..
5 nyūnādidoṣamokṣāyeti ja.. / nyānādidoṣanāśāyeti ṅa..
6 mahāprabho iti jha..
7 hiraṇyavastradhūpādi iti jha..
8 pāyasāhutisodhitamiti jha.. / sampātāhutiśodhanamiti ga..
9 snāpayitvā ca iti ga..
10 sādhāraṇāṃśubhiriti kha.. / sādhāraṇādikamiti ga..
:p 333
vihāya liṅgacaitanyaṃ kuryāt sthāṇuvisarjanaṃ //
97.d:
पूजा सामान्यलिङ्गेषु कार्या साधारणाणुभिः(10) /
:न्
1 जलं हुत्वा इति ग..
2 निवेद्य वरदेवके इति ज..
3 मन्त्रेशैर् मूर्तिपैः सह इति झ.. / मन्त्रेशैर् मूर्तिजैः सह इति
घ..
4 वहिष्कृत्वा इति झ.. / वहिर्हत्वा इति घ..
5 न्यूनादिदोषमोक्षायेति ज.. / न्यानादिदोषनाशायेति ङ..
6 महाप्रभो इति झ..
7 हिरण्यवस्त्रधूपादि इति झ..
8 पायसाहुतिसोधितमिति झ.. / सम्पाताहुतिशोधनमिति ग..
9 स्नापयित्वा च इति ग..
10 साधारणांशुभिरिति ख.. / साधारणादिकमिति ग..
:प् 333
विहाय लिङ्गचैतन्यं कुर्यात् स्थाणुविसर्जनं //
97.m:
Worship in common liṅgas is to be performed with common mantras.
:n
1 'having offered water in fire' in manuscript ga..
2 'having presented to the eminent deity' in manuscript ja..
3 'along with the lords of mantras and the guardians of icons' in manuscript jha.. / 'along with the lords of mantras and those born of icons' in manuscript gha..
4 'having expelled outside' in manuscript jha.. / 'having struck outside' in manuscript gha..
5 'for liberation from faults such as deficiency' in manuscript ja.. / 'for the destruction of faults such as deficiency' in manuscript ṅa..
6 'O great lord' in manuscript jha..
7 'gold, garments, incense, and so forth' in manuscript jha..
8 'purified by oblations of milk-rice' in manuscript jha.. / 'the purification by fallen oblation remnants' in manuscript ga..
9 'and having bathed' in manuscript ga..
10 'with common rays' in manuscript kha.. / 'the common and so forth' in manuscript ga..
:p 333
Leaving aside the consciousness of the liṅga, one should perform the dismissal from the pillar.

97.s:
asādhāraṇaliṅgeṣu kṣamasveti visarjanaṃ /
āvāhanamabhivyaktirvisargaḥ śaktirūpatā //
97.d:
असाधारणलिङ्गेषु क्षमस्वेति विसर्जनं /
आवाहनमभिव्यक्तिर्विसर्गः शक्तिरूपता //
97.m: In uncommon liṅgas, the dismissal is with the formula 'Forgive!' / Invocation is manifestation; dismissal is [return to] the state of power.

97.s:
pratiṣṭhānte kvacit proktaṃ sthirādyāhutisaptakaṃ /
sthiras tathāprameyaścānādibodhastathaiva ca //
97.d:
प्रतिष्ठान्ते क्वचित् प्रोक्तं स्थिराद्याहुतिसप्तकं /
स्थिरस् तथाप्रमेयश्चानादिबोधस्तथैव च //
97.m: At the conclusion of consecration, a group of seven fire oblations beginning with 'Fixed' is elsewhere taught: / 'Fixed', and likewise 'Immeasurable', and likewise 'Of Beginningless Awakening',

97.s:
nityotha sarvagaś caivāvināśī dṛṣṭa eva ca(1) /
ete guṇā maheśasya sannidhānāya kīrtitāḥ(2) //
97.d:
नित्योथ सर्वगश् चैवाविनाशी दृष्ट एव च(1) /
एते गुणा महेशस्य सन्निधानाय कीर्तिताः(2) //
97.m: 'Eternal', then 'All-Pervading', and 'Imperishable', and 'Visible'. / These qualities of the Great Lord are proclaimed to secure His presence.

97.s:
oṃ namaḥ śivāya sthiro bhavetyāhutīnāṃ kramaḥ /
evametañca sampādya vidhāya śivakumbhavat(3) //
97.d:
ओं नमः शिवाय स्थिरो भवेत्याहुतीनां क्रमः /
एवमेतञ्च सम्पाद्य विधाय शिवकुम्भवत्(3) //
97.m: "Oṃ, homage to Śiva; be fixed!" is the order of the fire oblations. / Having accomplished this in this way and prepared like the Śiva-pitcher,

97.s:
kumbhadvayañca tanmadhyādekakumbhāmbhasā bhavaṃ /
saṃsnāpya tad dvitīyantu kartṛsnānāya dhārayet //
97.d:
कुम्भद्वयञ्च तन्मध्यादेककुम्भाम्भसा भवं /
संस्नाप्य तद् द्वितीयन्तु कर्तृस्नानाय धारयेत् //
97.m: two pitchers, with the water of one pitcher from between them / having bathed Bhava, he should keep the second for the bath of the patron.

97.s:
datvā baliṃ samācamya vahirgacchet śivājñayā(4) /
jagatīvāhyataś caṇḍamaiśānyāndiśi mandire //
97.d:
दत्वा बलिं समाचम्य वहिर्गच्छेत् शिवाज्ञया(4) /
जगतीवाह्यतश् चण्डमैशान्यान्दिशि मन्दिरे //
97.m: Having offered the bali offering and sipped water, he should go outside by Śiva's command. / Outside the terrace, [he should install] Caṇḍa in the northeastern direction in the temple,

97.s:
dhāmagarbhapramāṇe ca(5) supīṭhe(6) kalpitāsane /
pūrvavan nyāsahomādi vidhāya dhyānapūrvakaṃ //
97.d:
धामगर्भप्रमाणे च(5) सुपीठे(6) कल्पितासने /
पूर्ववन् न्यासहोमादि विधाय ध्यानपूर्वकं //
97.m: proportioned to the sanctum of the shrine, on an excellent pedestal, on a prepared seat. / Having performed the ritual deposition, fire oblations, and so on as before, preceded by meditation,

97.s:
saṃsthāpya vidhivattatra brahmāṅgaiḥ(7) pūjayettataḥ /
aṅgāni pūrvayuktāni(8) brahmāṇī tvarcanā yathā(9) //
:n
1 vilāsī tṛpta eva ca iti kha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca / avināśī tṛpta eva ca
iti ṅa..
2 sannidhāya prakīrtitā iti kha.. , cha.. ca
3 oṃ nama ity ādi, śivakumbhavat ity antaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti /
śivāya śivakumbhavat iti ga..
4 vahiḥ kumbhe śivājñayā iti jha..
5 vāmagarbhapramāṇena iti jha..
6 svapīṭhe iti ga..
7 brahmādyair iti ga.. , jha.. ca
8 pūrvamuktāni iti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca / pūrvabhuktānīti ja..
9 tvadhunā yathā iti kha..
:p 334
evaṃ sadyojātāya oṃ hrūṃ phaṭ(1) namaḥ / oṃ viṃ
vāmadevāya hrūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ buṃ(2) aghorāya hrūṃ
phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ(3) tatpuruṣāya vaumīśānāya ca hrūṃ phaṭ
||
97.d:
संस्थाप्य विधिवत्तत्र ब्रह्माङ्गैः(7) पूजयेत्ततः /
अङ्गानि पूर्वयुक्तानि(8) ब्रह्माणी त्वर्चना यथा(9) //
:न्
1 विलासी तृप्त एव च इति ख.. , ङ.. , छ.. , ज.. च / अविनाशी तृप्त एव च
इति ङ..
2 सन्निधाय प्रकीर्तिता इति ख.. , छ.. च
3 ओं नम इत्य् आदि, शिवकुम्भवत् इत्य् अन्तः पाठो झ.. पुस्तके नास्ति /
शिवाय शिवकुम्भवत् इति ग..
4 वहिः कुम्भे शिवाज्ञया इति झ..
5 वामगर्भप्रमाणेन इति झ..
6 स्वपीठे इति ग..
7 ब्रह्माद्यैर् इति ग.. , झ.. च
8 पूर्वमुक्तानि इति ख.. , ग.. , ङ.. , छ.. च / पूर्वभुक्तानीति ज..
9 त्वधुना यथा इति ख..
:प् 334
एवं सद्योजाताय ओं ह्रूं फट्(1) नमः / ओं विं
वामदेवाय ह्रूं फट् नमः / ओं बुं(2) अघोराय ह्रूं
फट् नमः / ओं(3) तत्पुरुषाय वौमीशानाय च ह्रूं फट्
||
97.m:
and having properly installed [him] there, he should then worship with the brahmāṅga mantras. / The secondary limbs are as stated before, while the Brahmā mantras for the worship are as follows:
:n
1 'playful and satisfied' in manuscripts kha.., ṅa.., cha.., and ja.. / 'imperishable and satisfied' in manuscript ṅa..
2 'proclaimed for presence' in manuscripts kha.. and cha..
3 The reading beginning with 'oṃ nama' up to 'śivakumbhavat' is absent in the manuscript jha..
'to Śiva, like the Śiva-pitcher' in manuscript ga..
4 'in the outer pitcher by Śiva's command' in manuscript jha..
5 'by the measurement of the left interior' in manuscript jha..
6 'on his own pedestal' in manuscript ga..
7 'with those beginning with Brahmā' in manuscripts ga.. and jha..
8 'stated before' in manuscripts kha.., ga.., ṅa.., and cha.. / 'enjoyed before' in manuscript ja..
9 'now as follows' in manuscript kha..
:p 334
Thus: Oṃ hrūṃ phaṭ, homage to Sadyojāta; oṃ viṃ hrūṃ phaṭ, homage to Vāmadeva; oṃ buṃ hrūṃ phaṭ, homage to Aghora; oṃ vaum hrūṃ phaṭ to Tatpuruṣa and to Īśāna.

97.s:
japaṃ vivedya(4) santarpya vijñāpya natipūrvakaṃ /
devaḥ sannihito yāvattāvattvaṃ sannidho bhava //
97.d:
जपं विवेद्य(4) सन्तर्प्य विज्ञाप्य नतिपूर्वकं /
देवः सन्निहितो यावत्तावत्त्वं सन्निधो भव //
97.m: Having offered recitation, having made water libations, having petitioned preceded by prostration: / 'As long as the God is present, for that long be present!

97.s:
nyūnādhikañca yatkiñcit kṛtamajñānato mayā(5) /
tavatprasādena caṇḍeśa tat sarvaṃ paripūraya //
97.d:
न्यूनाधिकञ्च यत्किञ्चित् कृतमज्ञानतो मया(5) /
तवत्प्रसादेन चण्डेश तत् सर्वं परिपूरय //
97.m: Whatever has been done in defect or in excess by me through ignorance, / by your grace, O Caṇḍeśa, make all that complete!'

97.s:
vāṇaliṅge vāṇarohe(6) siddhaliṅge svayambhuvi /
pratimāsu ca sarvāsu na caṇḍo 'dhikṛto bhavet //
97.d:
वाणलिङ्गे वाणरोहे(6) सिद्धलिङ्गे स्वयम्भुवि /
प्रतिमासु च सर्वासु न चण्डो ऽधिकृतो भवेत् //
97.m: In a bāṇaliṅga, an elevated bāṇaliṅga, a siddhaliṅga, a self-manifested one, / and in all images, Caṇḍa has no authority.

97.s:
advaitabhāvanāyukte sthaṇḍileśavidhāvapi(7) /
abhyarcya caṇḍaṃ sasutaṃ yajamānaṃ hi bhāryayā //
97.d:
अद्वैतभावनायुक्ते स्थण्डिलेशविधावपि(7) /
अभ्यर्च्य चण्डं ससुतं यजमानं हि भार्यया //
97.m: Even in the rite of the Lord of the altar accompanied by non-dual contemplation, / having worshipped Caṇḍa, the patron indeed with his wife and son

97.s:
pūrvasthāpitakumbhe na snāpayet snāpakaḥ(8) svayaṃ /
sthāpakaṃ yajamānopi sampūjya ca(9) maheśavat(10) //
97.d:
पूर्वस्थापितकुम्भे न स्नापयेत् स्नापकः(8) स्वयं /
स्थापकं यजमानोपि सम्पूज्य च(9) महेशवत्(10) //
97.m: the bather himself should bathe with the pitcher previously set up. / The patron also, having worshipped the master of ceremonies like the Great Lord,

97.s:
vittaśāṭhyaṃ vinā dadyād bhūhiraṇyādi(11) dakṣiṇāṃ /
:n
1 oṃ sadyojātāya hūṃ phaṭ iti jha.. / evaṃ sadyojātāya oṃ hrūṃ
phaṭ nama iti kha.. , cha.. ca / oṃ evaṃ sadyo jātāya hūṃ phaṭ nama iti
ga.. , ja.. ca
2 oṃ vaṃ iti jha..
3 oṃ evaṃ ceti cha.. / oṃ evaṃ cediti ṅa.. / oṃ vai iti ja..
4 dhūpaṃ nivedya iti gha..
5 kṛtamajñānatopi vā iti ga..
6 bāṇaliṅge cale lohe iti ja..
7 sthaṇḍile sannidhāvapi iti ja.. , jha.. ca
8 sthāpaka iti ja..
9 prapūjya ca iti ja..
10 maheśvaramiti kha.. , cha.. ca
11 gohiraṇyādi iti ja.. , jha.. ca
:p 335
mūrtimān vidhivat paścāt jāpakān brāhmaṇāṃs tathā //
97.d:
वित्तशाठ्यं विना दद्याद् भूहिरण्यादि(11) दक्षिणां /
:न्
1 ओं सद्योजाताय हूं फट् इति झ.. / एवं सद्योजाताय ओं ह्रूं
फट् नम इति ख.. , छ.. च / ओं एवं सद्यो जाताय हूं फट् नम इति
ग.. , ज.. च
2 ओं वं इति झ..
3 ओं एवं चेति छ.. / ओं एवं चेदिति ङ.. / ओं वै इति ज..
4 धूपं निवेद्य इति घ..
5 कृतमज्ञानतोपि वा इति ग..
6 बाणलिङ्गे चले लोहे इति ज..
7 स्थण्डिले सन्निधावपि इति ज.. , झ.. च
8 स्थापक इति ज..
9 प्रपूज्य च इति ज..
10 महेश्वरमिति ख.. , छ.. च
11 गोहिरण्यादि इति ज.. , झ.. च
:प् 335
मूर्तिमान् विधिवत् पश्चात् जापकान् ब्राह्मणांस् तथा //
97.m:
should give sacrificial fees such as land and gold without deceit in wealth.
:n
1 'oṃ sadyojātāya hūṃ phaṭ' in manuscript jha.. / 'evaṃ sadyojātāya oṃ hrūṃ phaṭ namaḥ' in manuscripts kha.. and cha.. / 'oṃ evaṃ sadyo jātāya hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ' in manuscripts ga.. and ja..
2 'oṃ vaṃ' in manuscript jha..
3 'oṃ evaṃ ca' in manuscript cha.. / 'oṃ evaṃ cet' in manuscript ṅa.. / 'oṃ vai' in manuscript ja..
4 'having offered incense' in manuscript gha..
5 'done even out of ignorance' in manuscript ga..
6 'in a bāṇaliṅga, a movable one, a metal one' in manuscript ja..
7 'on the altar, even in proximity' in manuscripts ja.. and jha..
8 'the master of ceremonies' in manuscript ja..
9 'and having reverenced' in manuscript ja..
10 'the Great Lord' in manuscripts kha.. and cha..
11 'cattle, gold, and so forth' in manuscripts ja.. and jha..
:p 335
Then, properly, [the patron should honor] the priest in bodily form, as well as the reciting Brahmins.

97.s:
devajñaṃ śilpinaṃ prārcya dīnānāthādi(1) bhojayet /
yadatra sammukhībhāve svedito bhagavanmayā //
97.d:
देवज्ञं शिल्पिनं प्रार्च्य दीनानाथादि(1) भोजयेत् /
यदत्र सम्मुखीभावे स्वेदितो भगवन्मया //
97.m: Having honored the astrologer and the artisan, he should feed the poor, the helpless, and others: / 'Whatever distress has been caused by me toward your presence here, O Lord,

97.s:
kṣamasva nātha tat sarvaṃ kāruṇyāmbunidhaṃ mama(2) /
iti vijñaptiyuktāya yajamānāya sadguruḥ //
97.d:
क्षमस्व नाथ तत् सर्वं कारुण्याम्बुनिधं मम(2) /
इति विज्ञप्तियुक्ताय यजमानाय सद्गुरुः //
97.m: forgive all that, O ocean of compassion, toward me!' / To the patron who has made this petition, the true guru,

97.s:
pratiṣṭhāpuṇyasadbhāvaṃ(3) sphurattārakasaprabhaṃ(4) /
kuśapuṣpākṣatopetaṃ svakareṇa samarpayet //
97.d:
प्रतिष्ठापुण्यसद्भावं(3) स्फुरत्तारकसप्रभं(4) /
कुशपुष्पाक्षतोपेतं स्वकरेण समर्पयेत् //
97.m: accompanied by kuśa grass, flowers, and unbroken grains, glowing with the radiance of flashing stars, / should bestow with his own hand the reality of the merit of consecration.

97.s:
tataḥ pāśapatopetaṃ(5) praṇamya parameśvaraṃ /
tato 'pi balibhirbhūtān sannidhāya nibodhayet //
97.d:
ततः पाशपतोपेतं(5) प्रणम्य परमेश्वरं /
ततो ऽपि बलिभिर्भूतान् सन्निधाय निबोधयेत् //
97.m: Then, having bowed to the Supreme Lord together with His retinue, / he should next address the beings, having brought them close with bali offerings:

97.s:
sthātavyaṃ bhavatā tāvad yāvat sannihito haraḥ(6) /
gururvastrādisaṃyuktaṃ gṛhṇīyādyāgamaṇḍapaṃ //
97.d:
स्थातव्यं भवता तावद् यावत् सन्निहितो हरः(6) /
गुरुर्वस्त्रादिसंयुक्तं गृह्णीयाद्यागमण्डपं //
97.m: 'You must remain as long as Hara is present!' / The guru should take the sacrificial pavilion together with the garments and the like,

97.s:
sarvopakaraṇaṃ śilpī tathā snāpanamaṇḍapaṃ(7) /
anye devādayaḥ sthāpyā mantrair āgamasambhavaiḥ //
97.d:
सर्वोपकरणं शिल्पी तथा स्नापनमण्डपं(7) /
अन्ये देवादयः स्थाप्या मन्त्रैर् आगमसम्भवैः //
97.m: and the artisan all the equipment and the bathing pavilion. / Other deities and beings are to be installed with mantras born of the Agamas,

97.s:
ādivarṇasya bhedādvā(8) sutattvavyāptibhāvitāḥ(9) /
sādhya(10) pramukhadevāś ca saridoṣadhayas tathā //
97.d:
आदिवर्णस्य भेदाद्वा(8) सुतत्त्वव्याप्तिभाविताः(9) /
साध्य(10) प्रमुखदेवाश् च सरिदोषधयस् तथा //
97.m: or through the division of the primary syllable, conceived as pervaded by the true principles. / The deities headed by the Sādhyas, as well as the rivers and herbs,

97.s:
kṣetrapāḥ kinnarādyāś ca pṛthivītattvamāśritāḥ /
:n
1 dīnānāthāṃśceti ja..
2 deva tvaṃ nātha tat sarvaṃ kāruṇyān manave nama iti jha..
3 pratiṣṭhāyajñasambhāramiti ga..
4 sphurattārakasannibhamiti
5 tataḥ paśupatiṃ japtvā iti kha.. , ga.. ca
6 bhava iti kha.. , gha.. ca
7 gururvastrāṇītyādiḥ, snānamaṇḍapamityantaḥ pāṭho jha..
pustake nāsti
8 ādivarṇasya śeṣādvā iti jha..
9 svātantryā vyāptirīritā iti ga.. / svatattvavyāptibhāvitā iti cha.. /
svatantravyāptibhedata iti ja..
10 jāpya iti jha..
:p 336
snānaṃ sarasvatīlakṣmīnadīnāmambhasi kvacit //
97.d:
क्षेत्रपाः किन्नराद्याश् च पृथिवीतत्त्वमाश्रिताः /
:न्
1 दीनानाथांश्चेति ज..
2 देव त्वं नाथ तत् सर्वं कारुण्यान् मनवे नम इति झ..
3 प्रतिष्ठायज्ञसम्भारमिति ग..
4 स्फुरत्तारकसन्निभमिति
5 ततः पशुपतिं जप्त्वा इति ख.. , ग.. च
6 भव इति ख.. , घ.. च
7 गुरुर्वस्त्राणीत्यादिः, स्नानमण्डपमित्यन्तः पाठो झ..
पुस्तके नास्ति
8 आदिवर्णस्य शेषाद्वा इति झ..
9 स्वातन्त्र्या व्याप्तिरीरिता इति ग.. / स्वतत्त्वव्याप्तिभाविता इति छ.. /
स्वतन्त्रव्याप्तिभेदत इति ज..
10 जाप्य इति झ..
:प् 336
स्नानं सरस्वतीलक्ष्मीनदीनामम्भसि क्वचित् //
97.m:
the guardians of the fields, Kinnaras, and others, abide in the principle of earth.
[Notes]
1. "dīnānāthāṃś ca" in MS ja.
2. "deva tvaṃ nātha tat sarvaṃ kāruṇyān manave namaḥ" in MS jha.
3. "pratiṣṭhāyajñasambhāram" in MS ga.
4. "sphurattārakasannibham"
5. "tataḥ paśupatiṃ japtvā" in MSS kha. and ga.
6. "bhava" in MSS kha. and gha.
7. The passage beginning "gurur vastrāṇi" and ending with "snānamaṇḍapam" is missing in MS jha.
8. "ādivarṇasya śeṣādvā" in MS jha.
9. "svātantryā vyāptir īritā" in MS ga.; "svatattvavyāptibhāvitāḥ" in MS cha.;
"svatantravyāptibhedataḥ" in MS ja.
10. "jāpyaḥ" in MS jha. [Page 336]
A bath in the water of the Sarasvatī or the Lakṣmī river, somewhere.

97.s:
bhuvanādhipatīnāñca sthānaṃ yatra vyavasthitiḥ /
aṇḍavṛddhipradhānāntaṃ tritattvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ padaṃ //
97.d:
भुवनाधिपतीनाञ्च स्थानं यत्र व्यवस्थितिः /
अण्डवृद्धिप्रधानान्तं त्रितत्त्वं ब्रह्मणः पदं //
97.m: And the realm of the lords of the worlds, wherever their location is: / The triad of principles, ending with the expansion of the cosmic egg up to Pradhāna, is the realm of Brahmā.

97.s:
tanmātrādipradhānāntaṃ(1) padametat trikaṃ hareḥ(2) /
nāṭyeśagaṇamātṝṇāṃ yakṣeśaśarajanmanāṃ //
97.d:
तन्मात्रादिप्रधानान्तं(1) पदमेतत् त्रिकं हरेः(2) /
नाट्येशगणमातॄणां यक्षेशशरजन्मनां //
97.m: This triad of realms, from the subtle elements up to Pradhāna, belongs to Hari; / [and also] of the lord of dance, the Gaṇas, the Mothers, the lord of the Yakṣas, and the reed-born [Skanda].

97.s:
aṇḍajāḥ śuddhavidyāntaṃ padaṃ gaṇapates tathā /
māyāṃśadeśaśaktyanataṃ śivā śivoptarociṣāṃ(3) //
97.d:
अण्डजाः शुद्धविद्यान्तं पदं गणपतेस् तथा /
मायांशदेशशक्त्यनतं शिवा शिवोप्तरोचिषां(3) //
97.m: The egg-born [principles] up to Pure Knowledge are the realm of Gaṇapati; / ending with the region of Māyā's parts and Śakti, [it belongs to] Śivā and the radiances of Śiva.

97.s:
padamīśvaraparyantaṃ vyaktārcāsu ca kīrtitaṃ /
kūrmādyaṃ kīrtitaṃ yacca yacca ratnādipañcakaṃ(4) //
97.d:
पदमीश्वरपर्यन्तं व्यक्तार्चासु च कीर्तितं /
कूर्माद्यं कीर्तितं यच्च यच्च रत्नादिपञ्चकं(4) //
97.m: The realm up to Īśvara is declared [applicable] in the case of manifest icons; / and that which begins with the tortoise, and the group of five [deposits] beginning with jewels:

97.s:
pratikṣipet pīṭhagarte ca pañcabrahmaśilāṃ vinā /
ṣaḍbhirvibhājite garte(5) tyaktvā bhāvañca pṛṣṭhataḥ //
97.d:
प्रतिक्षिपेत् पीठगर्ते च पञ्चब्रह्मशिलां विना /
षड्भिर्विभाजिते गर्ते(5) त्यक्त्वा भावञ्च पृष्ठतः //
97.m: One should deposit them into the cavity of the pedestal, except the five-Brahma stone. / When the cavity is divided into six parts, leaving aside the portion behind,

97.s:
sthāpanaṃ pañcamāṃśe ca yadi vā vasubhājite /
sthāpanaṃ saptame bhāge pratimāsu sukhāvahaṃ //
97.d:
स्थापनं पञ्चमांशे च यदि वा वसुभाजिते /
स्थापनं सप्तमे भागे प्रतिमासु सुखावहं //
97.m: the installation should be in the fifth part; or if divided into eight parts, / the installation in the seventh part brings happiness in the case of images.

97.s:
dhāraṇābhirviśuddhiḥ syāt sthāpane lepacitrayoḥ /
snānādi mānasantatra śilāratnādiveśanaṃ(6) //
97.d:
धारणाभिर्विशुद्धिः स्यात् स्थापने लेपचित्रयोः /
स्नानादि मानसन्तत्र शिलारत्नादिवेशनं(6) //
97.m: Purification occurs through mental retentions in the installation of clay and painted icons; / bathing and the like are mental there, [as is] the placement of the stone, jewels, and so forth.

97.s:
netrodghāṭanamantreṣṭamāsanādiprakalpanaṃ /
pūjā nirambubhiḥ puṣpair yathā citraṃ na duṣyati //
97.d:
नेत्रोद्घाटनमन्त्रेष्टमासनादिप्रकल्पनं /
पूजा निरम्बुभिः पुष्पैर् यथा चित्रं न दुष्यति //
97.m: The opening of the eyes is performed with mantras, as is the arrangement of the seat and so on; / worship is done with dry flowers, so that the painting is not ruined.

97.s:
vidhistu calaliṅgeṣu sampratyeva nigadyate /
:n
1 tanmātrādiprayāṇāntamiti kha..
2 tattvamekaṃ citraṃ hareriti gha..
3 snānaṃ sarasvatītyādiḥ, rociṣāmityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake
nāsti
4 yadratnādikapañcakamiti ja..
5 ṣaḍabhirbhājite garbhe iti ṅa..
6 śilāvāhādiveśanaṃ iti jha.. / śilāratnaniveśanamiti kha..
:p 337
pañcabhirvā tribhirvāpi pṛthak kuryād(1) vibhājite(2) //
97.d:
विधिस्तु चललिङ्गेषु सम्प्रत्येव निगद्यते /
:न्
1 तन्मात्रादिप्रयाणान्तमिति ख..
2 तत्त्वमेकं चित्रं हरेरिति घ..
3 स्नानं सरस्वतीत्यादिः, रोचिषामित्यन्तः पाठो झ.. पुस्तके
नास्ति
4 यद्रत्नादिकपञ्चकमिति ज..
5 षडभिर्भाजिते गर्भे इति ङ..
6 शिलावाहादिवेशनं इति झ.. / शिलारत्ननिवेशनमिति ख..
:प् 337
पञ्चभिर्वा त्रिभिर्वापि पृथक् कुर्याद्(1) विभाजिते(2) //
97.m:
The rule for movable liṅgas is now spoken of:
[Notes]
1. "tanmātrādiprayāṇāntam" in MS kha.
2. "tattvam ekaṃ citraṃ hareḥ" in MS gha.
3. The passage beginning "snānaṃ sarasvatī" and ending with "rociṣām" is missing in MS jha.
4. "yad ratnādikapañcakam" in MS ja.
5. "ṣaḍbhir bhājite garbhe" in MS ṅa.
6. "śilāvāhādiveśanam" in MS jha.; "śilāratnaniveśanam" in MS kha. [Page 337]
when divided into five or into three parts, one should make [the divisions] separately.

97.s:
bhagatrayeṇa bhāgāṃśo bhavedbhāgadvayena vā /
svapīṭheṣvapi(3) tadvat syālliṅgeṣu tattvabhedataḥ //
97.d:
भगत्रयेण भागांशो भवेद्भागद्वयेन वा /
स्वपीठेष्वपि(3) तद्वत् स्याल्लिङ्गेषु तत्त्वभेदतः //
97.m: The proportion of the portion should be three shares, or two shares; / on their own pedestals it should likewise be, according to the distinction of principles in the liṅgas.

97.s:
sṛṣṭimantreṇa saṃskāro vidhivat sphāṭikādiṣu /
kiñca brahmaśilāratnaprabhūteścānivedanaṃ(4) //
97.d:
सृष्टिमन्त्रेण संस्कारो विधिवत् स्फाटिकादिषु /
किञ्च ब्रह्मशिलारत्नप्रभूतेश्चानिवेदनं(4) //
97.m: The ritual consecration of [liṅgas of] crystal and the like should be performed according to rule with the creation mantra; / moreover, the offering of the Brahmā-stone, jewels, and plenty [of gifts should be done].

97.s:
yojanaṃ piṇḍikāyāś ca manasā parikalpayet /
svayambhūvāṇaliṅgādau(5) saṃskṛtau niyamo na hi //
97.d:
योजनं पिण्डिकायाश् च मनसा परिकल्पयेत् /
स्वयम्भूवाणलिङ्गादौ(5) संस्कृतौ नियमो न हि //
97.m: And one should mentally conceive the joining of the pedestal; / in the case of self-manifest and Bāṇaliṅgas, there is no strict rule for ritual preparation.

97.s:
snāpanaṃ saṃhitāmantrair nyāsaṃ homañca kārayet /
nadīsamudrarohāṇāṃ sthāpanaṃ pūrvavan mataṃ //
97.d:
स्नापनं संहितामन्त्रैर् न्यासं होमञ्च कारयेत् /
नदीसमुद्ररोहाणां स्थापनं पूर्ववन् मतं //
97.m: One should perform the bathing with Saṃhitā mantras, and the ritual deposition and fire oblation; / the installation of those originating from rivers and the ocean is held to be as before.

97.s:
aihikam mṛṇmayaṃ liṅgaṃ piṣṭakādi ca takṣaṇāt(6) /
kṛtvā sampūjayecchuddhaṃ sīkṣaṇādividhānataḥ(7) //
97.d:
ऐहिकम् मृण्मयं लिङ्गं पिष्टकादि च तक्षणात्(6) /
कृत्वा सम्पूजयेच्छुद्धं सीक्षणादिविधानतः(7) //
97.m: Having fashioned an earthly liṅga made of clay, dough, or the like immediately, / one should worship it purely according to the rites of viewing and initiation.

97.s:
samādāya tato mantrānātmānaṃ sannidhāya ca /
tajjale prakṣipelliṅgaṃ vatsarāt kāmadaṃ bhavet //
97.d:
समादाय ततो मन्त्रानात्मानं सन्निधाय च /
तज्जले प्रक्षिपेल्लिङ्गं वत्सरात् कामदं भवेत् //
97.m: Then, having gathered the mantras and invoked the Self into proximity, / one should cast that liṅga into water; after a year it will grant desires.

97.s:
viṣṇvādisthāpanaṃ caiva pṛyaṅmantraiḥ samācaret /
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe śivapratiṣṭhā(8) nāma saptanavatitamo
'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 pṛthak pīṭhe iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. ca
2 sthāpanamityādiḥ, kuryād vibhājite ity antaḥ pāṭho ṅa.pustake
nāsti
3 svapīṭhe snapite iti kha..
4 prabhūtepyadhiveśanamiti gha..
5 vāṇaliṅgānāmiti ja..
6 piṣṭakādi ca tatkramāditi cha.. , ja.. ca
7 mṛṣṭimantreṇetyādiḥ dīkṣaṇādividhānata ity antaḥ
pāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti
8 śivapūjā iti ka..
:p 338
:ś athāṣṭanavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
gaurīpratiṣṭhākathanaṃ
97.d:
विष्ण्वादिस्थापनं चैव पृयङ्मन्त्रैः समाचरेत् /
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे शिवप्रतिष्ठा(8) नाम सप्तनवतितमो
ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 पृथक् पीठे इति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. च
2 स्थापनमित्यादिः, कुर्याद् विभाजिते इत्य् अन्तः पाठो ङ.पुस्तके
नास्ति
3 स्वपीठे स्नपिते इति ख..
4 प्रभूतेप्यधिवेशनमिति घ..
5 वाणलिङ्गानामिति ज..
6 पिष्टकादि च तत्क्रमादिति छ.. , ज.. च
7 मृष्टिमन्त्रेणेत्यादिः दीक्षणादिविधानत इत्य् अन्तः
पाठो ग.. पुस्तके नास्ति
8 शिवपूजा इति क..
:प् 338
:श् अथाष्टनवतितमो ऽध्यायः ||
गौरीप्रतिष्ठाकथनं
97.m:
And one should perform the installation of Viṣṇu and others with individual mantras.
Thus ends the ninety-seventh chapter, named "The Consecration of Śiva", in the Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
[Notes]
1. "pṛthak pīṭhe" in MSS kha., ga., and gha.
2. The passage beginning "sthāpanam" and ending with "kuryād vibhājite" is missing in MS ṅa.
3. "svapīṭhe snapite" in MS kha.
4. "prabhūte 'py adhiveśanam" in MS gha.
5. "vāṇaliṅgānām" in MS ja.
6. "piṣṭakādi ca tatkramāt" in MSS cha. and ja.
7. The passage beginning "mṛṣṭimantreṇa" and ending with "dīkṣaṇādividhānataḥ" is missing in MS ga.
8. "śivapūjā" in MS ka. [Page 338]
Now the ninety-eighth chapter:
The Exposition of the Consecration of Gaurī

98.s:
īśvara uvāca
vakṣye gaurīpratiṣṭhāñca pūjayā sahitāṃ śṛṇu /
maṇḍapādyaṃ puro yacca(1) saṃsthāpya cādhiropayet //
98.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
वक्ष्ये गौरीप्रतिष्ठाञ्च पूजया सहितां शृणु /
मण्डपाद्यं पुरो यच्च(1) संस्थाप्य चाधिरोपयेत् //
98.m: Īśvara said: / I shall declare the consecration of Gaurī together with her worship; listen. / Having set up the pavilion and other requisites previously, one should raise [her] onto [the couch].

98.s:
śayyāyāntāṃś ca vinyasya mantrānmūrtyādikān guha /
ātmavidyāśivāntañca(2) kuryādīśaniveśanaṃ //
98.d:
शय्यायान्तांश् च विन्यस्य मन्त्रान्मूर्त्यादिकान् गुह /
आत्मविद्याशिवान्तञ्च(2) कुर्यादीशनिवेशनं //
98.m: Having deposited those [deities] on the bed, and the mantras of the icon and so forth, O Guha, / one should perform the installation of the Lord, ending with the self, knowledge, and Śiva.

98.s:
śaktiṃ parāṃ tato(3) nyasya hutvā(4) japtvā ca pūrvavat /
sandhāya ca tathā piṇḍīṃ(5) kriyāśaktisvarūpiṇīṃ //
98.d:
शक्तिं परां ततो(3) न्यस्य हुत्वा(4) जप्त्वा च पूर्ववत् /
सन्धाय च तथा पिण्डीं(5) क्रियाशक्तिस्वरूपिणीं //
98.m: Then, having deposited the supreme Śakti, and having offered fire oblations and recited [mantras] as before, / and having joined the pedestal, which embodies the Śakti of action,

98.s:
sadeśavyāpikāṃ dhyātvā nyastaratnādikāṃ tathā /
evaṃ saṃsthāpya tāṃ paścāddevīntasyānniyojayet //
98.d:
सदेशव्यापिकां ध्यात्वा न्यस्तरत्नादिकां तथा /
एवं संस्थाप्य तां पश्चाद्देवीन्तस्यान्नियोजयेत् //
98.m: meditating on it as pervading the region, and having deposited the jewels and other items likewise, / having thus established it, one should subsequently install the Goddess upon it:

98.s:
paraśaktisvarūpāntāṃ svāṇunā(6) śaktiyogataḥ /
tato nyaset kriyāśaktiṃ pīṭhe jñānañca vigrahe //
98.d:
परशक्तिस्वरूपान्तां स्वाणुना(6) शक्तियोगतः /
ततो न्यसेत् क्रियाशक्तिं पीठे ज्ञानञ्च विग्रहे //
98.m: her who embodies the supreme Śakti, with her own mantra through the union of Śakti; / then one should deposit the Śakti of action on the pedestal, and knowledge upon the body.

98.s:
tatopi vyāpinīṃ śaktiṃ samāvāhya niyojayet /
ambikāṃ śivanāmnīñca samālabhya(7) prapūjayet //
oṃ ādhāraśaktaye namaḥ / oṃ kūrmāya namaḥ / oṃ skandāya ca
tathā namaḥ / oṃ hrīṃ nārāyaṇāya namaḥ / oṃ aiśvaryāya
namaḥ
:n
1 maṇḍapādyaṃ praviśecca iti ga..
2 śivāstraṃ ceti gha..
3 tathā śaktiṃ parāmiti kha..
4 stutveti ja..
5 caṇḍīmiti kha..
6 ātmaneti cha..
7 tryambakeśīti nāmnīñca samārabhyeti ja..
:p 339
98.d:
ततोपि व्यापिनीं शक्तिं समावाह्य नियोजयेत् /
अम्बिकां शिवनाम्नीञ्च समालभ्य(7) प्रपूजयेत् //
ओं आधारशक्तये नमः / ओं कूर्माय नमः / ओं स्कन्दाय च
तथा नमः / ओं ह्रीं नारायणाय नमः / ओं ऐश्वर्याय
नमः
:न्
1 मण्डपाद्यं प्रविशेच्च इति ग..
2 शिवास्त्रं चेति घ..
3 तथा शक्तिं परामिति ख..
4 स्तुत्वेति ज..
5 चण्डीमिति ख..
6 आत्मनेति छ..
7 त्र्यम्बकेशीति नाम्नीञ्च समारभ्येति ज..
:प् 339
98.m:
From there, having invoked the all-pervading Śakti, one should unite it; / having anointed Ambikā, bearing the name of Śiva, one should worship her:
"Oṃ, homage to the Support-Power! Oṃ, homage to the Tortoise! Oṃ, likewise homage to Skanda! Oṃ hrīṃ, homage to Nārāyaṇa! Oṃ, homage to Sovereignty!"
[Gap in text]
1. "One should enter the pavilion and so forth" in manuscript ga.
2. "And the weapon of Śiva" in manuscript gha.
3 "Likewise the supreme Śakti" according to manuscript Kha.
4 "Having praised" according to manuscript Ja.
5 "Caṇḍī" according to manuscript Kha.
6 "By the self" according to manuscript Cha.
7 "The name Tryambakeśī and having begun" according to manuscript Ja.

98.s:
oṃ aṃ adhaśchadanāya namaḥ / oṃ padmāsanāya namaḥ / oṃ
ūrdhvacchadanāya namaḥ / oṃ padmāsanāya namaḥ / atha
sampūjyāḥ keśavās tathā / oṃ hrīṃ karṇikāya namaḥ / oṃ
kṣaṃ puṣkarākṣebhya(1) ihārcayet / oṃ hāṃ puṣṭyai hrīṃ
ca jñānāyai hrūṃ kriyāyai tato namaḥ / oṃ nālāya namaḥ / ruṃ
dharmāya namaḥ(2) / ruṃ jñānāya vai namaḥ(3) / oṃ vairāgyāya
vai namaḥ / oṃ vai adharmāya namaḥ(4) / oṃ ruṃ ajñānāya vai
namaḥ / oṃ avairāgyāya vai namaḥ / aṃ anaiśvaryāya namaḥ /
98.d:
ओं अं अधश्छदनाय नमः / ओं पद्मासनाय नमः / ओं
ऊर्ध्वच्छदनाय नमः / ओं पद्मासनाय नमः / अथ
सम्पूज्याः केशवास् तथा / ओं ह्रीं कर्णिकाय नमः / ओं
क्षं पुष्कराक्षेभ्य(1) इहार्चयेत् / ओं हां पुष्ट्यै ह्रीं
च ज्ञानायै ह्रूं क्रियायै ततो नमः / ओं नालाय नमः / रुं
धर्माय नमः(2) / रुं ज्ञानाय वै नमः(3) / ओं वैराग्याय
वै नमः / ओं वै अधर्माय नमः(4) / ओं रुं अज्ञानाय वै
नमः / ओं अवैराग्याय वै नमः / अं अनैश्वर्याय नमः /
98.m:
"Oṃ aṃ, reverence to the lower covering. Oṃ, reverence to the lotus seat. Oṃ, reverence to the upper covering. Oṃ, reverence to the lotus seat." Then the Keśavas are likewise to be worshipped: "Oṃ hrīṃ, reverence to the pericarp. Oṃ kṣaṃ, to the lotus-eyed ones"—here he should worship. "Oṃ hāṃ, reverence to Puṣṭi; hrīṃ, to Jñānā; hrūṃ, to Kriyā." Then, "Reverence: oṃ, reverence to the stalk. Ruṃ, reverence to Dharma. Ruṃ, indeed reverence to Jñāna. Oṃ, indeed reverence to Vairāgya. Oṃ, indeed reverence to Adharma. Oṃ ruṃ, indeed reverence to Ajñāna.
Reverence: oṃ, indeed reverence to Avairāgya. Aṃ, reverence to Anaiśvarya."

98.s:
huṃ vāce huṃ ca rāgiṇyai kraiṃ jvālinyai tato namaḥ / oṃ hrauṃ
śamāyai(5) ca namaḥ / hruṃ jyeṣṭhāyai tato namaḥ / oṃ hrauṃ
rauṃ krauṃ navaśaktyai gauṃ ca gauryāsanāya ca / gauṃ
gaurīmūrtaye namaḥ / gauryā mūlamathocyate / oṃ hrīṃ saḥ(6)
mahāgauri rudradayite svāhā / gauryai namaḥ / gāṃ hrūṃ hrīṃ
śivo gūṃ syāt śivāyai kavacāya ca / goṃ netrāya ca goṃ astrāya oṃ
gauṃ vijñānaśaktaye, oṃ gūṃ kriyāśaktaye namaḥ(7) / pūrvādau
śākrādikān / oṃ suṃ subhāgāyai namaḥ / hrīṃ vījalalitā
tataḥ / oṃ hrīṃ kāminyai ca namaḥ / oṃ hrūṃ syāt
kāmaśālinīmantrair gaurīṃ pratiṣṭhāpya prārcya japtvātha
sarvabhāk(8) ||
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe gaurīpratiṣṭhā nāmāṣṭanavatitamo
'dhyāyaḥ
:n
1 oṃ khaṃ puṣkarebhya iti kha..
2 dhaṃ dharmāya nama iti kha..
3 vaṃ jñānāya nama iti kha..
4 ruṃ adharmāya nama iti ṅa..
98.d:
हुं वाचे हुं च रागिण्यै क्रैं ज्वालिन्यै ततो नमः / ओं ह्रौं
शमायै(5) च नमः / ह्रुं ज्येष्ठायै ततो नमः / ओं ह्रौं
रौं क्रौं नवशक्त्यै गौं च गौर्यासनाय च / गौं
गौरीमूर्तये नमः / गौर्या मूलमथोच्यते / ओं ह्रीं सः(6)
महागौरि रुद्रदयिते स्वाहा / गौर्यै नमः / गां ह्रूं ह्रीं
शिवो गूं स्यात् शिवायै कवचाय च / गों नेत्राय च गों अस्त्राय ओं
गौं विज्ञानशक्तये, ओं गूं क्रियाशक्तये नमः(7) / पूर्वादौ
शाक्रादिकान् / ओं सुं सुभागायै नमः / ह्रीं वीजललिता
ततः / ओं ह्रीं कामिन्यै च नमः / ओं ह्रूं स्यात्
कामशालिनीमन्त्रैर् गौरीं प्रतिष्ठाप्य प्रार्च्य जप्त्वाथ
सर्वभाक्(8) ||
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे गौरीप्रतिष्ठा नामाष्टनवतितमो
ऽध्यायः
:न्
1 ओं खं पुष्करेभ्य इति ख..
2 धं धर्माय नम इति ख..
3 वं ज्ञानाय नम इति ख..
4 रुं अधर्माय नम इति ङ..
98.m:
"Huṃ, to Vāc; huṃ, and to Rāgiṇī; kraiṃ, to Jvālinī." Then, "Reverence: oṃ hrauṃ, and reverence to Śamā; hruṃ, then reverence to Jyeṣṭhā. Oṃ hrauṃ rauṃ krauṃ, to the nine Śaktis; gauṃ, and to the seat of Gaurī; gauṃ, reverence to the icon of Gaurī." Now the root mantra of Gaurī is stated: "Oṃ hrīṃ saḥ, O Mahāgaurī, beloved of Rudra, svāhā; reverence to Gaurī. Gāṃ hrūṃ hrīṃ, let Śiva be gūṃ, to Śivā, to the armor; goṃ, to the eye; goṃ, to the weapon; oṃ gauṃ, to Vijñānaśakti; oṃ gūṃ, reverence to Kriyāśakti." In the east and other [quarters], the regents led by Śakra: "Oṃ suṃ, reverence to Subhagā"; then, the seed-syllable hrīṃ with Lalitā; "Oṃ hrīṃ, and reverence to Kāminī; oṃ hrūṃ, Kāmaśālinī." Having consecrated Gaurī with these mantras, having worshipped, and then having recited, one enjoys all.
Thus in the Mahāpurāṇa of Agni, the ninety-eighth chapter, entitled "The Consecration of Gaurī."
Footnotes:
1 "Oṃ khaṃ puṣkarebhyaḥ" according to manuscript Kha.
2 "Dhaṃ dharmāya namaḥ" according to manuscript Kha.
3 "Vaṃ jñānāya namaḥ" according to manuscript Kha.
4 "Ruṃ adharmāya namaḥ" according to manuscript Ṅa.

98.s:
5 vāmāyai iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca
6 oṃ hūṃ sa iti gha..
7 hrīṃ kriyāśaktaye nama iti jha.. / oṃ kriyāśaktaye nama iti gha..
8 japtvānurūpataḥ iti ga.. , cha.. , ca
:p 340
:ś athonaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
sūryapratiṣṭhākathanaṃ
98.d:
5 वामायै इति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. च
6 ओं हूं स इति घ..
7 ह्रीं क्रियाशक्तये नम इति झ.. / ओं क्रियाशक्तये नम इति घ..
8 जप्त्वानुरूपतः इति ग.. , छ.. , च
:प् 340
:श् अथोनशततमो ऽध्यायः
सूर्यप्रतिष्ठाकथनं
98.m:
5 "Vāmāyai" according to manuscripts Kha, Ga, Gha, and Ṅa.
6 "Oṃ hūṃ saḥ" according to manuscript Gha.
7 "Hrīṃ kriyāśaktaye namaḥ" according to manuscript Jha; "Oṃ kriyāśaktaye namaḥ" according to manuscript Gha.
8 "Japtvānurūpataḥ" according to manuscripts Ga, Cha, and Ca.
Now the ninety-ninth chapter.
Instruction on the consecration of Sūrya.

99.s:
īśvara uvāca
vakṣye sūryapratiṣṭhāñca pūrvavanmaṇḍapādikaṃ /
snānādikañca samyādya(1) pūrvoktavidhinā tataḥ //
99.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
वक्ष्ये सूर्यप्रतिष्ठाञ्च पूर्ववन्मण्डपादिकं /
स्नानादिकञ्च सम्याद्य(1) पूर्वोक्तविधिना ततः //
99.m:
The Lord said:
I shall speak also of the consecration of Sūrya, the pavilion and so forth as before, / and then the bath and the rest, having completed [them] according to the aforementioned rule.

99.s:
vidyāmāsanaśayyāyāṃ sāṅgaṃ vinyasya bhāskaraṃ /
tritattvaṃ vinyasettatra sasvaraṃ khādipañcakaṃ //
99.d:
विद्यामासनशय्यायां साङ्गं विन्यस्य भास्करं /
त्रितत्त्वं विन्यसेत्तत्र सस्वरं खादिपञ्चकं //
99.m: Having ritually deposited the Sun with his limbs upon the bed-seat of wisdom, / one should ritually deposit the three principles there, along with the group of five beginning with ether together with vowels.

99.s:
śuddhyādi pūrvavat kṛtvā piṇḍīṃ saṃśodhya pūrvavat /
sadeśapadaparyantaṃ vinyasya tattvapañcakaṃ(2) //
99.d:
शुद्ध्यादि पूर्ववत् कृत्वा पिण्डीं संशोध्य पूर्ववत् /
सदेशपदपर्यन्तं विन्यस्य तत्त्वपञ्चकं(2) //
99.m: Having performed purification and the rest as before, and having purified the pedestal as before, / having ritually deposited the five principles up to the level of the Sadāśiva plane,

99.s:
śaktyā ca sarvatomukhyā saṃsthāpya vidhivatataḥ /
svāṇunā(3) vidhivat sūryaṃ śaktyantaṃ(4) sthāpayedguruḥ //
99.d:
शक्त्या च सर्वतोमुख्या संस्थाप्य विधिवततः /
स्वाणुना(3) विधिवत् सूर्यं शक्त्यन्तं(4) स्थापयेद्गुरुः //
99.m: and having duly established it through the all-facing Śakti, / the guru should then duly establish the Sun by means of the stable [mantra], ending with Śakti.

99.s:
svāmyantamathavādityaṃ pādāntannāma dhārayet /
sūryamantrāstu(5) pūrvoktā draṣṭavyāḥ sthāpanepi ca(6) //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe sūryapratiṣṭhā nāmaikonaśatatamo
'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 snānādikaṃ ca sampūjya iti kha.. , cha.. , ca
2 vinyasya padapañcakamiti cha.. / vinyasya ratnapañcakamiti ja..
3 ātmaneti cha..
4 śaktyarthamiti ṅa..
5 sūryamantrāśceti cha..
6 sthāpanepi veti ja..
:p 341
:ś atha śatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
dvārapratiṣṭhākathanaṃ
99.d:
स्वाम्यन्तमथवादित्यं पादान्तन्नाम धारयेत् /
सूर्यमन्त्रास्तु(5) पूर्वोक्ता द्रष्टव्याः स्थापनेपि च(6) //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे सूर्यप्रतिष्ठा नामैकोनशततमो
ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 स्नानादिकं च सम्पूज्य इति ख.. , छ.. , च
2 विन्यस्य पदपञ्चकमिति छ.. / विन्यस्य रत्नपञ्चकमिति ज..
3 आत्मनेति छ..
4 शक्त्यर्थमिति ङ..
5 सूर्यमन्त्राश्चेति छ..
6 स्थापनेपि वेति ज..
:प् 341
:श् अथ शततमो ऽध्यायः
द्वारप्रतिष्ठाकथनं
99.m:
Or else he should confer a name on the Sun ending in "svāmin" or ending in "pāda"; / and the previously stated mantras of Sūrya are to be regarded as valid in the installation too.
Thus in the Mahāpurāṇa of Agni, the ninety-ninth chapter, entitled "The Consecration of Sūrya."
Footnotes:
1 "Snānādikaṃ ca sampūjya" according to manuscripts Kha, Cha, and Ca.
2 "Vinyasya padapañcakam" according to manuscript Cha; "vinyasya ratnapañcakam" according to manuscript Ja.
3 "Ātmanā" according to manuscript Cha.
4 "Śaktyartham" according to manuscript Ṅa.
5 "Sūryamantrāśca" according to manuscript Cha.
6 "Sthāpanepi vā" according to manuscript Ja.
Now the one-hundredth chapter.
Instruction on the consecration of the doorway.

100.s:
īśvara uvāca
dvārāśritapratiṣṭhāyā vakṣyāmi vidhimapyatha /
dvārāṅgāni kaṣāyādyaiḥ saṃskṛtya śayane nyaset //
100.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
द्वाराश्रितप्रतिष्ठाया वक्ष्यामि विधिमप्यथ /
द्वाराङ्गानि कषायाद्यैः संस्कृत्य शयने न्यसेत् //
100.m:
The Lord said:
I shall now state the rule for the consecration of what pertains to the doorway: / having purified the components of the doorway with astringent [decoctions] and the like, one should place them on the bed.

100.s:
mūlamadhyāgrabhāgeṣu trayamātmādiseśvaraṃ /
vinyasya sanniveśyātha(1) hutvā japtvātra rūpataḥ(2) //
100.d:
मूलमध्याग्रभागेषु त्रयमात्मादिसेश्वरं /
विन्यस्य सन्निवेश्याथ(1) हुत्वा जप्त्वात्र रूपतः(2) //
100.m: In the base, middle, and top portions, having ritually deposited the triad beginning with the self and ending with the Lord, / and having positioned them, having offered fire oblation and recited here according to form,

100.s:
dvārādatho yajedvāstuntatraivānantamantritaḥ /
ratnādipañcakaṃ nyasya śāntihomaṃ vidhāya ca //
100.d:
द्वारादथो यजेद्वास्तुन्तत्रैवानन्तमन्त्रितः /
रत्नादिपञ्चकं न्यस्य शान्तिहोमं विधाय च //
100.m: the one who has chanted the mantra of Ananta should then worship the site deity below the doorway right there; / having ritually deposited the five gems and the like and having performed the pacifying fire oblation,
[making an amulet bundle] filled with barley, white mustard, ṛddhi, vṛddhi, large sesame seeds, / cow dung, red arsenic, king-like mustard seeds, mohanī, lakṣaṇā, amṛtā,

100.s:
rocanā rug vaco dūrvā prāsādadhaś ca poṭalīṃ /
prakṛtyodumbare baddhvā rakṣārthaṃ praṇavena tu //
100.d:
रोचना रुग् वचो दूर्वा प्रासादधश् च पोटलीं /
प्रकृत्योदुम्बरे बद्ध्वा रक्षार्थं प्रणवेन तु //
100.m: yellow pigment, rug, vacā, and dūrvā grass, and having made an amulet bundle underneath the temple, / having tied it to the threshold with the praṇava for the sake of protection,

100.s:
dvāramuttarataḥ kiñcidāśritaṃ sanniveśayet /
ātmatattvamadho nyasya vidyātattvañca śākhayoḥ //
100.d:
द्वारमुत्तरतः किञ्चिदाश्रितं सन्निवेशयेत् /
आत्मतत्त्वमधो न्यस्य विद्यातत्त्वञ्च शाखयोः //
100.m: one should erect the doorway leaning slightly toward the north, / having deposited the principle of the self below, and the principle of wisdom on the two doorposts,

100.s:
śivamakāśadeśe ca vyāpakaṃ sarvamaṅgale(3) /
tato maheśanāthaṃ ca vinyasenmūlamantrataḥ //
:n
1 vinyasya ca niveśayātha iti kha.. / vinyasya sannibodhyātheti ja..
2 ajaptvānurūpata iti ga..
3 sarvapuṣkalamiti kha.. , gha.. ca
:p 342
100.d:
शिवमकाशदेशे च व्यापकं सर्वमङ्गले(3) /
ततो महेशनाथं च विन्यसेन्मूलमन्त्रतः //
:न्
1 विन्यस्य च निवेशयाथ इति ख.. / विन्यस्य सन्निबोध्याथेति ज..
2 अजप्त्वानुरूपत इति ग..
3 सर्वपुष्कलमिति ख.. , घ.. च
:प् 342
100.m:
and Śiva in the space [above], all-pervasive in the lintel; / then one should ritually deposit the Great Lord by means of the root mantra.
Footnotes:
1 "Vinyasya ca niveśyātha" according to manuscript Kha; "vinyasya sannibodhyātha" according to manuscript Ja.
2 "Ajaptvānurūpataḥ" according to manuscript Ga.
3 "Sarvapuṣkalam" according to manuscripts Kha and Gha.

100.s:
dvārāśritāṃś ca talpādīn(1) kṛtayuktaiḥ(2) svanāmabhiḥ /
juhuyācchatamardhaṃ vā dviguṇaṃ śaktitothavā(3) //
100.d:
द्वाराश्रितांश् च तल्पादीन्(1) कृतयुक्तैः(2) स्वनामभिः /
जुहुयाच्छतमर्धं वा द्विगुणं शक्तितोथवा(3) //
100.m: For those dependent on the doorway, such as the pedestal, with their own names conjoined with "kṛta", / one should offer one hundred fire oblations, or fifty, or double that, according to capacity.

100.s:
nyūnādidoṣamoṣārthaṃ hetito juhuyāccchataṃ(4) /
digbalimpūrvavaddhutvā(5) pradadyāddakṣiṇādikaṃ //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe dvārapratiṣṭhā nāma śatatamo
'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athaikādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
prāsādapratiṣṭhā
100.d:
न्यूनादिदोषमोषार्थं हेतितो जुहुयाच्च्छतं(4) /
दिग्बलिम्पूर्ववद्धुत्वा(5) प्रदद्याद्दक्षिणादिकं //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे द्वारप्रतिष्ठा नाम शततमो
ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथैकाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
प्रासादप्रतिष्ठा
100.m:
For the removal of faults such as deficiency or excess, one should offer one hundred [oblations] with the weapon [mantra]; / having offered the directional tribute as before, he should bestow the sacrificial fee and the like.
Thus in the Mahāpurāṇa of Agni, the one-hundredth chapter, entitled "The Consecration of the Doorway."
Now the one hundred and first chapter.
Consecration of the temple.

101.s:
īavara uvāca
prāsādasthāpanaṃ vakṣye taccaitanyaṃ svayogataḥ(6) /
śukanāśāsamāptau tu pūrvavedyāś ca madhyataḥ //
101.d:
ईअवर उवाच
प्रासादस्थापनं वक्ष्ये तच्चैतन्यं स्वयोगतः(6) /
शुकनाशासमाप्तौ तु पूर्ववेद्याश् च मध्यतः //
101.m:
The Lord said:
I shall explain the consecration of the temple and its consciousness through its own yoga: / upon the completion of the antefix (śukanāśā) and in the middle of the eastern altar,

101.s:
ādhāraśaktitaḥ padme vinyaste praṇavena ca(7) /
svarṇādye katamoddbhataṃ pañcagavyena saṃyutaṃ //
101.d:
आधारशक्तितः पद्मे विन्यस्ते प्रणवेन च(7) /
स्वर्णाद्ये कतमोद्द्भतं पञ्चगव्येन संयुतं //
101.m: when the [energy of] support has been placed upon the lotus with the praṇava, / a pot made of gold or whatever material, filled with the five bovine products,

101.s:
madhukṣīrayutaṃ kumbhaṃ nyastaratrādipañcakaṃ(8) /
sragvastraṃ gandhaliptañca gandhavatpuṣpabhūṣitaṃ(9) //
101.d:
मधुक्षीरयुतं कुम्भं न्यस्तरत्रादिपञ्चकं(8) /
स्रग्वस्त्रं गन्धलिप्तञ्च गन्धवत्पुष्पभूषितं(9) //
101.m: accompanied by honey and milk, in which the five gems and the like are deposited, / draped with garlands and cloth, smeared with perfume, and adorned with fragrant flowers,

101.s:
cūtādipallavānāñca kṛtī kṛtyañca vinyaset(10) /
:n
1 nandyādīna iti kha..
2 kṛtyayuktair iti ja..
3 śaktito yathā iti ga..
4 bhāgatrayeṇetyādiḥ, juhuyācchatamityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake
nāsti / atra katipayaślokādhiko 'dhyāyatrayātmakaḥ pāṭhaḥ
patitosti
5 pūrvavad datvā iti ga.. , gha ca
6 taccaitanyañca yogata iti ga.. / taccaitanyasvayogata iti cha..
7 vinyaste praṇavena tu iti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. , jha.. ca / vinyaset praṇavena tu iti
ga..
8 madhukṣīrayutaṃ nyastaratnādipañcakaṃ tata iti ga..
9 gandhavatpuṣpadhūpitamiti ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca
10 vahnikṛta padmaṃ vinyasediti kha.. / vahnikūpaṃ yavaṃ nyasediti ga.. /
vahnikūpeṣu ca nyasediti ja..
:p 343
pūrakeṇa samādāya sakalīkṛtavigrahaḥ //
101.d:
चूतादिपल्लवानाञ्च कृती कृत्यञ्च विन्यसेत्(10) /
:न्
1 नन्द्यादीन इति ख..
2 कृत्ययुक्तैर् इति ज..
3 शक्तितो यथा इति ग..
4 भागत्रयेणेत्यादिः, जुहुयाच्छतमित्यन्तः पाठो झ.. पुस्तके
नास्ति / अत्र कतिपयश्लोकाधिको ऽध्यायत्रयात्मकः पाठः
पतितोस्ति
5 पूर्ववद् दत्वा इति ग.. , घ च
6 तच्चैतन्यञ्च योगत इति ग.. / तच्चैतन्यस्वयोगत इति छ..
7 विन्यस्ते प्रणवेन तु इति ख.. , छ.. , ज.. , झ.. च / विन्यसेत् प्रणवेन तु इति
ग..
8 मधुक्षीरयुतं न्यस्तरत्नादिपञ्चकं तत इति ग..
9 गन्धवत्पुष्पधूपितमिति ग.. , ङ.. , छ.. च
10 वह्निकृत पद्मं विन्यसेदिति ख.. / वह्निकूपं यवं न्यसेदिति ग.. /
वह्निकूपेषु च न्यसेदिति ज..
:प् 343
पूरकेण समादाय सकलीकृतविग्रहः //
101.m:
and decorated with sprouts of mango and the like, the skillful [priest] should deposit.
Footnotes:
1 "Nandyādīn" according to manuscript Kha.
[Variant reading note] 2 'kṛtyayuktaiḥ' in manuscript ja..
[Variant reading note] 3 'śaktito yathā' in manuscript ga..
[Variant reading note] 4 The text beginning with 'bhāgatrayeṇa' and ending with 'juhuyācchatam' is absent in manuscript jha.. Here, a reading consisting of three chapters plus several verses has fallen out.
[Variant reading note] 5 'pūrvavad datvā' in manuscripts ga.. and gha..
[Variant reading note] 6 'taccaitanyañca yogataḥ' in manuscript ga..; 'taccaitanyasvayogataḥ' in cha..
[Variant reading note] 7 'vinyaste praṇavena tu' in manuscripts kha.., cha.., ja.., and jha..; 'vinyaset praṇavena tu' in ga..
[Variant reading note] 8 'madhukṣīrayutaṃ nyastaratnādipañcakaṃ tataḥ' in manuscript ga..
[Variant reading note] 9 'gandhavatpuṣpadhūpitam' in manuscripts ga.., ṅa.., and cha..
[Variant reading note] 10 'vahnikṛta padmaṃ vinyased' in manuscript kha..; 'vahnikūpaṃ yavaṃ nyased' in ga..;
'vahnikūpeṣu ca nyased' in manuscript ja..
Having inhaled through the pūraka breath, his body fully ritualised,

101.s:
sarvātmabhinnātmānaṃ svāṇunā(1) svāntamārutaḥ /
ājñayā bodhayecchambhau(2) recakena tato guruḥ //
101.d:
सर्वात्मभिन्नात्मानं स्वाणुना(1) स्वान्तमारुतः /
आज्ञया बोधयेच्छम्भौ(2) रेचकेन ततो गुरुः //
101.m: his inner breath holding the soul distinct from the universal Soul with his own mantra, / the guru, through the recaka breath, should then awaken it in Śambhu by [Śambhu's] command.

101.s:
dvādaśāntāt(3) samādāya sphuradvahnikaṇopamaṃ /
nikṣipet kumbhagarbhe ca nyastatantrātivāhikaṃ(4) //
101.d:
द्वादशान्तात्(3) समादाय स्फुरद्वह्निकणोपमं /
निक्षिपेत् कुम्भगर्भे च न्यस्ततन्त्रातिवाहिकं(4) //
101.m: Drawing it from the dvādaśānta, resembling a flashing spark of fire, / he should deposit it within the jar, having laid down the subtle transmigrating body.

101.s:
vigrahantadguṇānāñca bodhakañca kalādikaṃ /
kṣāntaṃ vāgīśvaraṃ(5) tattu brātaṃ tatra niveśayet //
101.d:
विग्रहन्तद्गुणानाञ्च बोधकञ्च कलादिकं /
क्षान्तं वागीश्वरं(5) तत्तु ब्रातं तत्र निवेशयेत् //
101.m: The body, its qualities, and its awakeners, such as the kalās— / that multitude terminating in the letter kṣa, belonging to Vāgīśvara, he should install there.

101.s:
daśa nāḍīrdaśa prāṇānindriyāṇi trayodaśa /
tadadhipāṃś ca saṃyojya praṇavādyaiḥ svanāmabhiḥ //
101.d:
दश नाडीर्दश प्राणानिन्द्रियाणि त्रयोदश /
तदधिपांश् च संयोज्य प्रणवाद्यैः स्वनामभिः //
101.m: Having combined the ten nāḍīs, the ten prāṇas, and the thirteen sense organs / along with their presiding deities through their own names preceded by the praṇava,

101.s:
svakāryakāraṇatvena(6) māyākāśaniyāmikāḥ(7) /
vidyeśān prerakān śambhuṃ vyāpinañca susamvaraiḥ(8) //
101.d:
स्वकार्यकारणत्वेन(6) मायाकाशनियामिकाः(7) /
विद्येशान् प्रेरकान् शम्भुं व्यापिनञ्च सुसम्वरैः(8) //
101.m: as his own cause and effect, the regulators of the ether of māyā, / the Vidyeśvaras, the instigators, Śambhu, and the all-pervading [Lord] with well-arranged restraints,

101.s:
aṅgāni ca(9) vinikṣipya nirundhyādrodhamudrā(10) /
suvarṇādyudbhavaṃ yadvā puruṣaṃ puruṣānugaṃ //
101.d:
अङ्गानि च(9) विनिक्षिप्य निरुन्ध्याद्रोधमुद्रा(10) /
सुवर्णाद्युद्भवं यद्वा पुरुषं पुरुषानुगं //
101.m: and having deposited the limbs, he should confine [it] with the rodhamudrā, / or [he should deposit] the Puruṣa, follower of the supreme Puruṣa, fashioned of gold or other materials.

101.s:
pañcagavyakaṣāyādyaiḥ pūrvavat saṃskṛtantataḥ /
śayyāyāṃ kumbhamāropya dhyātvā rudramumāpatiṃ //
:n
1 sarvātmabhinnātmānaṃ svātmanā iti kha.. / sarvātmābhinnamātmā ca
sthāṇuneti ja..
2 bodhayecchaktau iti kha.. , gha.. ca
3 dvādaśāntamiti ga.. , ja.. ca
4 nyasya tatra yathākramamiti ga.. / nyasya tatrābhivāhikamiti cha.. / nyasya
tatrābhivādakamiti ja..
5 vāmeśvaramiti kha.. / bāṇeśvaramiti ṅa..
6 akāryakāraṇatve neti kha.. , cha.. ca
7 prayāmikā iti kha.. , cha.. ca
8 vyāpinañca svaśaktita iti jha.. / vyāpinañcāsya saṃsravair iti ṅa..
9 ajñāne ceti gha.. , jha.. ca / aṅkādi ceti ṅa..
10 nirmañchya droṇamudrayā iti ga.. / nirundhyād dravamudrayā iti jha..
:p 344
101.d:
पञ्चगव्यकषायाद्यैः पूर्ववत् संस्कृतन्ततः /
शय्यायां कुम्भमारोप्य ध्यात्वा रुद्रमुमापतिं //
:न्
1 सर्वात्मभिन्नात्मानं स्वात्मना इति ख.. / सर्वात्माभिन्नमात्मा च
स्थाणुनेति ज..
2 बोधयेच्छक्तौ इति ख.. , घ.. च
3 द्वादशान्तमिति ग.. , ज.. च
4 न्यस्य तत्र यथाक्रममिति ग.. / न्यस्य तत्राभिवाहिकमिति छ.. / न्यस्य
तत्राभिवादकमिति ज..
5 वामेश्वरमिति ख.. / बाणेश्वरमिति ङ..
6 अकार्यकारणत्वे नेति ख.. , छ.. च
7 प्रयामिका इति ख.. , छ.. च
8 व्यापिनञ्च स्वशक्तित इति झ.. / व्यापिनञ्चास्य संस्रवैर् इति ङ..
9 अज्ञाने चेति घ.. , झ.. च / अङ्कादि चेति ङ..
10 निर्मञ्छ्य द्रोणमुद्रया इति ग.. / निरुन्ध्याद् द्रवमुद्रया इति झ..
:प् 344
101.m:
Then, having consecrated it as before with the five products of the cow, decoctions, and so forth, / placing the pot upon the couch, and meditating upon Rudra, the consort of Umā,
[Variant reading note]
[Variant reading note] 1 'sarvātmabhinnātmānaṃ svātmanā' in manuscript kha..; 'sarvātmābhinnamātmā ca sthāṇunā' in ja..
[Variant reading note] 2 'bodhayecchaktau' in manuscripts kha.. and gha..
[Variant reading note] 3 'dvādaśāntam' in manuscripts ga.. and ja..
[Variant reading note] 4 'nyasya tatra yathākramam' in manuscript ga..; 'nyasya tatrābhivāhikam' in cha..; 'nyasya tatrābhivādakam' in ja..
[Variant reading note] 5 'vāmeśvaram' in manuscript kha..; 'bāṇeśvaram' in ṅa..
[Variant reading note] 6 'akāryakāraṇatve na' in manuscripts kha.. and cha..
[Variant reading note] 7 'prayāmikāḥ' in manuscripts kha.. and cha..
[Variant reading note] 8 'vyāpinañca svaśaktitaḥ' in manuscript jha..; 'vyāpinañcāsya saṃsravaiḥ' in ṅa..
[Variant reading note] 9 'ajñāne ca' in manuscripts gha.. and jha..; 'aṅkādi ca' in ṅa..
[Variant reading note] 10 'nirmañchya droṇamudrayā' in manuscript ga..; 'nirundhyād dravamudrayā' in jha..

101.s:
tasmiṃś ca śivamantreṇa vyāpakatvena viyaset /
sannidhānāya homañca praokṣaṇaṃ sparśanaṃ japaṃ //
101.d:
तस्मिंश् च शिवमन्त्रेण व्यापकत्वेन वियसेत् /
सन्निधानाय होमञ्च प्रओक्षणं स्पर्शनं जपं //
101.m: he should ritually deposit [it] into it with the Śiva-mantra in an all-pervading manner. / For the sake of presence, [performing] the fire oblation, sprinkling, touching, and recitation,

101.s:
sānnidhyābodhanaṃ(1) sarvambhāgatrayavibhāgataḥ /
vidhāyaivaṃ(2) prakṛtyante(3) kumbhe taṃ viniveśayet //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe prāsādakṛtyapratiṣṭhā
nāmaikādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha dvyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
dhvajāropaṇaṃ
101.d:
सान्निध्याबोधनं(1) सर्वम्भागत्रयविभागतः /
विधायैवं(2) प्रकृत्यन्ते(3) कुम्भे तं विनिवेशयेत् //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे प्रासादकृत्यप्रतिष्ठा
नामैकाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ द्व्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
ध्वजारोपणं
101.m:
having performed all the awakening of the divine presence by means of a three-fold division, / in this manner, ending with the material cause, he should install Him into the jar.
Thus ends the one hundred and first chapter, entitled 'Consecration of Temple Rites', in the great Purāṇa of Agni.
Now begins the one hundred and second chapter.
The Raising of the Flag

102.s:
īśvara uvāca
cūlake dhvajadaṇḍe ca(4) dhvaje devakule tathā /
pratiṣṭhā ca yathoddiṣṭā(5) tathā skanda vadāmi te(6) //
102.d:
ईश्वर उवाच
चूलके ध्वजदण्डे च(4) ध्वजे देवकुले तथा /
प्रतिष्ठा च यथोद्दिष्टा(5) तथा स्कन्द वदामि ते(6) //
102.m: The Lord said: / The consecration for the crest-pole, the flagpole, / the flag, and the temple, as it has been taught, / that, O Skanda, I shall relate to you.

102.s:
taḍāgārdhapraveśādvā yadvā savārdhaveśanāt /
aiṣṭake dārujaḥ(7) śūlaḥ śailaje dhāmni śailajaḥ(8) //
102.d:
तडागार्धप्रवेशाद्वा यद्वा सवार्धवेशनात् /
ऐष्टके दारुजः(7) शूलः शैलजे धाम्नि शैलजः(8) //
102.m: Either from entry into half of the tank, or from entry into half of the pavilion: / on a brick [temple] the crest-pole is made of wood; on a stone abode, it is made of stone.

102.s:
vaiṣṇavādau ca cakrāḍhyaḥ kumbhaḥ syānmūrtimānataḥ /
sa ca triśūlayuktastu agracūlābhidho mataḥ(9) //
:n
1 sannidhyābodhanamiti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
2 vidhāyaiveti ja..
3 prakṛtyā tu iti kha..
4 cūḍake dhvajadaṇḍe vā iti ja..
5 yathādiṣṭā iti jha..
6 tathā hy ahaṃ vadāmi te iti ṅa..
7 aiṣṭe dārubhava iti gha.. , ja.. ca
8 taḍāgārdhetyādiḥ, śailaja ity antaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti
9 agraṃ cūḍābhidho mata iti gha.. / asracūlādidoṣata iti cha.. /
gṛhacūḍābhidho mata iti ṅa.. / agraṃ cūḍādidoṣata iti kha..
:p 345
102.d:
वैष्णवादौ च चक्राढ्यः कुम्भः स्यान्मूर्तिमानतः /
स च त्रिशूलयुक्तस्तु अग्रचूलाभिधो मतः(9) //
:न्
