न्यसेन्म्लेच्छांश् च कोणेषु ग्रामादिषु तथा स्मृतिं(1) /
श्रियं वैश्रवणं द्वारि(2) पूर्वे तौ(3) पश्यतां श्रियं //
106.m: One should place foreigners in the corner directions, and likewise the law in villages and the like. / At the eastern gate, Śrī and Vaiśravaṇa; both should behold Śrī.

106.s:
devādīnāṃ paścimataḥ pūrvāsyāni gṛhāṇi hi /
pūrvataḥ paścimāsyāni dakṣiṇe cottarānanān(4) //
106.d:
देवादीनां पश्चिमतः पूर्वास्यानि गृहाणि हि /
पूर्वतः पश्चिमास्यानि दक्षिणे चोत्तराननान्(4) //
106.m: To the west of the gods and others, houses should face east; / to the east, facing west; and to the south, facing north.

106.s:
nākeśaviṣṇvādidhāmāni rakṣārthaṃ nagarasya ca(5) /
nirdaivatantu nagaragrāmadurgagṛhādikaṃ //
106.d:
नाकेशविष्ण्वादिधामानि रक्षार्थं नगरस्य च(5) /
निर्दैवतन्तु नगरग्रामदुर्गगृहादिकं //
106.m: Abodes of Indra, Viṣṇu, and others [should be established] for the protection of the city. / A city, village, fortress, house, or the like that is devoid of deities

106.s:
bhujyate tat piśācādyai rogādyaiḥ paribhūyate /
nagarādi sadaivaṃ hi jayadaṃ bhuktimuktidaṃ //
106.d:
भुज्यते तत् पिशाचाद्यै रोगाद्यैः परिभूयते /
नगरादि सदैवं हि जयदं भुक्तिमुक्तिदं //
106.m: is consumed by piśācas and others and overcome by diseases and the like. / Thus, a city and the like always bestows victory, worldly enjoyment, and liberation.

106.s:
pūrvāyāṃ śrīgṛhaṃ proktamāgneyyāṃ vai mahānasaṃ /
śanayaṃ dakṣiṇasyāntu(7) nairṛtyāmāyudhāśrayaṃ //
106.d:
पूर्वायां श्रीगृहं प्रोक्तमाग्नेय्यां वै महानसं /
शनयं दक्षिणस्यान्तु(7) नैरृत्यामायुधाश्रयं //
106.m: A room for prosperity is prescribed in the east, a kitchen in the south-east, / a bedroom in the south, and an armory in the south-west;

106.s:
bhojanaṃ paścimāyāntu vāyavyāṃ dhānyasaṅgrahaḥ /
uttare dravyasaṃsthānamaiśānyāṃ devatāgṛhaṃ(8) //
106.d:
भोजनं पश्चिमायान्तु वायव्यां धान्यसङ्ग्रहः /
उत्तरे द्रव्यसंस्थानमैशान्यां देवतागृहं(8) //
106.m: a dining room in the west, a store of grain in the north-west, / storage for wealth in the north, and a shrine for deities in the north-east.

106.s:
catuḥśālaṃ triśālaṃ vā dviśālaṃ caikaśālakaṃ /
catuḥśālagṛhāṇāntu śālālindakabhedataḥ(9) //
:n
1 tathā sthitamiti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca / yathāsthitamiti ja..
2 vaiśravaṇaṃ vāpi iti ga..
3 pūrvata iti kha..
4 dakṣiṇe cottareṇa ceti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. ca
5 nagarasya hīti kha.. , cha.. ca
6 rogādyair abhibhūyate iti ja..
7 dakṣiṇāyāṃ tviti ga.. , gha.. , jha ca
8 devatālayamiti jha..
9 śālālindaprabhedata iti ka..
:p 364
106.d:
चतुःशालं त्रिशालं वा द्विशालं चैकशालकं /
चतुःशालगृहाणान्तु शालालिन्दकभेदतः(9) //
:न्
1 तथा स्थितमिति ख.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. च / यथास्थितमिति ज..
2 वैश्रवणं वापि इति ग..
3 पूर्वत इति ख..
4 दक्षिणे चोत्तरेण चेति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. च
5 नगरस्य हीति ख.. , छ.. च
6 रोगाद्यैर् अभिभूयते इति ज..
7 दक्षिणायां त्विति ग.. , घ.. , झ च
8 देवतालयमिति झ..
9 शालालिन्दप्रभेदत इति क..
:प् 364
106.m:
A house may have four halls, three halls, two halls, or a single hall. / In four-hall houses, according to the distinction of halls and porticos,
[Notes:]
1 'tathā sthitam' in manuscripts kha, gha, ṅa, and cha; 'yathāsthitam' in manuscript ja.
2 'vaiśravaṇaṃ vāpi' in manuscript ga.
3 'pūrvataḥ' in manuscript kha.
4 'dakṣiṇe cottareṇa ca' in manuscripts kha, ga, and gha.
5 'nagarasya hi' in manuscripts kha and cha.
6 'rogādyair abhibhūyate' in manuscript ja.
7 'dakṣiṇāyāṃ tu' in manuscripts ga, gha, and jha.
8 'devatālayam' in manuscript jha.
9 'śālālindaprabhedataḥ' in manuscript ka.

106.s:
śatadvayantu jāyante pañcāśat pañca teṣvapi /
triśālāni tu catvāri dviśālāni tu pañcadhā //
106.d:
शतद्वयन्तु जायन्ते पञ्चाशत् पञ्च तेष्वपि /
त्रिशालानि तु चत्वारि द्विशालानि तु पञ्चधा //
106.m: two hundred and fifty-five types arise among them. / There are four three-hall houses, and five types of two-hall houses;

106.s:
ekaśālāni catvāri ekālindāni vacmi ca /
aṣṭāviṃśadalindāni gṛhāṇi nagarāṇi ca(1) //
106.d:
एकशालानि चत्वारि एकालिन्दानि वच्मि च /
अष्टाविंशदलिन्दानि गृहाणि नगराणि च(1) //
106.m: there are four single-hall houses; and I shall state those with single porticos. / Houses and cities have twenty-eight porticos,

106.s:
caturbhiḥ saprabhiś caiva pañcapañcāśadeva tu /
ṣaḍalindāni viṃśaiva aṣṭābhirviṃśa eva hi(2) //
106.d:
चतुर्भिः सप्रभिश् चैव पञ्चपञ्चाशदेव तु /
षडलिन्दानि विंशैव अष्टाभिर्विंश एव हि(2) //
106.m: fifty-five with four and seven, / twenty with six porticos, and twenty with eight.

106.s:
aṣṭālindaṃ bhavedevaṃ(3) nagarādau gṛhāṇi hi /
:e ity āgeneye mahāpurāṇe nagarādivāsturnāma ṣaḍadhikaśatatamo
'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha saptādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
svāyambhuvasargaḥ
agnir uvāca(4)
106.d:
अष्टालिन्दं भवेदेवं(3) नगरादौ गृहाणि हि /
:ए इत्य् आगेनेये महापुराणे नगरादिवास्तुर्नाम षडधिकशततमो
ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ सप्ताधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
स्वायम्भुवसर्गः
अग्निर् उवाच(4)
106.m:
Thus houses in cities and the like may have eight porticos.
Thus ends the one hundred and sixth chapter, entitled 'Site Architecture of Cities and the Like', in the Mahāpurāṇa spoken by Agni.
Now begins the one hundred and seventh chapter.
The creation by Svāyambhuva.
Agni said:

107.s:
vakṣye bhuvanakoṣañca pṛthvīdvīpādilakṣaṇaṃ /
agnidhraścāgnibāhuś ca vapuṣmāndyutimāṃs tathā //
107.d:
वक्ष्ये भुवनकोषञ्च पृथ्वीद्वीपादिलक्षणं /
अग्निध्रश्चाग्निबाहुश् च वपुष्मान्द्युतिमांस् तथा //
107.m: I shall speak of the configuration of the cosmos, and the characteristics of the earth, continents, and so forth: / [The sons of Priyavrata were] Āgnīdhra, Agnibāhu, Vapuṣmat, and Dyutimat,

107.s:
medhā medhātithirbhavyaḥ savanaḥ putra eva ca(5) /
:n
1 gṛhāṇi nagarādiṣu iti jha.. / gṛhāṇi nagarāṇi tu iti kha..
2 viṃśa eva ceti kha.. , cha.. ca
3 aṣṭābhirvibhajedevamiti cha..
4 īśvara uvāceti kha.. , cha.. ca
5 savanaḥ kṣaya eva ca iti ka..
:p 365
jyotiṣmān daśamasteṣāṃ satyanāmā suto 'bhavat //
107.d:
मेधा मेधातिथिर्भव्यः सवनः पुत्र एव च(5) /
:न्
1 गृहाणि नगरादिषु इति झ.. / गृहाणि नगराणि तु इति ख..
2 विंश एव चेति ख.. , छ.. च
3 अष्टाभिर्विभजेदेवमिति छ..
4 ईश्वर उवाचेति ख.. , छ.. च
5 सवनः क्षय एव च इति क..
:प् 365
ज्योतिष्मान् दशमस्तेषां सत्यनामा सुतो ऽभवत् //
107.m:
Medhā, Medhātithi, Bhavya, and Savana, as his sons.
[Footnote]
1. 'gṛhāṇi nagarādiṣu' in MS jha; 'gṛhāṇi nagarāṇi tu' in MS kha.
2. 'viṃśa eva ca' in MSS kha and cha.
3. 'aṣṭābhirvibhajedevam' in MS cha.
4. 'īśvara uvāca' in MSS kha and cha.
5. 'savanaḥ kṣaya eva ca' in MS ka.
The tenth among them was his son Jyotiṣmān, whose name was truthful.

107.s:
priyabratasutāḥ khyātāḥ saptadvīpāndadau pitā /
jambudvīpamathāgnīdhre plakṣaṃ medhātitherdadau //
107.d:
प्रियब्रतसुताः ख्याताः सप्तद्वीपान्ददौ पिता /
जम्बुद्वीपमथाग्नीध्रे प्लक्षं मेधातिथेर्ददौ //
107.m: The sons of Priyavrata were renowned; their father gave them the seven continents. / Then he gave Jambūdvīpa to Āgnīdhra, and Plakṣa to Medhātithi;

107.s:
vapuṣmate śālmalañca jyotiṣmate kuśāhvayaṃ /
krauñcadvīpaṃ dyutimate śākaṃ bhavyāya dattavān //
107.d:
वपुष्मते शाल्मलञ्च ज्योतिष्मते कुशाह्वयं /
क्रौञ्चद्वीपं द्युतिमते शाकं भव्याय दत्तवान् //
107.m: And Śālmala to Vapuṣmān, and that called Kuśa to Jyotiṣmān, / Krauñcadvīpa to Dyutimān, and Śāka he gave to Bhavya.

107.s:
puṣkaraṃ savanāyādādagnīdhre 'dāt sute śataṃ(1) /
jambūdvīpaṃ pitā lakṣaṃ nābherdattaṃ himāhvayaṃ //
107.d:
पुष्करं सवनायादादग्नीध्रे ऽदात् सुते शतं(1) /
जम्बूद्वीपं पिता लक्षं नाभेर्दत्तं हिमाह्वयं //
107.m: He gave Puṣkara to Savana; and to Āgnīdhra's sons he gave a hundred, / [while] the father gave a hundred thousand [yojanas of] Jambūdvīpa; [the realm] named Hima was given to Nābhi;

107.s:
hemakūṭaṃ kimpuruṣe harivarṣāya naiṣadhaṃ /
ilāvṛte merumadhye ramye nīlācalaśritaṃ(2) //
107.d:
हेमकूटं किम्पुरुषे हरिवर्षाय नैषधं /
इलावृते मेरुमध्ये रम्ये नीलाचलश्रितं(2) //
107.m: Hemakūṭa to Kimpuruṣa, Naiṣadha to Harivarṣa, / in Ilāvṛta, in the middle of Meru; [the realm] bordering the Blue Mountain (Nīlācala) to Ramyaka;

107.s:
hiraṇvate śvetavarṣaṃ kurūṃstu kurave dadau /
bhadrāśvāya ca bhadrāśvaṃ ketumālāya paścimaṃ //
107.d:
हिरण्वते श्वेतवर्षं कुरूंस्तु कुरवे ददौ /
भद्राश्वाय च भद्राश्वं केतुमालाय पश्चिमं //
107.m: To Hiraṇvān the White Realm (Śvetavarṣa), and Kuru to Kuru he gave; / and Bhadrāśva to Bhadrāśva, and the western [realm] to Ketumāla.

107.s:
meroḥ priyavrataḥ putrānabhiṣicya yayau vanaṃ /
śālagrāme tapastaptvā yayau viṣṇorlayaṃ nṛpaḥ //
107.d:
मेरोः प्रियव्रतः पुत्रानभिषिच्य ययौ वनं /
शालग्रामे तपस्तप्त्वा ययौ विष्णोर्लयं नृपः //
107.m: Having consecrated his sons, Priyavrata departed from Meru to the forest; / having performed ascetic austerity at Śālagrāma, the king merged into Viṣṇu.

107.s:
yāni kumpuruṣādyāni hy aṣṭavarṣāṇi sattama /
teṣāṃ svābhāvikī siddhiḥ sukhaprāyā hy ayatnataḥ //
107.d:
यानि कुम्पुरुषाद्यानि ह्य् अष्टवर्षाणि सत्तम /
तेषां स्वाभाविकी सिद्धिः सुखप्राया ह्य् अयत्नतः //
107.m: The eight realms beginning with Kimpuruṣa, O best of men, / their perfection is natural, mostly happy, without effort.

107.s:
jarāmṛtyubhayaṃ nāsti dharmādharmau yugādikaṃ /
nādhamaṃ madhyamantulyā himāddeśāttu nābhitaḥ(3) //
107.d:
जरामृत्युभयं नास्ति धर्माधर्मौ युगादिकं /
नाधमं मध्यमन्तुल्या हिमाद्देशात्तु नाभितः(3) //
107.m: There is no fear of old age or death, no virtue or vice, cosmic ages and the like, / nothing inferior, [only] mediocre [and] equal, up to Nābhi's realm from the Snowy [Mountain].

107.s:
ṛṣabho merudevyāñca ṛṣabhād bharato 'bhavat /
ṛṣabho dattaśrīḥ putre śālagrāme hariṅgataḥ //
107.d:
ऋषभो मेरुदेव्याञ्च ऋषभाद् भरतो ऽभवत् /
ऋषभो दत्तश्रीः पुत्रे शालग्रामे हरिङ्गतः //
107.m: ṛṣabha was born from Merudevī, and from Ṛṣabha Bharata was born. / Ṛṣabha, having conferred prosperity upon his son, went to Hari at Śālagrāma.

107.s:
bharatād bhārataṃ varṣaṃ bharatāt sumatistvabhūt(4) /
bharato dattalakṣmīkaḥ śālagrāme hariṃ gataḥ //
:n
1 sutebhya u iti kha.. , cha.. ca
2 ramyenīlācalāśriyamiti kha.. , ṅa.. , jha.. ca / ramyaṃ nīlācale
sthitamiti gha..
3 himāddeśāntanābhita iti cha..
4 sumatistata iti ga..
:p 366
107.d:
भरताद् भारतं वर्षं भरतात् सुमतिस्त्वभूत्(4) /
भरतो दत्तलक्ष्मीकः शालग्रामे हरिं गतः //
:न्
1 सुतेभ्य उ इति ख.. , छ.. च
2 रम्येनीलाचलाश्रियमिति ख.. , ङ.. , झ.. च / रम्यं नीलाचले
स्थितमिति घ..
3 हिमाद्देशान्तनाभित इति छ..
4 सुमतिस्तत इति ग..
:प् 366
107.m:
From Bharata came the realm of Bhārata, and from Bharata was born Sumati. / Bharata, having conferred fortune [upon him], went to Hari at Śālagrāma.
[Footnote]
1. 'sutebhya u' in kha and cha.
2. 'ramyenīlācalāśriyam' in kha, ṅa, and jha; 'ramyaṃ nīlācale sthitam' in gha.
3. 'himāddeśāntanābhita' in cha.
4. 'sumatistata' in ga. / :p 366

107.s:
sa yogī yogaprastāve(1) vakṣye taccaritaṃ punaḥ /
sumatestejasastasmādindradyumno vyajāyata(2) //
107.d:
स योगी योगप्रस्तावे(1) वक्ष्ये तच्चरितं पुनः /
सुमतेस्तेजसस्तस्मादिन्द्रद्युम्नो व्यजायत(2) //
107.m: He was a yogin; in the context of yoga I shall tell his life story again. / From the brilliance of that Sumati, Indradyumna was born;

107.s:
parameṣṭhī tatastasmāt pratīhārastadanvayaḥ /
pratīhārāt pratīhartā pratiharturbhuvastataḥ //
107.d:
परमेष्ठी ततस्तस्मात् प्रतीहारस्तदन्वयः /
प्रतीहारात् प्रतीहर्ता प्रतिहर्तुर्भुवस्ततः //
107.m: From him Parameṣṭhin, and from him Pratīhāra was his lineage; / from Pratīhāra [came] Pratīhartā, and from Pratihartṛ then [came] Bhuva;

107.s:
udgītotha ca prastāro vibhuḥ prastārataḥ sutaḥ(3) /
pṛthuś caiva tato nakto naktasyāpi gayaḥ sutaḥ //
107.d:
उद्गीतोथ च प्रस्तारो विभुः प्रस्तारतः सुतः(3) /
पृथुश् चैव ततो नक्तो नक्तस्यापि गयः सुतः //
107.m: Udgītha, and then Prastāra; Vibhu was the son of Prastāra; / and then Pṛthu, then Nakta, and Gaya was the son of Nakta;

107.s:
naro gayasya tanayaḥ tatputro 'bhūdvirāṭ tataḥ /
tasya putro mahāvīryo dhīmāṃstasmādajāyata //
107.d:
नरो गयस्य तनयः तत्पुत्रो ऽभूद्विराट् ततः /
तस्य पुत्रो महावीर्यो धीमांस्तस्मादजायत //
107.m: Nara was the son of Gaya; from him his son was Virāj; / his son was Mahāvīrya; from him was born the wise

107.s:
mahāntastatsutaścābhūnmanasyastasya cātmajaḥ /
tvaṣṭā tvaṣṭuś ca virajā(4)rajastasyāpyabhūt sutaḥ //
107.d:
महान्तस्तत्सुतश्चाभून्मनस्यस्तस्य चात्मजः /
त्वष्टा त्वष्टुश् च विरजा(4)रजस्तस्याप्यभूत् सुतः //
107.m: Mahānta, and his son was Manasyu; / Tvaṣṭā, and from Tvaṣṭā Virajā, and Rajas was also his son;

107.s:
satyajidrajasastasya jajñe putraśataṃ mune /
viśvajyotiḥpradhānāste bhāratantair vivardhitaṃ //
107.d:
सत्यजिद्रजसस्तस्य जज्ञे पुत्रशतं मुने /
विश्वज्योतिःप्रधानास्ते भारतन्तैर् विवर्धितं //
107.m: Satyajit was born of Rajas; to him were born a hundred sons, O sage, / with Viśvajyotis as the foremost; by them Bhārata was expanded.

107.s:
kṛtatretādisargeṇa sargaḥ svāyambhuvaḥ smṛtaḥ /
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe svāyambhuvaḥ sargo nāma
saptādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athāṣṭādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
bhuvanakoṣaḥ
107.d:
कृतत्रेतादिसर्गेण सर्गः स्वायम्भुवः स्मृतः /
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे स्वायम्भुवः सर्गो नाम
सप्ताधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथाष्टाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
भुवनकोषः
107.m:
Through the creation of the Kṛta, Tretā, and other [ages], this is remembered as the creation of Svāyambhuva.
Thus, in the Great Purāṇa of Agni, the one hundred and seventh chapter, entitled 'The Creation of Svāyambhuva'.
Now the one hundred and eighth chapter:
The Structure of the Universe.

108.s:
agnir uvāca
jambūplakṣāhvayau dvīpau śālmaliścāparo mahān /
kuśaḥ krauñcas tathā śākaḥ puṣkaraśceti saptamaḥ //
:n
1 yogaprastāre iti ga.. , ja.. , jha.. ca
2 indradyumnobhyajāyateti kha.. , cha.. ca
3 pratīhārādityādiḥ, prastārataḥ suta ity antaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake
nāsti
4 duṣṭāduṣṭaś ca virajā iti kha..
:p 367
108.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
जम्बूप्लक्षाह्वयौ द्वीपौ शाल्मलिश्चापरो महान् /
कुशः क्रौञ्चस् तथा शाकः पुष्करश्चेति सप्तमः //
:न्
1 योगप्रस्तारे इति ग.. , ज.. , झ.. च
2 इन्द्रद्युम्नोभ्यजायतेति ख.. , छ.. च
3 प्रतीहारादित्यादिः, प्रस्तारतः सुत इत्य् अन्तः पाठो झ.. पुस्तके
नास्ति
4 दुष्टादुष्टश् च विरजा इति ख..
:प् 367
108.m:
Agni said: / The two continents named Jambū and Plakṣa, and the next large one is Śālmali; / Kuśa, Krauñca, and likewise Śāka, and Puṣkara is the seventh.
[Footnote]
1. 'yogaprastāre' in ga, ja, and jha.
2. 'indradyumnobhyajāyata' in kha and cha.
3. The reading beginning with 'pratīhārād' up to 'prastārataḥ suta' is missing in manuscript jha.
4. 'duṣṭāduṣṭaś ca virajā' in kha. / :p 367

108.s:
ete dvīpāḥ samudraistu sapta saptabhirāvṛtāḥ /
lavaṇekṣusurāsarpirdadhidugdhajalaiḥ samaṃ(1) //
108.d:
एते द्वीपाः समुद्रैस्तु सप्त सप्तभिरावृताः /
लवणेक्षुसुरासर्पिर्दधिदुग्धजलैः समं(1) //
108.m: These seven continents are encircled by seven oceans / containing salt, sugar-cane juice, wine, clarified butter, curd, milk, and water respectively.

108.s:
jambūdvīpo dvīpamadhye(2) tanmadhye merurucchritaḥ(3) /
caturaśītisāhasro bhūyiṣṭhaḥ(4) ṣoḍaśādvirāṭ //
108.d:
जम्बूद्वीपो द्वीपमध्ये(2) तन्मध्ये मेरुरुच्छ्रितः(3) /
चतुरशीतिसाहस्रो भूयिष्ठः(4) षोडशाद्विराट् //
108.m: Jambūdvīpa is in the middle of the continents; in its middle stands high Meru, / measuring eighty-four thousand [yojanas], extending sixteen [thousand] within the earth;

108.s:
dvātriṃśanmūrdhni vistarāt ṣoḍaśādhaḥ(5) sahasravān /
bhūyastasyāsya(6) śailo 'sau karṇikākārasaṃsthitaḥ //
108.d:
द्वात्रिंशन्मूर्ध्नि विस्तरात् षोडशाधः(5) सहस्रवान् /
भूयस्तस्यास्य(6) शैलो ऽसौ कर्णिकाकारसंस्थितः //
108.m: Thirty-two [thousand yojanas] in width at the summit, and sixteen thousand below; / this mountain stands resembling the pericarp of that earth-lotus.

108.s:
himavān hemakūṭaś ca niṣadhaścāsya dakṣiṇe /
nīlaḥ śvetaś ca śṛṅgo ca uttare varṣaparvatāḥ //
108.d:
हिमवान् हेमकूटश् च निषधश्चास्य दक्षिणे /
नीलः श्वेतश् च शृङ्गो च उत्तरे वर्षपर्वताः //
108.m: Himavān, Hemakūṭa, and Niṣadha are to the south of it; / Nīla, Śveta, and Śṛṅgin are the boundary mountains to the north.

108.s:
lakṣapramāṇau dvau madhye daśahīnās tathāpare /
sahasradvitayochrāyāstāvadvistāriṇaś ca te //
108.d:
लक्षप्रमाणौ द्वौ मध्ये दशहीनास् तथापरे /
सहस्रद्वितयोछ्रायास्तावद्विस्तारिणश् च ते //
108.m: The two in the middle measure a hundred thousand [yojanas]; the others are ten [thousand] less; / they are two thousand in height and just as much in breadth.

108.s:
bhārataṃ prathamaṃ varṣantataḥ kimpuruṣaṃ smṛtaṃ /
harivarsantathaivānyanmerordakṣiṇato dvija //
108.d:
भारतं प्रथमं वर्षन्ततः किम्पुरुषं स्मृतं /
हरिवर्सन्तथैवान्यन्मेरोर्दक्षिणतो द्विज //
108.m: Bhārata is declared the first realm, then Kimpuruṣa, / and likewise another is Harivarṣa, south of Meru, O twice-born!

108.s:
ramyakaṃ cottare varṣaṃ tathaivānyaddhiraṇmayaṃ(7) /
uttarāḥ kuravaś caiva yathā vai bhārataṃ tathā //
108.d:
रम्यकं चोत्तरे वर्षं तथैवान्यद्धिरण्मयं(7) /
उत्तराः कुरवश् चैव यथा वै भारतं तथा //
108.m: Ramyaka is a northern realm, and likewise another is Hiraṇmaya, / and the Northern Kurus, just as Bhārata is.

108.s:
navasāhasramekaikameteṣāṃ munisattama /
ilāvṛtañca tanmadhye sauvarṇā meruruchritaḥ //
108.d:
नवसाहस्रमेकैकमेतेषां मुनिसत्तम /
इलावृतञ्च तन्मध्ये सौवर्णा मेरुरुछ्रितः //
108.m: Each of these is nine thousand [yojanas in extent], O best of sages! / And in their middle is Ilāvṛta, where golden Meru rises high.

108.s:
meroś caturdiśantatra navasāhasravistṛtaṃ(8) /
:n
1 dadhidugdhajalāntakā iti kha.. , cha.. ca
2 jambūdvīpastasya madhye iti ja..
3 merurutthita iti jha..
4 bhūmiṣṭha iti gha.. , ja.. ca / bhuvistha iti ṅa..
5 ṣoḍaśāṃśa iti jha..
6 bhūpādmasyāsya iti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. ca
7 tathaivātra hiraṇmayamiti ga.. / tathaivātha hiraṇmayamiti ja..
8 ilāvṛtaścetyādiḥ, navasāhasravistṛtamityantaḥ pāṭho cha..
pustake nāsti
:p 368
ilāvṛtaṃ mahābhāga catvāraścātra parvatāḥ //
108.d:
मेरोश् चतुर्दिशन्तत्र नवसाहस्रविस्तृतं(8) /
:न्
1 दधिदुग्धजलान्तका इति ख.. , छ.. च
2 जम्बूद्वीपस्तस्य मध्ये इति ज..
3 मेरुरुत्थित इति झ..
4 भूमिष्ठ इति घ.. , ज.. च / भुविस्थ इति ङ..
5 षोडशांश इति झ..
6 भूपाद्मस्यास्य इति ख.. , ग.. , छ.. च
7 तथैवात्र हिरण्मयमिति ग.. / तथैवाथ हिरण्मयमिति ज..
8 इलावृतश्चेत्यादिः, नवसाहस्रविस्तृतमित्यन्तः पाठो छ..
पुस्तके नास्ति
:प् 368
इलावृतं महाभाग चत्वारश्चात्र पर्वताः //
108.m:
On the four sides of Meru there extends for nine thousand [yojanas]
[Footnote]
1. 'dadhidugdhajalāntakā' in kha and cha.
2. 'jambūdvīpastasya madhye' in ja.
3. 'merurutthita' in jha.
4. 'bhūmiṣṭha' in gha and ja; 'bhuvistha' in ṅa.
5. 'ṣoḍaśāṃśa' in jha.
6. 'bhūpādmasyāsya' in kha, ga, and cha.
7. 'tathaivātra hiraṇmayam' in ga; 'tathaivātha hiraṇmayam' in ja.
8. The reading beginning with 'ilāvṛtaśca' up to 'navasāhasravistṛtam' is missing in manuscript cha. / :p 368
Ilāvṛta, O highly fortunate one; and four mountains are here,

108.s:
viṣkambhā racitā meroryojanāyutavistṛtāḥ(1) /
pūrveṇa mandaro nāma dakṣiṇe gandhamādanaḥ //
108.d:
विष्कम्भा रचिता मेरोर्योजनायुतविस्तृताः(1) /
पूर्वेण मन्दरो नाम दक्षिणे गन्धमादनः //
108.m: Fashioned as buttresses of Meru, extending ten thousand yojanas: / on the east Mandara by name, on the south Gandhamādana,

108.s:
vipulaḥ paścime pārśve supārśvaścottare smṛtaḥ(2) /
kadambasteṣu jambuś ca pippalo baṭa eva ca //
108.d:
विपुलः पश्चिमे पार्श्वे सुपार्श्वश्चोत्तरे स्मृतः(2) /
कदम्बस्तेषु जम्बुश् च पिप्पलो बट एव च //
108.m: Vipula is on the western flank, and Supārśva is traditionally known on the north; / on them are the kadamba, the jambu, the pippala, and the banyan.

108.s:
ekādaśaśatāyāmāḥ pādapā giriketavaḥ /
jambūdvīpeti sañjñā syāt phalaṃ jambā gajopamaṃ //
108.d:
एकादशशतायामाः पादपा गिरिकेतवः /
जम्बूद्वीपेति सञ्ज्ञा स्यात् फलं जम्बा गजोपमं //
108.m: These trees, the banners of the mountains, are eleven hundred [yojanas] in height; / from this comes the name Jambūdvīpa; the fruit of the jambu is like an elephant;

108.s:
jambūnadīrasenāsyāstvidaṃ jāmbūnadaṃ(3) paraṃ /
supārśvaḥ pūrvato meroḥ ketumālastu paścime //
108.d:
जम्बूनदीरसेनास्यास्त्विदं जाम्बूनदं(3) परं /
सुपार्श्वः पूर्वतो मेरोः केतुमालस्तु पश्चिमे //
108.m: From the juice of this Jambū river comes this superior jāmbūnada gold. / Supārśva is to the east of Meru, and Ketumāla on the west;

108.s:
vanaṃ caitrarathaṃ pūrve dakṣiṇe gandhamādanaḥ /
vaibhrājaṃ paścime saumye nandanañca sarāṃsyatha //
108.d:
वनं चैत्ररथं पूर्वे दक्षिणे गन्धमादनः /
वैभ्राजं पश्चिमे सौम्ये नन्दनञ्च सरांस्यथ //
108.m: To the east is the Caitraratha forest, to the south Gandhamādana, / to the west Vaibhrāja, and in the north Nandana; and now the lakes:

108.s:
aruṇodaṃ mahābhadraṃ saṃśitodaṃ(5) samānasaṃ /
śitābhaś cakramuñjādyāḥ pūrvataḥ keśarācalāḥ(5) //
108.d:
अरुणोदं महाभद्रं संशितोदं(5) समानसं /
शिताभश् चक्रमुञ्जाद्याः पूर्वतः केशराचलाः(5) //
108.m: Aruṇoda, Mahābhadra, Śītodaka, together with Mānasa. / Śitābha, Cakramuñja, and others are the filament mountains to the east;

108.s:
dakṣiṇendrestrikūṭādyāḥ śiśivāsamukhā jale(6) /
śaṅkhakūṭādayaḥ saumye merau ca brahmaṇaḥ purī //
108.d:
दक्षिणेन्द्रेस्त्रिकूटाद्याः शिशिवासमुखा जले(6) /
शङ्खकूटादयः सौम्ये मेरौ च ब्रह्मणः पुरी //
108.m: To the south of Indra, Trikūṭa and others, headed by Śiśiravāsa in the water; / Śaṅkhakūṭa and others in the north; and on Meru is the city of Brahmā,

108.s:
caturdaśasahasrāṇi yojanānāñca dikṣu ca /
indrādilokapālānāṃ samantāt brahmaṇaḥ puraḥ //
108.d:
चतुर्दशसहस्राणि योजनानाञ्च दिक्षु च /
इन्द्रादिलोकपालानां समन्तात् ब्रह्मणः पुरः //
108.m: Measuring fourteen thousand yojanas, and in the cardinal directions / all around the city of Brahmā are [the cities] of the guardians of the worlds, headed by Indra.

108.s:
viṣṇupādāt plāvayitvā candraṃ svargāt patantyapi /
pūrveṇa śītā bhadrāśvācchailācchailādgatārṇavaṃ //
108.d:
विष्णुपादात् प्लावयित्वा चन्द्रं स्वर्गात् पतन्त्यपि /
पूर्वेण शीता भद्राश्वाच्छैलाच्छैलाद्गतार्णवं //
108.m: Flowing down from the foot of Viṣṇu, after flooding the moon, they fall from heaven. / To the east, the Śītā flows from mountain to mountain across Bhadrāśva into the ocean.

108.s:
tathaivālakanandāpi dakṣiṇenaiva bhārataṃ(7) /
:n
1 yojanāyutamucchritā iti gha..
2 supārśvaścottare sthita iti gha..
3 rasanāsmāddhemajāmbunadamiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca
4 asitodamiti ja..
5 pūrvataḥ śiśirācalā iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ja.. ca
6 śaśivāmamukhā jale iti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca
7 dakṣiṇena ca bhāratamiti kha.. / dakṣiṇenaiti bhāratamiti ga..
:p 369
prayāti sāgaraṃ kṛtvā saptabhedātha paścimaṃ //
108.d:
तथैवालकनन्दापि दक्षिणेनैव भारतं(7) /
:न्
1 योजनायुतमुच्छ्रिता इति घ..
2 सुपार्श्वश्चोत्तरे स्थित इति घ..
3 रसनास्माद्धेमजाम्बुनदमिति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. च
4 असितोदमिति ज..
5 पूर्वतः शिशिराचला इति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ज.. च
6 शशिवाममुखा जले इति ख.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. च
7 दक्षिणेन च भारतमिति ख.. / दक्षिणेनैति भारतमिति ग..
:प् 369
प्रयाति सागरं कृत्वा सप्तभेदाथ पश्चिमं //
108.m:
Likewise, the Alakanandā flows south across Bhārata,
[Footnote]
1. 'yojanāyutamucchritā' in MS gha.
2. 'supārśvaścottare sthitaḥ' in MS gha.
3. 'rasanāsmāddhemajāmbunadam' in MSS kha, ga, gha, ṅa, and cha.
4. 'asitodam' in MS ja.
5. 'pūrvataḥ śiśirācalā' in MSS kha, ga, gha, and ja.
6. 'śaśivāmamukhā jale' in MSS kha, gha, ṅa, and cha.
7. 'dakṣiṇena ca bhāratam' in MS kha; 'dakṣiṇenaiti bhāratam' in MS ga.
and dividing into seven streams, reaches the ocean. Then to the west

108.s:
abdhiñca cakṣuḥsaumyābdhiṃ bhadrottarakurūnapi(1) /
ānīlaniṣadhāyāmau(2) mālyavadgandhamādanau //
108.d:
अब्धिञ्च चक्षुःसौम्याब्धिं भद्रोत्तरकुरूनपि(1) /
आनीलनिषधायामौ(2) माल्यवद्गन्धमादनौ //
108.m: reaches the ocean [as the river] Cakṣu; the northern ocean [as the Bhadrā] through Uttarakuru. / Mālyavat and Gandhamādana extend up to the Nīla and Niṣadha mountains.

108.s:
tayormadhyagato meruḥ karṇikākārasaṃsthitaḥ /
bhāratāḥ ketumālāś ca bhadrāśvāḥ kuravas tathā //
108.d:
तयोर्मध्यगतो मेरुः कर्णिकाकारसंस्थितः /
भारताः केतुमालाश् च भद्राश्वाः कुरवस् तथा //
108.m: Between the two stands Meru, situated in the shape of a pericarp. / Bhārata, Ketumāla, Bhadrāśva, and Kuru

108.s:
patrāṇi lokapadmasya maryādāśailavāhyataḥ /
jaṭharo devakūṭaś ca maryādāparvatāvubhau(3) //
108.d:
पत्राणि लोकपद्मस्य मर्यादाशैलवाह्यतः /
जठरो देवकूटश् च मर्यादापर्वतावुभौ(3) //
108.m: are the petals of the world-lotus outside the boundary mountains. / Jaṭhara and Devakūṭa are both boundary mountains;

108.s:
tau dakṣiṇottarāyāmāvānīlaniṣadhāyatau /
gandhamādanakailāsau pūrvavacāyatāvubhau(4) //
108.d:
तौ दक्षिणोत्तरायामावानीलनिषधायतौ /
गन्धमादनकैलासौ पूर्ववचायतावुभौ(4) //
108.m: they extend north to south, stretching up to the Nīla and Niṣadha mountains. / Gandhamādana and Kailāsa both stretch [east to west] like the former.

108.s:
aśītiyojanāyāmāvarṇavāntarvyavasthitau /
niṣadhaḥ pāripātraś ca maryādāparvatāvubhau //
108.d:
अशीतियोजनायामावर्णवान्तर्व्यवस्थितौ /
निषधः पारिपात्रश् च मर्यादापर्वतावुभौ //
108.m: Extending eighty yojanas, situated inside the ocean, / Niṣadha and Pāripātra are both boundary mountains.

108.s:
meroḥ paścimadigbhāge yathā pūrve tathā sthitau /
triśṛṅgo rudhiraś caiva uttarau varṣaparvatau //
108.d:
मेरोः पश्चिमदिग्भागे यथा पूर्वे तथा स्थितौ /
त्रिशृङ्गो रुधिरश् चैव उत्तरौ वर्षपर्वतौ //
108.m: They stand on the western side of Meru, just as [the two] on the east. / Triśṛṅga and Rudhira are the two northern realm-mountains.

108.s:
pūrvapañcāyatāvetāvarṇavāntarvyavasthitau /
jāṭharādyāś ca maryādāśailā meroś caturdiśaṃ //
108.d:
पूर्वपञ्चायतावेतावर्णवान्तर्व्यवस्थितौ /
जाठराद्याश् च मर्यादाशैला मेरोश् चतुर्दिशं //
108.m: These two extend east to west, situated within the ocean. / The boundary mountains such as Jaṭhara stand on the four sides of Meru.

108.s:
keśarādiṣu yā droṇyastāsu santi purāṇi hi /
lakṣmīviṣṇvagnisūryādidevānāṃ munisattama //
108.d:
केशरादिषु या द्रोण्यस्तासु सन्ति पुराणि हि /
लक्ष्मीविष्ण्वग्निसूर्यादिदेवानां मुनिसत्तम //
108.m: In the valleys in their filaments are cities / of gods such as Lakṣmī, Viṣṇu, Agni, and Sūrya, O best of sages,

108.s:
bhaumānāṃ svargadharmāṇāṃ na pāpāstatra yānti ca(5) /
:n
1 bhadrodbhavakurūnapi iti kha..
2 alīnaniṣadhāyāmā iti kha.. , cha.. ca
3 ramyakamityādiḥ, maryādāparvatāvubhāvityanntaḥ pāṭho jha..
pustake nāsti
4 pūrvapaścāyatāvubhau iti gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca
5 bhumāḥ svargā dharmiṇānte na pāpāstatra yānti ca iti cha.. , ṅa.. ca /
maumānāṃ svargadharmāṇāṃ tanayā hy atra yānti ceti ga.. , gha.. ca /
bhogināṃ svargadharmāṇāṃ tanayāstatra yānti ceti ja..
:p 370
bhadrāśve 'sti hayagrīvo varāhaḥ ketumālake //
108.d:
भौमानां स्वर्गधर्माणां न पापास्तत्र यान्ति च(5) /
:न्
1 भद्रोद्भवकुरूनपि इति ख..
2 अलीननिषधायामा इति ख.. , छ.. च
3 रम्यकमित्यादिः, मर्यादापर्वतावुभावित्यन्न्तः पाठो झ..
पुस्तके नास्ति
4 पूर्वपश्चायतावुभौ इति घ.. , ङ.. , ज.. च
5 भुमाः स्वर्गा धर्मिणान्ते न पापास्तत्र यान्ति च इति छ.. , ङ.. च /
मौमानां स्वर्गधर्माणां तनया ह्य् अत्र यान्ति चेति ग.. , घ.. च /
भोगिनां स्वर्गधर्माणां तनयास्तत्र यान्ति चेति ज..
:प् 370
भद्राश्वे ऽस्ति हयग्रीवो वराहः केतुमालके //
108.m:
and of earthly beings of heavenly righteousness; the wicked do not go there.
[Footnote]
1. 'bhadrodbhavakurūnapi' in MS kha.
2. 'alīnaniṣadhāyāmā' in MSS kha and cha.
3. The reading from 'ramyakam' up to 'maryādāparvatāvubhau' is missing in MS jha.
4. 'pūrvapaścāyatāvubhau' in MSS gha, ṅa, and ja.
5. 'bhumāḥ svargā dharmiṇānte na pāpāstatra yānti ca' in MSS cha and ṅa.
6. 'maumānāṃ svargadharmāṇāṃ tanayā hy atra yānti ca' in MSS ga and gha.
7. 'bhogināṃ svargadharmāṇāṃ tanayāstatra yānti ca' in MS ja.
In Bhadrāśva resides Hayagrīva; the Boar [resides] in Ketumāla;

108.s:
bhārate kūrmarūpī ca matsyarūpaḥ kuruṣvapi /
viśvarūpeṇa sarvatra pūjyate bhagavān hariḥ //
108.d:
भारते कूर्मरूपी च मत्स्यरूपः कुरुष्वपि /
विश्वरूपेण सर्वत्र पूज्यते भगवान् हरिः //
108.m: and in Bhārata [he resides] in the form of the Tortoise; in the Kurus, in the form of the Fish. / Lord Hari is worshipped everywhere in his universal form.

108.s:
kimpuruṣādyaṣṭasu kṣudbhītiśokādikaṃ na ca /
catturviṃśatisāhasraṃ prajā jīvantyanāmayāḥ //
108.d:
किम्पुरुषाद्यष्टसु क्षुद्भीतिशोकादिकं न च /
चत्तुर्विंशतिसाहस्रं प्रजा जीवन्त्यनामयाः //
108.m: In the eight realms beginning with Kimpuruṣa, there is neither hunger, fear, sorrow, nor the like; / the people, free from disease, live for twenty-four thousand [years].

108.s:
kṛtādikalpanā nāsti bhaumānyambhāṃsi nāmbudāḥ /
sarveṣveteṣu varṣeṣu sapta sapta kulācalāḥ //
108.d:
कृतादिकल्पना नास्ति भौमान्यम्भांसि नाम्बुदाः /
सर्वेष्वेतेषु वर्षेषु सप्त सप्त कुलाचलाः //
108.m: There is no reckoning of ages such as the Kṛta; their waters are of the earth, not from clouds. / In all these realms there are seven clan-mountains each,

108.s:
nadyaś ca śataśastebhyastīrthabhūtāḥ prajajñire /
bhārate yāni nīrthāni tāni tīrthāni vacmi te //
:ś atha navādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
tīrthamāhātmyaṃ
108.d:
नद्यश् च शतशस्तेभ्यस्तीर्थभूताः प्रजज्ञिरे /
भारते यानि नीर्थानि तानि तीर्थानि वच्मि ते //
:श् अथ नवाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
तीर्थमाहात्म्यं
108.m:
and hundreds of rivers flowing from them have become sacred fords. / I will tell you of the sacred fords that exist in Bhārata.
Now begins the one hundred and ninth chapter.
The Greatness of Sacred Fords.

109.s:
agnir uvāca
māhātmyaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ vakṣye yadbhaktimuktidaṃ /
yasya hastau ca pādau ca manaś caiva susaṃyataṃ(1) //
109.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
माहात्म्यं सर्वतीर्थानां वक्ष्ये यद्भक्तिमुक्तिदं /
यस्य हस्तौ च पादौ च मनश् चैव सुसंयतं(1) //
109.m: Agni said: / I shall declare the greatness of all sacred fords, which grants worldly enjoyment and liberation. / One whose hands, feet, and mind are well controlled,

109.s:
vidyā tapaś ca kīrtiś ca sa tīrthaphalamaśnute /
:n
1 svasaṃyatamiti gha..
:p 371
pratigrāhādupāvṛtto laghvāhāro jitendriyaḥ //
109.d:
विद्या तपश् च कीर्तिश् च स तीर्थफलमश्नुते /
:न्
1 स्वसंयतमिति घ..
:प् 371
प्रतिग्राहादुपावृत्तो लघ्वाहारो जितेन्द्रियः //
109.m:
who possesses learning, ascetic austerity, and good repute, attains the fruit of a sacred ford.
[Footnote]
1. 'svasaṃyatam' in MS gha.
Refraining from acceptance of gifts, eating light food, with senses subdued,

109.s:
niṣpapastīrthayātrī tu sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet /
anupoṣya trirātrīṇi tīrthānyanabhigamya ca //
109.d:
निष्पपस्तीर्थयात्री तु सर्वयज्ञफलं लभेत् /
अनुपोष्य त्रिरात्रीणि तीर्थान्यनभिगम्य च //
109.m: the pilgrim to a sacred ford, free from sin, obtains the fruit of all sacrifices. / Without having fasted for three nights and without having visited sacred fords,

109.s:
adatvā kāñcanaṃ gāś ca daridro nāma jāyate /
tīrthābhiogamane(1) tat syādyadyajñenāpyate phalaṃ //
109.d:
अदत्वा काञ्चनं गाश् च दरिद्रो नाम जायते /
तीर्थाभिओगमने(1) तत् स्याद्यद्यज्ञेनाप्यते फलं //
109.m: and without giving gold and cattle, one is born verily poor. / By visiting a sacred ford, that fruit which is gained by a sacrifice is obtained.

109.s:
puṣkaraṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ sānnidhyaṃ hi trisandhyakaṃ /
daśakoṭisahasrāṇi tīrthānāṃ vipra puṣkare //
109.d:
पुष्करं परमं तीर्थं सान्निध्यं हि त्रिसन्ध्यकं /
दशकोटिसहस्राणि तीर्थानां विप्र पुष्करे //
109.m: Puṣkara is the supreme sacred ford; [the divine] presence is there at the three junctions of the day. / Ten thousand crores of sacred fords are present at Puṣkara, O brahmin.

109.s:
brahmā saha surair āste munayaḥ sarvamicchavaḥ /
devāḥ prāptāḥ siddhimatra snātāḥ pitṛsurārcakāḥ(2) //
109.d:
ब्रह्मा सह सुरैर् आस्ते मुनयः सर्वमिच्छवः /
देवाः प्राप्ताः सिद्धिमत्र स्नाताः पितृसुरार्चकाः(2) //
109.m: Brahmā resides [there] together with the gods, as do sages desiring everything. / Here the gods attained perfection, bathing [and] worshipping the ancestors and the deities.

109.s:
aśvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya(3) brahmalokaṃ prayānti te /
kārttikyāmannadānācca nirmalo brahmalokabhāk(4) //
109.d:
अश्वमेधफलं प्राप्य(3) ब्रह्मलोकं प्रयान्ति ते /
कार्त्तिक्यामन्नदानाच्च निर्मलो ब्रह्मलोकभाक्(4) //
109.m: Obtaining the fruit of a horse-sacrifice, they proceed to the world of Brahmā; / and by gifting food on the full moon of Kārttika, [a man] becomes spotless and enjoys the world of Brahmā.

109.s:
puṣkare duṣkaraṃ gantuṃ(5) puṣkare duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ /
duṣkaraṃ puṣkare dānaṃ vastuṃ caiva suduṣkaraṃ(6) //
109.d:
पुष्करे दुष्करं गन्तुं(5) पुष्करे दुष्करं तपः /
दुष्करं पुष्करे दानं वस्तुं चैव सुदुष्करं(6) //
109.m: Difficult it is to go to Puṣkara; difficult is ascetic austerity at Puṣkara; / difficult is gift at Puṣkara, and very difficult indeed to reside [there].

109.s:
tatra vāsājjapacchrāddhāt kulānāṃ śatamuddharet /
jambumārgaṃ ca tatraiva tīrthantaṇḍulikāśramaṃ //
109.d:
तत्र वासाज्जपच्छ्राद्धात् कुलानां शतमुद्धरेत् /
जम्बुमार्गं च तत्रैव तीर्थन्तण्डुलिकाश्रमं //
109.m: By residing there, by recitation, and by ancestral rites, one would deliver a hundred ancestors' lineages. / Right there are Jambumārga, and the sacred ford Taṇḍulikāśrama,

109.s:
karṇāśramaṃ(7) koṭitīrthaṃ narmadā cārvudaṃ paraṃ /
tīrthañcarmaṇvatī sindhuḥ somanāthaḥ prabhāsakaṃ //
109.d:
कर्णाश्रमं(7) कोटितीर्थं नर्मदा चार्वुदं परं /
तीर्थञ्चर्मण्वती सिन्धुः सोमनाथः प्रभासकं //
109.m: Karṇāśrama, Koṭitīrtha, the Narmadā, and the supreme Arbuda; / the sacred fords Carmaṇvatī, Sindhu, Somanātha, and Prabhāsa;

109.s:
sarasvatyabdhisaṅgaś ca(8) sāgarantīrthamuttamaṃ /
:n
1 tīrthādigamane iti gha..
2 pitṛsurārcitā iti kha..
3 aśvamedhaphalaścāsyeti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. ca / aśvamedhaphalaṃ cāpyeti
gha..
4 brahmalokakamiti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca
5 duṣkaraṃ gantumiti kha..
6 vastuṃ tatra suduṣkaramiti ja..
7 kaṇvāśramamiti gha..
8 sarasvatyabdhisañjñayeti ga.. , gha.. , ja.. ca
:p 372
piṇḍārakaṃ dvārakā ca gomatī sarvasiddhidā //
109.d:
सरस्वत्यब्धिसङ्गश् च(8) सागरन्तीर्थमुत्तमं /
:न्
1 तीर्थादिगमने इति घ..
2 पितृसुरार्चिता इति ख..
3 अश्वमेधफलश्चास्येति ख.. , ग.. , छ.. च / अश्वमेधफलं चाप्येति
घ..
4 ब्रह्मलोककमिति ख.. , ग.. , ङ.. , छ.. च
5 दुष्करं गन्तुमिति ख..
6 वस्तुं तत्र सुदुष्करमिति ज..
7 कण्वाश्रममिति घ..
8 सरस्वत्यब्धिसञ्ज्ञयेति ग.. , घ.. , ज.. च
:प् 372
पिण्डारकं द्वारका च गोमती सर्वसिद्धिदा //
109.m:
and the confluence of the Sarasvatī with the ocean, the excellent sacred ford of the ocean.
[Footnote marker]
[Variant 1: "tīrthādigamane" in ms. gha]
[Variant 2: "pitṛsurārcitāḥ" in ms. kha]
[Variant 3: "aśvamedhaphalaścāsya" in mss. kha, ga, cha; "aśvamedhaphalaṃ cāpya" in ms. gha]
[Variant 4: "brahmalokakam" in mss. kha, ga, ṅa, cha]
[Variant 5: "duṣkaraṃ gantum" in ms. kha]
[Variant 6: "vastuṃ tatra suduṣkaram" in ms. ja]
[Variant 7: "kaṇvāśramam" in ms. gha]
[Variant 8: "sarasvatyabdhisañjñayā" in mss. ga, gha, ja; p. 372]
Piṇḍāraka, Dvārakā, and the Gomatī, which grants all perfections;

109.s:
bhūmitīrthaṃ brahmatuṅgaṃ(1) tīrthaṃ pañcanadaṃ paraṃ /
bhīmatīrthaṃ(2) girīndrañca devikā pāpanāśinī //
109.d:
भूमितीर्थं ब्रह्मतुङ्गं(1) तीर्थं पञ्चनदं परं /
भीमतीर्थं(2) गिरीन्द्रञ्च देविका पापनाशिनी //
109.m: Bhūmitīrtha, Brahmatuṅga, the supreme sacred ford Pañcanada, / Bhīmatīrtha, Girīndra, and the Devikā, which destroys sin;

109.s:
tīrthaṃ vinaśanaṃ puṇyaṃ nāgodbhedamaghārdanaṃ /
tīrthaṃ kumārakoṭiś ca sarvadānīritāni ca //
109.d:
तीर्थं विनशनं पुण्यं नागोद्भेदमघार्दनं /
तीर्थं कुमारकोटिश् च सर्वदानीरितानि च //
109.m: the holy sacred ford Vinaśana, Nāgodbheda that removes sins, / and the sacred ford Kumārakoṭi: all have been declared by the wise.

109.s:
kurukṣetraṃ gamiṣyāmi kurukṣetre vasāmyahaṃ /
ya evaṃ satataṃ brūyātso 'malaḥ prāpnuyāddivaṃ //
109.d:
कुरुक्षेत्रं गमिष्यामि कुरुक्षेत्रे वसाम्यहं /
य एवं सततं ब्रूयात्सो ऽमलः प्राप्नुयाद्दिवं //
109.m: “I will go to Kurukṣetra; I reside in Kurukṣetra”— / whoever would constantly say this, spotless, shall attain heaven.

109.s:
tatra viṣṇvādayo devāstatra vāsāddhariṃ vrajet(3) /
sarasvatyāṃ sannihityāṃ snānakṛdbrahmalokabhāk(4) //
109.d:
तत्र विष्ण्वादयो देवास्तत्र वासाद्धरिं व्रजेत्(3) /
सरस्वत्यां सन्निहित्यां स्नानकृद्ब्रह्मलोकभाक्(4) //
109.m: There dwell Viṣṇu and the other gods; by living there one goes to Hari. / Performing a bath in the Sarasvatī at the Sannihitī, one attains the world of Brahmā.

109.s:
pāṃśavopi kurukṣetre nayanti paramāṃ gatiṃ /
dharmatīrthaṃ suvarṇākhyaṃ gaṅgādvāramanuttamaṃ //
109.d:
पांशवोपि कुरुक्षेत्रे नयन्ति परमां गतिं /
धर्मतीर्थं सुवर्णाख्यं गङ्गाद्वारमनुत्तमं //
109.m: Even the particles of dust in Kurukṣetra lead to the highest destination. / Dharmatīrtha, the one called Suvarṇa, and the unsurpassable Gaṅgādvāra;

109.s:
tīrthaṃ kaṇakhalaṃ puṇyaṃ bhadrakarṇahradantathā(5) /
gaṅgāsasvatīsaṅgaṃ brahmāvartamaghārdanaṃ //
109.d:
तीर्थं कणखलं पुण्यं भद्रकर्णह्रदन्तथा(5) /
गङ्गासस्वतीसङ्गं ब्रह्मावर्तमघार्दनं //
109.m: the holy sacred ford Kaṇakhala, and likewise the pool Bhadrakarṇa; / the confluence of the Gaṅgā and Sarasvatī, and Brahmāvarta that crushes sin;

109.s:
bhṛgutuṅgañca kubjāmraṃ gaṅgodbhedamaghāntakaṃ(6) /
vārāṇasī varantīrthamavimuktamanuttamaṃ //
109.d:
भृगुतुङ्गञ्च कुब्जाम्रं गङ्गोद्भेदमघान्तकं(6) /
वाराणसी वरन्तीर्थमविमुक्तमनुत्तमं //
109.m: Bhṛgutuṅga, Kubjāmra, and Gaṅgodbheda that puts an end to sin; / Vārāṇasī, the excellent sacred ford, and the unsurpassable Avimukta;

109.s:
kapālamocanaṃ tīrthantīrtharājaṃ prayāgakaṃ /
gomatīgaṅgayoḥ saṅgaṃ gaṅgā sarvatra nākadā //
109.d:
कपालमोचनं तीर्थन्तीर्थराजं प्रयागकं /
गोमतीगङ्गयोः सङ्गं गङ्गा सर्वत्र नाकदा //
109.m: the sacred ford Kapālamocana, Prayāga the king of sacred fords, / and the confluence of the Gomatī and Gaṅgā: the Gaṅgā everywhere grants heaven.

109.s:
tīrthaṃ rājagṛhaṃ puṇyaṃ śālagrāmamaghāntakaṃ /
:n
1 ṛṣitīrthaṃ brahmatuṅgamiti gha.. / bhūmitīrthaṃ
brahmasañjñamiti cha..
2 bhīmātīrthamiti gha..
3 vāmāddivaṃ brajediti ja..
4 brahmalokaga iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
5 tatra karṇahradaṃ tatheti kha.. / bhadrakaṃ tu hradaṃ tatheti ga.. , ṅa..
ca
6 gaṅgodbhedamavantikamiti ja..
:p 373
vaṭeśaṃ vāmanntīrthaṃ kālikāsaṅgamuttamaṃ(1) //
109.d:
तीर्थं राजगृहं पुण्यं शालग्राममघान्तकं /
:न्
1 ऋषितीर्थं ब्रह्मतुङ्गमिति घ.. / भूमितीर्थं
ब्रह्मसञ्ज्ञमिति छ..
2 भीमातीर्थमिति घ..
3 वामाद्दिवं ब्रजेदिति ज..
4 ब्रह्मलोकग इति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. , ज.. च
5 तत्र कर्णह्रदं तथेति ख.. / भद्रकं तु ह्रदं तथेति ग.. , ङ..
च
6 गङ्गोद्भेदमवन्तिकमिति ज..
:प् 373
वटेशं वामन्न्तीर्थं कालिकासङ्गमुत्तमं(1) //
109.m:
The holy sacred ford Rājagṛha, and Śālagrāma that puts an end to sin;
[Footnote marker]
[Variant 1: "ṛṣitīrthaṃ brahmatuṅgam" in ms. gha; "bhūmitīrthaṃ brahmasañjñam" in ms. cha]
[Variant 2: "bhīmātīrtham" in ms. gha]
[Variant 3: "vāmāddivaṃ brajet" in ms. ja]
[Variant 4: "brahmalokagaḥ" in mss. kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cha, ja]
[Variant 5: "tatra karṇahradaṃ tathā" in ms. kha; "bhadrakaṃ tu hradaṃ tathā" in mss. ga, ṅa]
[Variant 6: "gaṅgodbhedamavantikam" in ms. ja; p. 373]
Vaṭeśa, the sacred ford Vāmana, and the excellent confluence of the Kālikā;

109.s:
lauhityaṃ karatoyākhyaṃ śoṇañcātharṣabhaṃ paraṃ /
śrīparvataṃ kolvagiriṃ(2) sahyādrirmalayo giriḥ //
109.d:
लौहित्यं करतोयाख्यं शोणञ्चाथर्षभं परं /
श्रीपर्वतं कोल्वगिरिं(2) सह्याद्रिर्मलयो गिरिः //
109.m: Lauhitya, the one named Karatoyā, the Śoṇa, and the supreme Ṛṣabha; / Śrīparvata, the Kolvagiri mountain, the Sahyādri, and the Malaya mountain;

109.s:
godāvarī tuṅgabhadrā kāvero varadā nadī /
tāpī payoṣṇī revā ca daṇḍakāraṇyamuttamaṃ //
109.d:
गोदावरी तुङ्गभद्रा कावेरो वरदा नदी /
तापी पयोष्णी रेवा च दण्डकारण्यमुत्तमं //
109.m: the Godāvarī, the Tuṅgabhadrā, the Kāverī, and the river Varadā; / the Tāpī, the Payoṣṇī, the Revā, and the excellent Daṇḍaka forest;

109.s:
kālañjaraṃ muñjavaṭantīrthaṃ sūrpārakaṃ paraṃ /
mandākinī citrakūṭaṃ śṛṅgaverapuraṃ paraṃ(3) //
109.d:
कालञ्जरं मुञ्जवटन्तीर्थं सूर्पारकं परं /
मन्दाकिनी चित्रकूटं शृङ्गवेरपुरं परं(3) //
109.m: Kālañjara, Muñjavaṭa, and the supreme sacred ford Sūrpāraka; / the Mandākinī, Citrakūṭa, and the supreme Śṛṅgaverapura;

109.s:
avantī paramaṃ tīrthamayodhyā pāpanāśanī /
naimiṣaṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakaṃ(4) //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe tīrthayātrā māhātmyaṃ nāma
navādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha daśādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
gaṅāmāhātmyaṃ
109.d:
अवन्ती परमं तीर्थमयोध्या पापनाशनी /
नैमिषं परमं तीर्थं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकं(4) //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे तीर्थयात्रा माहात्म्यं नाम
नवाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ दशाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
गङामाहात्म्यं
109.m:
Avantī, the supreme sacred ford, and Ayodhyā, destroyer of sins; / and Naimiṣa, the supreme sacred ford that bestows worldly enjoyment and liberation.
Thus ends the one hundred and ninth chapter, entitled “The Greatness of Pilgrimage to Sacred Fords,” in the great Agni Purāṇa.
Now begins the one hundred and tenth chapter:
The Greatness of the Gaṅgā.

110.s:
agnir uvāca
gaṅāmāhātmyamākhyāsye sevyā sā bhuktimuktidā /
yeṣāṃ madhye yāti gaṅgā te deśā pāvanā varāḥ //
:n
1 tīrthaṃ kaṇakhalamityādiḥ, kālikāsaṅgamuttamamityantaḥ
pāṭho cha.. pustake nāsti
2 śrīparvataṃ kondragiririti cha.. / śrīparvataṃ kolagirimiti ja..
3 śṛṅgaverapuaraṃ varamiti gha..
4 agnir uvāca / māhātmyaṃ sarvatīrthānāmityādiḥ, naimiṣaṃ
paramantīrthaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakaṃ / ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe
tīrthayātrāmāhātmyamityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti
:p 374
110.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
गङामाहात्म्यमाख्यास्ये सेव्या सा भुक्तिमुक्तिदा /
येषां मध्ये याति गङ्गा ते देशा पावना वराः //
:न्
1 तीर्थं कणखलमित्यादिः, कालिकासङ्गमुत्तममित्यन्तः
पाठो छ.. पुस्तके नास्ति
2 श्रीपर्वतं कोन्द्रगिरिरिति छ.. / श्रीपर्वतं कोलगिरिमिति ज..
3 शृङ्गवेरपुअरं वरमिति घ..
4 अग्निर् उवाच / माहात्म्यं सर्वतीर्थानामित्यादिः, नैमिषं
परमन्तीर्थं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकं / इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे
तीर्थयात्रामाहात्म्यमित्यन्तः पाठो झ.. पुस्तके नास्ति
:प् 374
110.m:
Agni said: / I shall describe the greatness of the Gaṅgā; she should be served, granting worldly enjoyment and liberation. / The regions through the midst of which the Gaṅgā flows are pure and supreme.
[Footnote marker]
[Variant 1: The reading from "tīrthaṃ kaṇakhalam" up to "kālikāsaṅgamuttamam" is absent in ms. cha]
[Variant 2: "śrīparvataṃ kondragiriḥ" in ms. cha; "śrīparvataṃ kolagirim" in ms. ja]
[Variant 3: "śṛṅgaverapuraṃ varam" in ms. gha]
[Variant 4: The passage from "agnir uvāca / māhātmyaṃ sarvatīrthānām..." up to "naimiṣaṃ paramantīrthaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakaṃ / ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe tīrthayātrāmāhātmyam" is absent in ms. jha; p. 374]

110.s:
gatirgaṅgā tu(1) bhūtānāṃ gatimanveṣatāṃ(2)
sadā
gaṅgā tārayate(3) cobhau vaṃśau nityaṃ hi sevitā //
110.d:
गतिर्गङ्गा तु(1) भूतानां गतिमन्वेषतां(2)
सदा
गङ्गा तारयते(3) चोभौ वंशौ नित्यं हि सेविता //

110.s:
cāndrāyaṇasahasrācca gaṅgāmbhaḥpānamuttamaṃ /
gaṅāṃ māsantu saṃsevya sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet //
110.d:
चान्द्रायणसहस्राच्च गङ्गाम्भःपानमुत्तमं /
गङां मासन्तु संसेव्य सर्वयज्ञफलं लभेत् //
110.m: Drinking the water of the Gaṅgā is superior to a thousand cāndrāyaṇa penances. / Having attended upon the Gaṅgā for a month, one attains the fruit of all sacrifices.

110.s:
sakalāghaharī devī svargalokapradāyinī /
yāvadasthi ca gaṅgāyāṃ tāvat svarge sa tiṣṭhati //
110.d:
सकलाघहरी देवी स्वर्गलोकप्रदायिनी /
यावदस्थि च गङ्गायां तावत् स्वर्गे स तिष्ठति //
110.m: The goddess removes all sins and bestows the world of heaven. / As long as one's bone remains in the Gaṅgā, for so long he resides in heaven.

110.s:
andhādayastu(4) tāṃ sevya devair gacchanti tulyatāṃ(5) /
gaṅgātīrthasamudbhūtamṛddhārī so 'ghahārkavat(6) //
110.d:
अन्धादयस्तु(4) तां सेव्य देवैर् गच्छन्ति तुल्यतां(5) /
गङ्गातीर्थसमुद्भूतमृद्धारी सो ऽघहार्कवत्(6) //
110.m: Even the blind and the like, by serving her, attain equality with the gods. / One who bears the mud arising from the sacred ford of the Gaṅgā destroys sins like the Sun.

110.s:
darśanāt sparśanāt pānāttathā gaṅgetikīrtanāt /
punāti puṇyapuruṣān śataśītha sahasraśaḥ //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe gaṅgāmāhātmyaṃ nāma
daśādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha ekādaśādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
prayāgamāhātmyaṃ
110.d:
दर्शनात् स्पर्शनात् पानात्तथा गङ्गेतिकीर्तनात् /
पुनाति पुण्यपुरुषान् शतशीथ सहस्रशः //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे गङ्गामाहात्म्यं नाम
दशाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ एकादशाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
प्रयागमाहात्म्यं
110.m:
By seeing, touching, drinking, and likewise by calling out “Gaṅgā,” / she purifies virtuous men by hundreds and by thousands.
Thus ends the one hundred and tenth chapter, entitled “The Greatness of the Gaṅgā,” in the great Agni Purāṇa.
Now begins the one hundred and eleventh chapter:
The Greatness of Prayāga.

111.s:
agnir uvāca
vakṣye prayāgamāhātmyaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ paraṃ(7) /
prayāge brahmaviṣṇvādyā deva munivarāḥ sthitāḥ //
:n
1 gatirgaṅgā hīti ga.. , ja.. ca
2 gatirgatimatāmiti jha..
3 gaṅgā pāvayate iti jha..
4 patitādayastu iti jha..
5 gacchanti sāmyatāmiti gha.. , jha.. ca
6 gaṅgātīrasamudbhūtamṛddhāro so 'ghahārkavaditi kha.. , ga.. , jha.. ca /
gaṅgātīrasamudbhūtamṛdaṃ mūrdhā vibharti yaḥ / vibharti
rūpaṃ sorkasya tamonāśāya kevalamiti ṅa..
7 bhaktimuktiphalapradamiti ga.. / bhuktimuktipradāyakamiti jha..
:p 375
111.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
वक्ष्ये प्रयागमाहात्म्यं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं परं(7) /
प्रयागे ब्रह्मविष्ण्वाद्या देव मुनिवराः स्थिताः //
:न्
1 गतिर्गङ्गा हीति ग.. , ज.. च
2 गतिर्गतिमतामिति झ..
3 गङ्गा पावयते इति झ..
4 पतितादयस्तु इति झ..
5 गच्छन्ति साम्यतामिति घ.. , झ.. च
6 गङ्गातीरसमुद्भूतमृद्धारो सो ऽघहार्कवदिति ख.. , ग.. , झ.. च /
गङ्गातीरसमुद्भूतमृदं मूर्धा विभर्ति यः / विभर्ति
रूपं सोर्कस्य तमोनाशाय केवलमिति ङ..
7 भक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदमिति ग.. / भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकमिति झ..
:प् 375
111.m:
Agni said: / I will declare the supreme greatness of Prayāga, which bestows worldly enjoyment and liberation. / At Prayāga reside the gods, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and others, as well as the foremost sages.
[Footnote marker]
1. "gatir gaṅgā hi" in ga and ja.
2. "gatir gatimatām" in jha.
3. "gaṅgā pāvayate" in jha.
4. "patitādayas tu" in jha.
5. "gacchanti sāmyatām" in gha and jha.
6. "gaṅgātīrasamudbhūtamṛddhāro 'so 'ghahārkavat" in kha, ga, and jha.
"He who carries on his head the clay originating from the banks of the Gaṅgā bears the very form of the sun solely for the destruction of darkness," in ṅa.
7. "bhaktimuktiphalapradam" in ga; "bhuktimuktipradāyakam" in jha.

111.s:
saritaḥ sāgarāḥ siddhā gandharvasarāpsas tathā /
tatra trīṇyagnikuṇḍāni teṣāṃ madhye tu jāhnavī //
111.d:
सरितः सागराः सिद्धा गन्धर्वसराप्सस् तथा /
तत्र त्रीण्यग्निकुण्डानि तेषां मध्ये तु जाह्नवी //
111.m: Rivers, oceans, Siddhas, Gandharvas, and Apsarases are there. / There are three fire-pits, and between them is the Jāhnavī.

111.s:
vegena samatikrāntā sarvatīrthatiraskṛtā /
tapanasya sutā tatra triṣu lokeṣu viśrutā //
111.d:
वेगेन समतिक्रान्ता सर्वतीर्थतिरस्कृता /
तपनस्य सुता तत्र त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुता //
111.m: Rushing past swiftly, surpassing all sacred fords, / the daughter of the sun is famous there throughout the three worlds.

111.s:
gaṅgāyamunayormadhyaṃ(1) pṛthivyā jaghanaṃ smṛtaṃ /
prayāgaṃ jaghanasyāntarupasthamṛṣayo viduḥ(2) //
111.d:
गङ्गायमुनयोर्मध्यं(1) पृथिव्या जघनं स्मृतं /
प्रयागं जघनस्यान्तरुपस्थमृषयो विदुः(2) //
111.m: The space between the Gaṅgā and the Yamunā is considered the hips of the earth; / sages know Prayāga situated within the hips to be the female organ.

111.s:
prayāgaṃ sapratiṣṭhānam kambalāśvatarāvubhau /
tīrthaṃ bhogavatī caiva vedī proktā prajāpateḥ //
111.d:
प्रयागं सप्रतिष्ठानम् कम्बलाश्वतरावुभौ /
तीर्थं भोगवती चैव वेदी प्रोक्ता प्रजापतेः //
111.m: Prayāga, together with Pratiṣṭhāna, both Kambala and Aśvatara, / and the Bhogavatī sacred ford, is declared the sacrificial altar of Prajāpati.

111.s:
tatra vedāś ca yajñāś ca mūrtimantaḥ prayāgake /
stavanādasya(3) tīrthasya nāmasaṅkirtanādapi //
111.d:
तत्र वेदाश् च यज्ञाश् च मूर्तिमन्तः प्रयागके /
स्तवनादस्य(3) तीर्थस्य नामसङ्किर्तनादपि //
111.m: There the Vedas and sacrifices are present in bodily form at Prayāga. / By praising this sacred ford or even by reciting its name,

111.s:
mṛttikālambhanādvāpi sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate /
prayāge saṅgate dānaṃ śrāddhaṃ japyādi cākṣayaṃ(4) //
111.d:
मृत्तिकालम्भनाद्वापि सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते /
प्रयागे सङ्गते दानं श्राद्धं जप्यादि चाक्षयं(4) //
111.m: or by touching its clay, one is liberated from all sins. / Gift, ancestral rite, recitation, and so forth performed at the confluence in Prayāga become imperishable.

111.s:
na devavacanādvipra na lokavacanādapi /
matirutkramaṇīyānte prayāge maraṇaṃ prati //
111.d:
न देववचनाद्विप्र न लोकवचनादपि /
मतिरुत्क्रमणीयान्ते प्रयागे मरणं प्रति //
111.m: O Brahmin, not on the word of a god, nor even on the word of ordinary folk, / should one’s resolution be turned away at the end regarding death at Prayāga.

111.s:
daśatīrthasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭyas tathāparāḥ /
teṣāṃ sānnidhyamatraiva prayāgaṃ paramantataḥ //
111.d:
दशतीर्थसहस्राणि षष्टिकोट्यस् तथापराः /
तेषां सान्निध्यमत्रैव प्रयागं परमन्ततः //
111.m: Ten thousand sacred fords and another sixty crores / are present right here; therefore Prayāga is supreme.

111.s:
vāsukerbhogavatyatra haṃsaprapatanaṃ paraṃ /
gavāṃ koṭipradānādyat tryahaṃ snānasya(5) tatphalaṃ //
111.d:
वासुकेर्भोगवत्यत्र हंसप्रपतनं परं /
गवां कोटिप्रदानाद्यत् त्र्यहं स्नानस्य(5) तत्फलं //
111.m: Here are the Bhogavatī of Vāsuki and the supreme Haṃsaprapatana. / Whatever fruit is obtained from the gift of a crore of cows is obtained by bathing for three days

111.s:
prayāge māghamāse tu evamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ /
:n
1 gaṅāyamunayormadhye iti kha..
2 saritaḥ sāgarā ity ādiḥ, upasthamṛṣayo vidurityantaḥ pāṭho
ga.. pustake nāsti
3 śravaṇādasyeti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca
4 śrāddhadravyādi cākṣayamiti gha..
5 tryahaṃ snātasyeti gha..
:p 376
sarvatra sulabhā gaṅgā triṣu sthāneṣu durlabhā //
111.d:
प्रयागे माघमासे तु एवमाहुर्मनीषिणः /
:न्
1 गङायमुनयोर्मध्ये इति ख..
2 सरितः सागरा इत्य् आदिः, उपस्थमृषयो विदुरित्यन्तः पाठो
ग.. पुस्तके नास्ति
3 श्रवणादस्येति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , ज.. च
4 श्राद्धद्रव्यादि चाक्षयमिति घ..
5 त्र्यहं स्नातस्येति घ..
:प् 376
सर्वत्र सुलभा गङ्गा त्रिषु स्थानेषु दुर्लभा //
111.m:
at Prayāga in the month of Māgha: so say the wise.
[Footnote]
1. "gaṅgāyamunayor madhye" in kha.
2. The text beginning with "saritaḥ sāgarāḥ" and ending with "upastham ṛṣayo viduḥ" is absent in manuscript ga.
3. "śravaṇād asya" in kha, ga, gha, ṅa, and ja.
4. "śrāddhadravyādi cākṣayam" in gha.
5. "tryahaṃ snātasya" in gha.
The Gaṅgā is accessible everywhere, [yet] hard to reach at three places:

111.s:
gaṅādvāre prayāge ca gaṅgāsāgarasaṅgame /
atra dānāddivaṃ(1) yāti rājendro jāyate 'tra ca //
111.d:
गङाद्वारे प्रयागे च गङ्गासागरसङ्गमे /
अत्र दानाद्दिवं(1) याति राजेन्द्रो जायते ऽत्र च //
111.m: at Gaṅgādvāra, at Prayāga, and at the confluence of the Gaṅgā and the ocean. / From giving [gifts] here, one goes to heaven, and one is born here as an emperor.

111.s:
vaṭamūle saṅgamādau mṛto viṣṇupurīṃ vrajet /
urvaśīpulinaṃ ramyaṃ tīrthaṃ sandhyāvatas tathā //
111.d:
वटमूले सङ्गमादौ मृतो विष्णुपुरीं व्रजेत् /
उर्वशीपुलिनं रम्यं तीर्थं सन्ध्यावतस् तथा //
111.m: One who dies at the foot of the banyan tree, at the confluence, and elsewhere goes to the realm of Viṣṇu. / There is the lovely Urvaśī sandbank, and the sacred ford Sandhyāvata,

111.s:
koṭītīrthañcāśvamedhaṃ gaṅgāyamunamuttamaṃ /
mānasaṃ rajasā hīnaṃ tīrthaṃ vāsarakaṃ paraṃ(2) //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe prayāgamāhātmyaṃ nāma
ekādaśādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha dvādaśādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
vārāṇasīmāhātmyam
111.d:
कोटीतीर्थञ्चाश्वमेधं गङ्गायमुनमुत्तमं /
मानसं रजसा हीनं तीर्थं वासरकं परं(2) //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे प्रयागमाहात्म्यं नाम
एकादशाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ द्वादशाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
वाराणसीमाहात्म्यम्
111.m:
Koṭītīrtha, Aśvamedha, the supreme [confluence of] Gaṅgā and Yamunā, / the Mānasa sacred ford free of impurity, and the supreme Vāsaraka sacred ford.
Thus ends the one hundred and eleventh chapter, entitled "The Greatness of Prayāga," in the Great Purāṇa of Agni.
Now the one hundred and twelfth chapter.
The Greatness of Vārāṇasī

112.s:
agnir uvāca
vārāṇasī(3) paraṃ tīrthaṃ gauryai prāha maheśvaraḥ /
bhuktimuktipradaṃ puṇyaṃ vasatāṃ gṛṇatāṃ hariṃ(4) //
112.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
वाराणसी(3) परं तीर्थं गौर्यै प्राह महेश्वरः /
भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं पुण्यं वसतां गृणतां हरिं(4) //
112.m: Agni said: / Maheśvara told Gaurī about Vārāṇasī, the supreme sacred ford, / auspicious, bestowing worldly enjoyment and liberation upon those who dwell [there] praising Hari.

112.s:
rudra uvāca
gaurīkṣetraṃ na muktaṃ vai avimuktaṃ tataḥ smṛtaṃ /
:n
1 annadānāddivamiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
2 tīrthaṃ vānarakaṃ paramiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca
3 vārāṇasīmiti kha.. , gha.. ca
4 vasatāṃ śṛṇutāṃ harimiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca
:p 377
japtaṃ taptaṃ dattamamavimukte vilākṣayaṃ //
112.d:
रुद्र उवाच
गौरीक्षेत्रं न मुक्तं वै अविमुक्तं ततः स्मृतं /
:न्
1 अन्नदानाद्दिवमिति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. , ज.. च
2 तीर्थं वानरकं परमिति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. च
3 वाराणसीमिति ख.. , घ.. च
4 वसतां शृणुतां हरिमिति ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. च
:प् 377
जप्तं तप्तं दत्तममविमुक्ते विलाक्षयं //
112.m:
Rudra said: / Gaurī's sacred area is never forsaken (na muktam); therefore it is known as Avimukta.
1. "annadānād divaṃ" in kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cha, and ja.
2. "tīrthaṃ vānarakaṃ param" in kha, ga, gha, and ṅa.
3. "vārāṇasīm" in kha and gha.
4. "vasatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ harim" in ga, gha, and ṅa.
What is recited, practiced as ascetic austerity, or given at Avimukta becomes imperishable.

112.s:
aśmanā caraṇau hatvā vasetkāśīnna hi tyajet(1) /
hariś candraṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ guhyamāmnātakeśvaraṃ(2) //
112.d:
अश्मना चरणौ हत्वा वसेत्काशीन्न हि त्यजेत्(1) /
हरिश् चन्द्रं परं गुह्यं गुह्यमाम्नातकेश्वरं(2) //
112.m: Having broken one’s legs with a stone, one should dwell in Kāśī and never abandon it. / Hariścandra is supremely secret, and Āmrātakeśvara is secret;

112.s:
japyeśvaraṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ(3) guhyaṃ śrīparvataṃ tathā /
mahālayaṃ(4) paraṃ guhyaṃ bhṛguś caṇḍeśvaraṃ(5) tathā //
112.d:
जप्येश्वरं परं गुह्यं(3) गुह्यं श्रीपर्वतं तथा /
महालयं(4) परं गुह्यं भृगुश् चण्डेश्वरं(5) तथा //
112.m: Japyeśvara is supremely secret, and likewise Śrīparvata is secret; / Mahālaya is supremely secret, as are Bhṛgu and Caṇḍeśvara;

112.s:
kedāraṃ paramaṃ guhyamaṣṭau santyavimuktake /
guhyānāṃ paramaṃ guhyamavimuktaṃ paraṃ mama //
112.d:
केदारं परमं गुह्यमष्टौ सन्त्यविमुक्तके /
गुह्यानां परमं गुह्यमविमुक्तं परं मम //
112.m: Kedāra is supremely secret; there are eight [such shrines] in Avimukta. / Avimukta, the most secret of secrets, is supreme to me.

112.s:
dviyojanantu pūrvaṃ syād yojanārdhaṃ tadanyathā(6) /
varaṇā ca nadī cāsīt tayormadhye(7) vārāṇasī //
112.d:
द्वियोजनन्तु पूर्वं स्याद् योजनार्धं तदन्यथा(6) /
वरणा च नदी चासीत् तयोर्मध्ये(7) वाराणसी //
112.m: It measures two yojanas from east [to west], and half a yojana across; / and there was the river Varaṇā; between the two lies Vārāṇasī.

112.s:
atra snānaṃ japo homo maraṇaṃ devapūjanaṃ /
śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ nivāsaś ca yadyat syādbhuktimuktidaṃ(8) //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe vārāṇasīmāhātmyaṃ nāma
dvādaśādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 kāśīṃ tu na hi santyajediti ja..
2 paraṃ guhyamavimuktaṃ paraṃ mameti ja..
3 jayeśvaraṃ paraṃ guhyamiti kha..
4 mahābalamiti ka..
5 bhūmicaṇḍeśvaramiti ga..
6 tathānyatheti jha..
7 dvayormadhye iti kha..
8 yadvat syādbhuktimuktidamiti ṅa..
:p 378
:ś atha trayodaśādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
narmadādimāhātmyam
112.d:
अत्र स्नानं जपो होमो मरणं देवपूजनं /
श्राद्धं दानं निवासश् च यद्यत् स्याद्भुक्तिमुक्तिदं(8) //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे वाराणसीमाहात्म्यं नाम
द्वादशाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 काशीं तु न हि सन्त्यजेदिति ज..
2 परं गुह्यमविमुक्तं परं ममेति ज..
3 जयेश्वरं परं गुह्यमिति ख..
4 महाबलमिति क..
5 भूमिचण्डेश्वरमिति ग..
6 तथान्यथेति झ..
7 द्वयोर्मध्ये इति ख..
8 यद्वत् स्याद्भुक्तिमुक्तिदमिति ङ..
:प् 378
:श् अथ त्रयोदशाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
नर्मदादिमाहात्म्यम्
112.m:
Bathing, recitation, fire oblation, death, worship of gods, / ancestral rite, gift, and dwelling here—whatever it may be, bestows worldly enjoyment and liberation.
Thus ends the one hundred and twelfth chapter, entitled "The Greatness of Vārāṇasī," in the Great Purāṇa of Agni.
[Footnote]
1. "kāśīṃ tu na hi santyajet" in ja.
2. "paraṃ guhyam avimuktaṃ paraṃ mama" in ja.
3. "jayeśvaraṃ paraṃ guhyam" in kha.
4. "mahābalam" in ka.
5. "bhūmicaṇḍeśvaram" in ga.
6. "tathānyathā" in jha.
7. "dvayor madhye" in kha.
8. "yadvat syād bhuktimuktidam" in ṅa.
Now the one hundred and thirteenth chapter.
The Greatness of the Narmadā and Other Rivers

113.s:
agnir uvāca
narmadādikamāhātmyaṃ vakṣyehaṃ narmadāṃ parāṃ(1) /
sadyaḥ punāti gāṅgeyaṃ darśanādvāri nārmadaṃ //
113.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
नर्मदादिकमाहात्म्यं वक्ष्येहं नर्मदां परां(1) /
सद्यः पुनाति गाङ्गेयं दर्शनाद्वारि नार्मदं //
113.m: Agni said: / I shall declare the greatness of the Narmadā and other [rivers], and of the supreme Narmadā. / The water of the Gaṅgā purifies immediately; the water of the Narmadā purifies merely by sight.
In extent it is one hundred yojanas long and two yojanas wide. / Sixty thousand sacred fords and another sixty crores

113.s:
parvatasya samantāttu tiṣṭhantyamarakaṇṭake(2) /
kāverīsaṅgamaṃ puṇyaṃ śrīparvatamataḥ śṛṇu //
113.d:
पर्वतस्य समन्तात्तु तिष्ठन्त्यमरकण्टके(2) /
कावेरीसङ्गमं पुण्यं श्रीपर्वतमतः शृणु //
113.m: are situated all around the mountain at Amarakaṇṭaka. / The confluence of the Kāverī is holy; next listen about Śrīparvata.

113.s:
gaurī śrīrūpiṇī tepe tapastāmabravīddhariḥ(3) /
avāpsyasi tvamadhyātmyaṃ nāmnā śrīparvatastava //
113.d:
गौरी श्रीरूपिणी तेपे तपस्तामब्रवीद्धरिः(3) /
अवाप्स्यसि त्वमध्यात्म्यं नाम्ना श्रीपर्वतस्तव //
113.m:
Gaurī, taking the form of Śrī, practiced ascetic austerity. Hari said to her:
“You will attain spiritual supremacy, and [this place] will bear your name, Śrīparvata.

113.s:
samantādyojanaśataṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ bhaviṣyati /
atra dānantapo japyaṃ(4) śrāddhaṃ sarvamathākṣayaṃ(5) //
:n
1 narmadāparamiti jha..
2 niryāntyamarakaṇṭake iti jha..
3 tapastāmabravīddhara iti ga..
4 atra dānaṃ tathā japyamiti jha..
5 sarvamathākṣaramiti kha.. , cha.. ca
:p 379
113.d:
समन्ताद्योजनशतं महापुण्यं भविष्यति /
अत्र दानन्तपो जप्यं(4) श्राद्धं सर्वमथाक्षयं(5) //
:न्
1 नर्मदापरमिति झ..
2 निर्यान्त्यमरकण्टके इति झ..
3 तपस्तामब्रवीद्धर इति ग..
4 अत्र दानं तथा जप्यमिति झ..
5 सर्वमथाक्षरमिति ख.. , छ.. च
:प् 379
113.m:
For a hundred yojanas all around, it will be immensely meritorious.
Here gifts, ascetic austerity, recitation, and ancestral rites are all inexhaustible.
[Footnote]
1 'narmadāparam' in manuscript jha
2 'niryāntyamarakaṇṭake' in manuscript jha
3 'tapastāmabravīddhara' in manuscript ga
4 'atra dānaṃ tathā japyam' in manuscript jha
5 'sarvamathākṣaram' in manuscripts kha and cha / p. 379

113.s:
maraṇaṃ śivalokāya sarvadaṃ tīrthamuttamaṃ /
haro 'tra krīḍate devyā hiraṇyakaśipus tathā //
113.d:
मरणं शिवलोकाय सर्वदं तीर्थमुत्तमं /
हरो ऽत्र क्रीडते देव्या हिरण्यकशिपुस् तथा //
113.m:
Dying [here] leads to the realm of Śiva; this excellent sacred ford grants everything.
Hara sports here with the goddess, and likewise Hiraṇyakaśipu,

113.s:
tapastaptvā balī cābhūnmunayaḥ siddhimāpnuvan(1) /
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe narmadāśrīparvatādimāhātmyaṃ nāma
trayodaśādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha caturdaśādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
gayāmāhātmyam
113.d:
तपस्तप्त्वा बली चाभून्मुनयः सिद्धिमाप्नुवन्(1) /
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे नर्मदाश्रीपर्वतादिमाहात्म्यं नाम
त्रयोदशाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ चतुर्दशाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
गयामाहात्म्यम्
113.m:
having performed ascetic austerity, became powerful, and sages attained perfection.”
Thus ends the one hundred and thirteenth chapter, entitled 'The Glory of Narmadā, Śrīparvata and Others', in the Great Purāṇa of Agni.
Now begins the one hundred and fourteenth chapter:
The Glory of Gayā.

114.s:
agnir uvāca
gayāmāhātmyamākhyāsye gayātīrthottamottamaṃ /
gayāsurastapastepe tattapastāpibhiḥ(2) suraiḥ //
114.d:
अग्निर् उवाच
गयामाहात्म्यमाख्यास्ये गयातीर्थोत्तमोत्तमं /
गयासुरस्तपस्तेपे तत्तपस्तापिभिः(2) सुरैः //
114.m:
Agni said:
I shall describe the glory of Gayā, the most excellent of supreme sacred fords.
The demon Gayāsura performed ascetic austerity. Tormented by his ascetic austerity, the gods

114.s:
uktaḥ kṣīrābdhigo viṣṇuḥ pālayāsmān gayāsurāt /
tathetyuktvā harirdaityaṃ varaṃ brūhīti cābravīt //
114.d:
उक्तः क्षीराब्धिगो विष्णुः पालयास्मान् गयासुरात् /
तथेत्युक्त्वा हरिर्दैत्यं वरं ब्रूहीति चाब्रवीत् //
114.m:
spoke to Viṣṇu residing in the Milk Ocean: “Protect us from Gayāsura!”
Saying “So be it,” Hari said to the daitya: “Ask a boon.”

114.s:
daityo 'bravītpavitro 'haṃ bhaveyaṃ sarvatīrthataḥ /
tathetyuktvā gato viṣṇurdaityaṃ dṛṣṭvā na vā hariṃ //
114.d:
दैत्यो ऽब्रवीत्पवित्रो ऽहं भवेयं सर्वतीर्थतः /
तथेत्युक्त्वा गतो विष्णुर्दैत्यं दृष्ट्वा न वा हरिं //
114.m:
The daitya said: “May I become purer than all sacred fords.”
Saying “So be it,” Viṣṇu departed. Having seen the daitya, or not [even] seeing Hari,

114.s:
gatāḥ śūnyā mahī svarge devā brahmādayaḥ surāḥ(3) /
:n
1 siddhimāpnuyuriti jha..
2 tattapastāpitair iti ga.. , gha.. , jha.. ca
3 brahmādayaḥ punaḥ iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja. jha.. ca
:p 380
gatā ūcurhariṃ devāḥ śūnyā bhūstridivaṃ hare //
114.d:
गताः शून्या मही स्वर्गे देवा ब्रह्मादयः सुराः(3) /
:न्
1 सिद्धिमाप्नुयुरिति झ..
2 तत्तपस्तापितैर् इति ग.. , घ.. , झ.. च
3 ब्रह्मादयः पुनः इति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. , ज. झ.. च
:प् 380
गता ऊचुर्हरिं देवाः शून्या भूस्त्रिदिवं हरे //
114.m:
[all creatures] went to heaven; the earth was empty, as were the gods, Brahmā and the other deities.
[Footnote]
1 'siddhimāpnuyuḥ' in manuscript jha
2 'tattapastāpitaiḥ' in manuscripts ga, gha, and jha
3 'brahmādayaḥ punaḥ' in manuscripts kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cha, ja, and jha / p. 380
The gods went and said to Hari: “O Hari! The earth and the third heaven are empty,

114.s:
daityasya darśanādeva brahmaṇañcābravīddhariḥ /
yāgārthaṃ daityadehaṃ tvaṃ prārthaya tridaśaiḥ saha //
114.d:
दैत्यस्य दर्शनादेव ब्रह्मणञ्चाब्रवीद्धरिः /
यागार्थं दैत्यदेहं त्वं प्रार्थय त्रिदशैः सह //
114.m:
merely from the sight of the daitya!” Hari said to Brahmā:
“For the sake of a sacrifice, request the body of the daitya together with the gods.”

114.s:
tac chrutvā sasuro brahmā(1) gayāsuramathābravīt /
atithiḥ prārthayāmi tvāndehaṃ yāgāya pāvanaṃ //
114.d:
तच् छ्रुत्वा ससुरो ब्रह्मा(1) गयासुरमथाब्रवीत् /
अतिथिः प्रार्थयामि त्वान्देहं यागाय पावनं //
114.m:
Having heard that, Brahmā together with the gods said to Gayāsura:
“As a guest, I request your pure body for a sacrifice.”

114.s:
gayāsurastathetyuktvāpatattasya śirasyatha(2) /
yāgaṃ cakāra calite dehi pūrṇāhutiṃ(3) vibhuḥ //
114.d:
गयासुरस्तथेत्युक्त्वापतत्तस्य शिरस्यथ(2) /
यागं चकार चलिते देहि पूर्णाहुतिं(3) विभुः //
114.m:
Gayāsura said “So be it,” and fell upon his head.
When [the demon] shook, the lord performed the sacrifice, [offering] the final oblation upon the body.

114.s:
punarbrahmābravīdviṣṇuṃ pūrṇakāle 'suro 'calat /
śiṣṇurdharmamathāhūya prāha devamayīṃ śilām //
114.d:
पुनर्ब्रह्माब्रवीद्विष्णुं पूर्णकाले ऽसुरो ऽचलत् /
शिष्णुर्धर्ममथाहूय प्राह देवमयीं शिलाम् //
114.m:
Brahmā spoke again to Viṣṇu: “At the time of completion, the asura moved.”
Viṣṇu then summoned Dharma and said: “The stone imbued with the deities—

114.s:
dhārayadhvaṃ surāḥ sarve yasyāmupari santu te /
gadādharo madīyātha mūrtiḥ sthāsyati sāmaraiḥ //
114.d:
धारयध्वं सुराः सर्वे यस्यामुपरि सन्तु ते /
गदाधरो मदीयाथ मूर्तिः स्थास्यति सामरैः //
114.m:
all you gods, place it upon him; may those [gods] remain upon it.
Then my form, Gadādhara, shall abide there together with the immortals.”

114.s:
dharmaḥ śilāṃ devamayīṃ(4) tac chrutvādhārayat parāṃ /
yā dharmāddharmavatyāñca jātā dharmavratā sutā //
114.d:
धर्मः शिलां देवमयीं(4) तच् छ्रुत्वाधारयत् परां /
या धर्माद्धर्मवत्याञ्च जाता धर्मव्रता सुता //
114.m:
Having heard that, Dharma placed the supreme stone imbued with the deities [upon him],
who was born as the daughter Dharmavratā from Dharma and Dharmavatī.

114.s:
marīcirbrahmaṇaḥ putrastāmuvāha taponvitāṃ(5) /
yathā hariḥ śriyā reme gauryā śambhus tathā tayā //
114.d:
मरीचिर्ब्रह्मणः पुत्रस्तामुवाह तपोन्वितां(5) /
यथा हरिः श्रिया रेमे गौर्या शम्भुस् तथा तया //
114.m:
Marīci, the son of Brahmā, married her, who was endowed with ascetic austerity.
As Hari delighted with Śrī, and Śambhu with Gaurī, so did he with her.

114.s:
kuśapuṣpādyaraṇyācca ānīyātiśramānvitaḥ(6) /
bhuktvā dharmavratāṃ prāha pādasaṃvāhanaṃ kuru //
114.d:
कुशपुष्पाद्यरण्याच्च आनीयातिश्रमान्वितः(6) /
भुक्त्वा धर्मव्रतां प्राह पादसंवाहनं कुरु //
114.m:
Bringing kuśa grass, flowers, and other items from the forest, overwhelmed with fatigue,
having eaten, he said to Dharmavratā: “Massage my feet.”

114.s:
viśrāntasya muneḥ pādau tathetyuktvā priyākarot /
etasminnantare brahmā munau supte tathāgataḥ(7) //
114.d:
विश्रान्तस्य मुनेः पादौ तथेत्युक्त्वा प्रियाकरोत् /
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे ब्रह्मा मुनौ सुप्ते तथागतः(7) //
114.m:
Saying “So be it,” the beloved massaged the feet of the rested sage.
In the meantime, while the sage was asleep, Brahmā arrived.

114.s:
dharmavratācintayañca kiṃ brahmāṇaṃ samarcaye /
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ kurve brahmā pūjyo gurorguruḥ(8) //
:n
1 tac chrutvā satvaro brahmeti ṅa..
2 śirastatheti jha..
3 dehe pūrṇāhutimiti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
4 dehamayīmiti ga.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
5 tapaścitāmiti jha..
6 samānīya śramānvita iti ja..
7 supte samāgata iti gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , jha.. ca
8 dharmavratetyādiḥ, gurorgururityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ cha.. pustake
nāsti
:p 381
114.d:
धर्मव्रताचिन्तयञ्च किं ब्रह्माणं समर्चये /
पादसंवाहनं कुर्वे ब्रह्मा पूज्यो गुरोर्गुरुः(8) //
:न्
1 तच् छ्रुत्वा सत्वरो ब्रह्मेति ङ..
2 शिरस्तथेति झ..
3 देहे पूर्णाहुतिमिति ख.. , छ.. , ज.. च
4 देहमयीमिति ग.. , छ.. , ज.. च
5 तपश्चितामिति झ..
6 समानीय श्रमान्वित इति ज..
7 सुप्ते समागत इति घ.. , ङ.. , ज.. , झ.. च
8 धर्मव्रतेत्यादिः, गुरोर्गुरुरित्यन्तः पाठः छ.. पुस्तके
नास्ति
:प् 381
114.m:
Dharmavratā thought: “Shall I worship Brahmā,
or continue massaging the feet? Brahmā is the guru of my guru, worthy of worship.”
[Footnote]
1 'tac chrutvā satvaro brahmā' in manuscript ṅa
2 'śirastathā' in manuscript jha
3 'dehe pūrṇāhutim' in manuscripts kha, cha, and ja
4 'dehamayīm' in manuscripts ga, cha, and ja
5 'tapaścitām' in manuscript jha
6 'samānīya śramānvitaḥ' in manuscript ja
7 'supte samāgataḥ' in manuscripts gha, ṅa, ja, and jha
8 The passage beginning with 'dharmavratā' and ending with 'gurorguruḥ' is absent in manuscript cha / p. 381

114.s:
vicintya pūjayāmāsa brahmāṇaṃ cārhaṇādibhiḥ /
marīcistāmapaśyat sa(1) śaśāpoktivyatikramāt //
114.d:
विचिन्त्य पूजयामास ब्रह्माणं चार्हणादिभिः /
मरीचिस्तामपश्यत् स(1) शशापोक्तिव्यतिक्रमात् //
114.m:
Having reflected, she worshipped Brahmā with offerings of hospitality and the like.
Marīci saw her and, because of the breach of his instruction, cursed [her]:

114.s:
śilā bhaviṣyasi krodhāddharmavratābravīcca taṃ(2) /
pādābhyaṅgaṃ parityajya tvadguruḥ pūjito mayā //
114.d:
शिला भविष्यसि क्रोधाद्धर्मव्रताब्रवीच्च तं(2) /
पादाभ्यङ्गं परित्यज्य त्वद्गुरुः पूजितो मया //
114.m:
“You shall become a stone!” Out of anger, Dharmavratā said to him:
“Abandoning the rubbing of your feet, your guru was worshipped by me.

114.s:
adoṣāhaṃ yatastvaṃ hi śāpaṃ prāpsyasi śaṅkarāt /
dharmavratā pṛthak śāpaṃ dhārayitvāgrimadhyagāt //
114.d:
अदोषाहं यतस्त्वं हि शापं प्राप्स्यसि शङ्करात् /
धर्मव्रता पृथक् शापं धारयित्वाग्रिमध्यगात् //
114.m:
Since I am blameless, you will certainly receive a curse from Śaṅkara.”
Bearing her own curse, Dharmavratā entered into the midst of fire.

114.s:
tapaś cacāra varṣāṇāṃ sahasrāṇyayutāni ca /
tato viṣṇvādayo devā varaṃ brūhīti cābruvan //
114.d:
तपश् चचार वर्षाणां सहस्राण्ययुतानि च /
ततो विष्ण्वादयो देवा वरं ब्रूहीति चाब्रुवन् //
114.m:
She performed ascetic austerity for tens of thousands of years.
Then the gods, headed by Viṣṇu, said: “Ask a boon.”

114.s:
dharmavratābravīddevān śāpannirvartayantu me /
devā ūcuḥ
datto marīcinā śāpo bhaviṣyati na cānyathā //
114.d:
धर्मव्रताब्रवीद्देवान् शापन्निर्वर्तयन्तु मे /
देवा ऊचुः
दत्तो मरीचिना शापो भविष्यति न चान्यथा //
114.m:
Dharmavratā said to the gods: “Avert my curse!”
The gods said:
“The curse was given by Marīci; it cannot be otherwise.

114.s:
śilā pavitrā devāṅghrilakṣitā tvaṃ(3) bhaviṣyasi /
devavratā devaśilā sarvadevādirūpiṇī //
114.d:
शिला पवित्रा देवाङ्घ्रिलक्षिता त्वं(3) भविष्यसि /
देवव्रता देवशिला सर्वदेवादिरूपिणी //
114.m:
You shall become a holy stone, marked with the feet of the gods,
Devavratā, the divine stone, embodying all the gods and foremost deities,

114.s:
sarvadevamayī(4) puṇyā niś calāyārasusya hi /
devavratovāca
yadi tuṣṭāstha me sarve mayi tiṣṭhantu sarvadā //
114.d:
सर्वदेवमयी(4) पुण्या निश् चलायारसुस्य हि /
देवव्रतोवाच
यदि तुष्टास्थ मे सर्वे मयि तिष्ठन्तु सर्वदा //
114.m:
imbued with all the gods, sacred, and immovable upon the asura.”
Devavratā said:
“If you are all pleased with me, may you abide upon me at all times,

114.s:
brahmā viṣṇuś ca rudrādyā gaurīlakṣmīmukhāḥ surāḥ /
agnir uvāca
devavratāvacaḥ śrutvā tathetyuktvā divaṅgatāḥ //
114.d:
ब्रह्मा विष्णुश् च रुद्राद्या गौरीलक्ष्मीमुखाः सुराः /
अग्निर् उवाच
देवव्रतावचः श्रुत्वा तथेत्युक्त्वा दिवङ्गताः //
114.m:
Brahmā, Viṣṇu, the Rudras and others, and the deities headed by Gaurī and Lakṣmī.”
Agni said:
Having heard Devavratā's words and saying “So be it,” they went to heaven.

114.s:
sā dharmaṇāsurasyāsya dhṛtā devamayī śilā /
saśilaś calito daityaḥ sthitā rudrādayastataḥ //
114.d:
सा धर्मणासुरस्यास्य धृता देवमयी शिला /
सशिलश् चलितो दैत्यः स्थिता रुद्रादयस्ततः //
114.m:
That stone imbued with the deities was placed on the demon's [head] by Dharma.
The daitya, along with the stone, moved; thereupon Rudra and the others stood [upon him].

114.s:
sadevaś calito daityastato devaiḥ(5) prasāditaḥ /
kṣīrābdhigo hariḥ prādāt svamūrtiṃ śrīgadādharaṃ //
114.d:
सदेवश् चलितो दैत्यस्ततो देवैः(5) प्रसादितः /
क्षीराब्धिगो हरिः प्रादात् स्वमूर्तिं श्रीगदाधरं //
114.m:
Even along with the gods, the daitya shook; then he was propitiated by the gods.
Hari residing in the Milk Ocean gave his own form, the glorious Gadādhara,

114.s:
gacchantu bhoḥ svayaṃ yāsyaṃ(6) mūrtyā vai devagamyayā(7) /
:n
1 marīcistāmapaśyadvai iti gha..
2 dharmavratābravīdvaca iti ja..
3 pavitrā devānāṃ vanditā tvamiti gha..
4 sarvatīrthamayī iti gha.. , jha.. ca
5 tadā devair iti ja..
6 gacchetyuktvā svayaṃ gacchediti jha.. / gacchantūktvā svayaṃ yāsye iti kha..
, cha.. ca
7 mūrtyā devaikagamyayā iti gha.. , ṅa.. ca
:p 382
sthito gadādharo devo vyaktāvyaktobhayātmakaḥ //
114.d:
गच्छन्तु भोः स्वयं यास्यं(6) मूर्त्या वै देवगम्यया(7) /
:न्
1 मरीचिस्तामपश्यद्वै इति घ..
2 धर्मव्रताब्रवीद्वच इति ज..
3 पवित्रा देवानां वन्दिता त्वमिति घ..
4 सर्वतीर्थमयी इति घ.. , झ.. च
5 तदा देवैर् इति ज..
6 गच्छेत्युक्त्वा स्वयं गच्छेदिति झ.. / गच्छन्तूक्त्वा स्वयं यास्ये इति ख..
, छ.. च
7 मूर्त्या देवैकगम्यया इति घ.. , ङ.. च
:प् 382
स्थितो गदाधरो देवो व्यक्ताव्यक्तोभयात्मकः //
114.m:
[saying:] “Depart, O gods! I myself will go in a form accessible to the deities.”
[Footnote]
1 'marīcistāmapaśyadvai' in manuscript gha
2 'dharmavratābravīdvacaḥ' in manuscript ja
3 'pavitrā devānāṃ vanditā tvam' in manuscript gha
4 'sarvatīrthamayī' in manuscripts gha and jha
5 "tadā devaiḥ" in manuscript ja.
6 "gacchetyuktvā svayaṃ gacchet" in manuscript jha.; "gacchantūktvā svayaṃ yāsye" in kha. and cha.
7 "mūrtyā devaikagamyayā" in gha. and ṅa.
The god Gadādhara, whose nature is both manifest and unmanifest, stood [there].

114.s:
niś calārthaṃ svayaṃ devaḥ sthita ādigadādharaḥ /
gado nāmāsuro daityaḥ(1) sa hato viṣṇunā purā //
114.d:
निश् चलार्थं स्वयं देवः स्थित आदिगदाधरः /
गदो नामासुरो दैत्यः(1) स हतो विष्णुना पुरा //
114.m: For the sake of immobility, the god himself stood as Ādigadādhara. / Formerly, an Asura, a Daitya named Gada, was slain by Viṣṇu.

114.s:
tadasthinirmitā(2) cādyā gadā yā viśvakarmaṇā /
ādyayā gadayā hetipramukhā rākṣasā hatāḥ //
114.d:
तदस्थिनिर्मिता(2) चाद्या गदा या विश्वकर्मणा /
आद्यया गदया हेतिप्रमुखा राक्षसा हताः //
114.m: From his bones the primeval mace was fashioned by Viśvakarman. / With that primeval mace, the Rākṣasas headed by Heti were slain.

114.s:
gadādhareṇa vidhivat(3) tasmādādigadhādharaḥ(4) /
devamayyāṃ śilāyāṃ ca(5) sthite cādigadādhare //
114.d:
गदाधरेण विधिवत्(3) तस्मादादिगधाधरः(4) /
देवमय्यां शिलायां च(5) स्थिते चादिगदाधरे //
114.m: by Gadādhara according to rule; therefore, he is Ādigadādhara. / And when Ādigadādhara stood upon the stone that consists of the gods,

114.s:
gayāsure niś caleya brahmā pūrṇāhutiṃ dadau /
gayāsuro 'bravīddevān kimarthaṃ vañcito hy ahaṃ(6) //
114.d:
गयासुरे निश् चलेय ब्रह्मा पूर्णाहुतिं ददौ /
गयासुरो ऽब्रवीद्देवान् किमर्थं वञ्चितो ह्य् अहं(6) //
114.m: and the Gayāsura became motionless, Brahmā offered the final oblation. / Gayāsura said to the gods: "Why was I deceived?

114.s:
viṣṇorvacanamātreṇa kinnasyānniś calohyahaṃ /
ākrānto yadyahaṃ devā dātumarhata(7) me varaṃ //
114.d:
विष्णोर्वचनमात्रेण किन्नस्यान्निश् चलोह्यहं /
आक्रान्तो यद्यहं देवा दातुमर्हत(7) मे वरं //
114.m: By Viṣṇu's word alone, would I not have become motionless? / If I have been subdued, O gods, you ought to grant me a boon."

114.s:
devā ūcuḥ
tīrthasya karaṇe yat(8) tvamasmābhir niś calīkṛtaḥ /
viṣṇoḥ śambhorbrahmaṇaś ca kṣetraṃ tava bhaviṣyati //
114.d:
देवा ऊचुः
तीर्थस्य करणे यत्(8) त्वमस्माभिर् निश् चलीकृतः /
विष्णोः शम्भोर्ब्रह्मणश् च क्षेत्रं तव भविष्यति //
114.m: The gods said: / "Because you were made motionless by us for the creation of a sacred ford, / [this] field shall belong to you, and to Viṣṇu, Śambhu, and Brahmā.

114.s:
prasiddhaṃ sarvatīrthebhyaḥ pitrāderbrahmalokadaṃ /
ityuktvā te sthitā devā devyastīrthādayaḥ sthitāḥ //
114.d:
प्रसिद्धं सर्वतीर्थेभ्यः पित्रादेर्ब्रह्मलोकदं /
इत्युक्त्वा ते स्थिता देवा देव्यस्तीर्थादयः स्थिताः //
114.m: Renowned above all sacred fords, it shall bestow the world of Brahmā upon ancestors and others." / Having spoken thus, those gods remained, and the goddesses, the sacred fords, and others remained.

114.s:
yāgaṃ kṛtvā dadau brahmā ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇāṃ tadā /
pañcakrośaṃ gayākṣetraṃ pañcāśat pañca cārpayet //
114.d:
यागं कृत्वा ददौ ब्रह्मा ऋत्विग्भ्यो दक्षिणां तदा /
पञ्चक्रोशं गयाक्षेत्रं पञ्चाशत् पञ्च चार्पयेत् //
114.m: Having performed the sacrifice, Brahmā then gave the sacrificial fee to the officiating priests: / the Gayākṣetra of five krośas, and he bestowed fifty-five

114.s:
grāmān svarṇagirīn(9) kṛtvā nadīrdugdhamadhuśravāḥ /
sarovarāṇi dadhyājyair bahūnannādiparvatān(10) //

1 nāmāsuro raudra iti gha.. , jha.. ca
2 tadaṅgānnirmitā iti jha.. / tadarthā nirmitā iti cha..
3 gadāvareṇa deveneti jha..
4 gado nāmāsura ity ādiḥ, tasmādādigadādhara ity antaḥ pāṭho ja..
pustake nāsti
5 śilāyāntu iti ja..
6 vāñchito hy ahamiti kha.. , cha.. ca
7 dātumarhatheti ṅa..
8 tīrthasya kāraṇāyeti gha.. , jha.. ca
9 grāmān puṇyagirīniti ṅa..
10 dadhyādyair bahūnannādiparvatāniti ja..
:p 383
114.d:
ग्रामान् स्वर्णगिरीन्(9) कृत्वा नदीर्दुग्धमधुश्रवाः /
सरोवराणि दध्याज्यैर् बहूनन्नादिपर्वतान्(10) //
:न्
1 नामासुरो रौद्र इति घ.. , झ.. च
2 तदङ्गान्निर्मिता इति झ.. / तदर्था निर्मिता इति छ..
3 गदावरेण देवेनेति झ..
4 गदो नामासुर इत्य् आदिः, तस्मादादिगदाधर इत्य् अन्तः पाठो ज..
पुस्तके नास्ति
5 शिलायान्तु इति ज..
6 वाञ्छितो ह्य् अहमिति ख.. , छ.. च
7 दातुमर्हथेति ङ..
8 तीर्थस्य कारणायेति घ.. , झ.. च
9 ग्रामान् पुण्यगिरीनिति ङ..
10 दध्याद्यैर् बहूनन्नादिपर्वतानिति ज..

114.m:
villages, having made mountains of gold, rivers flowing with milk and honey, / lakes with curds and clarified butter, and many mountains of food and the like,
[Footnote]

2 "tadaṅgānnirmitā" in jha.; "tadarthā nirmitā" in cha.
3 "gadāvareṇa devena" in jha.
4 The reading beginning with "gado nāmāsuraḥ" and ending with "tasmādādigadādharaḥ" is absent in the manuscript ja.
5 "śilāyāntu" in ja.
6 "vāñchito hy aham" in kha. and cha.
7 "dātumarhatha" in ṅa.
8 "tīrthasya kāraṇāya" in gha. and jha.

114.s:
kāmadhenuṃ kalpataruṃ svarṇarūpyagṛhāṇi ca /
na yācayantu viprendrā alpānuktvā(1) dadau prabhuḥ //
114.d:
कामधेनुं कल्पतरुं स्वर्णरूप्यगृहाणि च /
न याचयन्तु विप्रेन्द्रा अल्पानुक्त्वा(1) ददौ प्रभुः //
114.m: the wish-granting cow, the wish-granting tree, and houses of gold and silver. / Saying, "Let the foremost of Brahmins not beg for little," the Lord gave [them].

114.s:
dharmayāge pralobhāttu pratigṛhya dhanādikaṃ /
sthitā yadā gayāyānte śaptāte brahmaṇā tadā //
114.d:
धर्मयागे प्रलोभात्तु प्रतिगृह्य धनादिकं /
स्थिता यदा गयायान्ते शप्ताते ब्रह्मणा तदा //
114.m: When, having accepted wealth and other things out of greed at the sacrificial rite of Dharma, / they remained at Gayā, they were then cursed by Brahmā:

114.s:
vidyāvivarjitā(2) yūyaṃ tṛṣṇāyuktā bhaviṣyatha /
dugdhādivarjitā nadyaḥ śailāḥ pāṣāṇarūpiṇaḥ //
114.d:
विद्याविवर्जिता(2) यूयं तृष्णायुक्ता भविष्यथ /
दुग्धादिवर्जिता नद्यः शैलाः पाषाणरूपिणः //
114.m: "You shall become devoid of learning and filled with craving! / The rivers shall be devoid of milk and the like, and the mountains will become mere stone."

114.s:
brahmāṇaṃ brāhmaṇaścocur naṣṭaṃ śāpena śākhilaṃ /
jīvanāya prasādannaḥ kuru viprāṃś ca so 'bravīt //
114.d:
ब्रह्माणं ब्राह्मणश्चोचुर् नष्टं शापेन शाखिलं /
जीवनाय प्रसादन्नः कुरु विप्रांश् च सो ऽब्रवीत् //
114.m: The Brahmins said to Brahmā: "Everything has been destroyed by the curse! / Show us favor for our livelihood." And he said to the Brahmins:

114.s:
tīrthopajīvikā yūyaṃ sacandrārkaṃ(3) bhaviṣyatha /
ye yuṣmān pūjayiṣyanti gayāyāmāgatā narāḥ //
114.d:
तीर्थोपजीविका यूयं सचन्द्रार्कं(3) भविष्यथ /
ये युष्मान् पूजयिष्यन्ति गयायामागता नराः //
114.m: "You shall subsist on the sacred ford as long as the moon and sun endure. / Those men who, having come to Gayā, will worship you

114.s:
havyakavyair dhanaiḥ śraddhaisteṣāṃ kulaśataṃ vrajet(4) /
narakāt svargalokāya(5) svargalokāt parāṅgatiṃ //
114.d:
हव्यकव्यैर् धनैः श्रद्धैस्तेषां कुलशतं व्रजेत्(4) /
नरकात् स्वर्गलोकाय(5) स्वर्गलोकात् पराङ्गतिं //
114.m: with sacrificial offerings to the gods and ancestral offerings, with wealth, and with ancestral rites, a hundred generations of their family shall go / from hell to the heavenly realm, and from the heavenly realm to the supreme state."

114.s:
gayopi cākarodyāgaṃ bahvannaṃ(6) bahudakṣiṇaṃ /
gayā purī tena nāmnā pāṇḍavā ījire hariṃ //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe gayāmāhātmyaṃ nāma
caturdaśādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ

2 gandhādivarjitā iti gha..
3 tīrthopajīvakā yūyamācandrārkamiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca
4 kulaśataṃ mahaditi ja..
5 svargalokaṃ ceti gha.. , ja.. , jha.. ca
6 vahnathemiti kha.. , cha.. ca / bahulamiti jha..

गया पुरी तेन नाम्ना पाण्डवा ईजिरे हरिं //

चतुर्दशाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः

1 अन्यानथेति झ.. / क्षपानुक्त्वा इति छ..
2 गन्धादिवर्जिता इति घ..
3 तीर्थोपजीवका यूयमाचन्द्रार्कमिति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. च

गयायात्राविधिः
114.m:
Gaya also performed a sacrifice with abundant food and bountiful sacrificial fees. / The city was named Gayā after him; there the Pāṇḍavas worshipped Hari.
Thus ends the one hundred and fourteenth chapter, named 'The Greatness of Gayā,' in the Great Purāṇa of Agni.
[Footnote]
1 "anyānatha" in jha.; "kṣapānuktvā" in cha. / 2 "gandhādivarjitā" in gha.

4 "kulaśataṃ mahat" in ja.
5 "svargalokaṃ ca" in gha., ja., and jha. / 6 "vahnathem" in kha. and cha.; "bahulam" in jha.
